#01 Global map for Fig.S2 
```{r}
library(Matrix)
library(rJava)
library(glmulti)
library(tidyr)
library(ggmap)
library(maps)
library(dplyr)

d0 <- read.csv("metadata.csv")
d0 <- d0 %>%
  mutate(
    Biomes = case_when(
      Biomes %in% c("Irrigated agriculture", "Rainfed agriculture") ~ "Agriculture",
      Biomes %in% c("Alpine grassland", "Temperate grassland") ~ "Grassland",
      Biomes %in% c("Desert grassland") ~ "Desert/Desert grassland",
      TRUE ~ Biomes  # 保持其他值不变
    )
  )


d1 <- d0[, c("Longitude", "Latitude", "Biomes")] %>% unique()

d1$Biomes <- factor(
  d1$Biomes,
  levels = c(
    "Grassland",
    "Desert/Desert grassland",
    "Agriculture",
    "Wetland",
    "Forest",
    "Tundra"
  )
)


colors <- c(
  "Grassland" = "#2E86C1",
  "Desert/Desert grassland" = "#27AE60",
  "Agriculture" = "#F39C12",
  "Wetland" = "#7D6608",
  "Forest" = "#08492A",
  "Tundra" = "#9B59B6"
)


mapWorld <- borders(
  "world",
  colour = "gray80",
  fill = "gray85",
  size = 0.1
) # create a layer of borders
mp <- ggplot() + theme_bw() +  mapWorld + xlab("Longitude") + ylab("Latitude") +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14, )) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = c(-90, 0, 90),
    labels = c("90° S", "0°", "90° N")  # 自定义纬度标签
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(-180, 0, 180),
    labels = c("180° W", "0°", "180° E")  # 自定义经度标签
  )

mp <- mp + geom_jitter(
  data = d1 ,
  aes(
    x = Longitude,
    y = Latitude,
    color = Biomes,
    fill = Biomes
  ),
  size = 2 ,
  width = 0.05,
  height = 0.05,
  stroke = 0.25
) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", size = 0.5),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    # 移除主要网格线
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    # 移除次要网格线
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  labs(color = "Biome", shape = "Biome") +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1)

print(mp)
```


#02 Cumulative effect size forest plots for Fig. 1 and Fig. S3.
##Biomass
```{r}
library(metafor)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)


ddate <- read.csv("metadata.csv", header = T)
GC_order <- c(
  "eCO2",
  "W",
  "N",
  "P",
  "K",
  "PPT-",
  "PPT+",
  "eCO2_W",
  "eCO2_N",
  "eCO2_PPT-",
  "W_N",
  "W_PPT-",
  "W_PPT+",
  "N_P",
  "N_K",
  "P_K",
  "N_PPT-",
  "N_PPT+",
  "eCO2_W_PPT-",
  "W_N_P",
  "N_P_K"
)
GR_order <- c("Plant", "Microbe", "Bacteria", "Fungi", "AMF")
df = ddate[, 1:32]

df1 = cbind(df, ddate[, c("PlantBiomass_yi", "PlantBiomass_vi")])
names(df1)[names(df1) == "PlantBiomass_yi"] <- "yi"
names(df1)[names(df1) == "PlantBiomass_vi"] <- "vi"
df1$Group <- "Plant"

df2 = cbind(df, ddate[, c("ALL_MicrobialBiomass_yi", "ALL_MicrobialBiomass_vi")])
names(df2)[names(df2) == "ALL_MicrobialBiomass_yi"] <- "yi"
names(df2)[names(df2) == "ALL_MicrobialBiomass_vi"] <- "vi"
df2$Group <- "Microbe"

df3 = cbind(df, ddate[, c("Bacteria_MicrobialBiomass_yi",
                          "Bacteria_MicrobialBiomass_vi")])
names(df3)[names(df3) == "Bacteria_MicrobialBiomass_yi"] <- "yi"
names(df3)[names(df3) == "Bacteria_MicrobialBiomass_vi"] <- "vi"
df3$Group <- "Microbe"

df4 = cbind(df, ddate[, c("Fungi_MicrobialBiomass_yi", "Fungi_MicrobialBiomass_vi")])
names(df4)[names(df4) == "Fungi_MicrobialBiomass_yi"] <- "yi"
names(df4)[names(df4) == "Fungi_MicrobialBiomass_vi"] <- "vi"
df4$Group <- "Microbe"

df5 = cbind(df, ddate[, c("AMF_MicrobialBiomass_yi", "AMF_MicrobialBiomass_vi")])
names(df5)[names(df5) == "AMF_MicrobialBiomass_yi"] <- "yi"
names(df5)[names(df5) == "AMF_MicrobialBiomass_vi"] <- "vi"
df5$Group <- "Microbe"


ddf <- rbind(df1, df2, df3, df4, df5)
d2 <- subset(ddf, !is.na(yi))
d2 <- subset(d2, vi > 0)

GCname <- unique(d2$GC)
GCname <- GCname[order(match(GCname, GC_order))]

Groupname <- unique(d2$Group)
Groupname <- Groupname[order(match(Groupname, GR_order))]


estimates <- vector()
variances <- vector()
labels <- vector()
number <- vector()

for (a1 in GCname) {
  d3 <- subset(d2, GC == a1)
  Groupname <- unique(d3$Group)
  estimates1 <- vector()
  variances1 <- vector()
  labels1 <- vector()
  number1 <- vector()
  for (a2 in Groupname) {
    rr <- try(rma(yi, vi, data = subset(d3, Group == a2), method = "REML"))
    if ('try-error' %in% class(rr)) {
      rr <- NA
    }
    estimates2 <- try(coef(rr))
    if ('try-error' %in% class(estimates2)) {
      estimates2 <- NA
    }
    variances2 <- try(vcov(rr))
    if ('try-error' %in% class(variances2)) {
      variances2 <- NA
    }
    estimates1 <- c(estimates1, estimates2)
    variances1 <- c(variances1, variances2)
    labels2 <- paste (a1, a2)
    labels1 <- c(labels1, labels2)
    aaa  = subset(d3, Group == a2)
    number2 = length(aaa$yi)
    number1 <- c(number1, number2)
  }
  estimates <- c(estimates, estimates1)
  variances <- c(variances, variances1)
  labels <- c(labels, labels1)
  number <- c(number, number1)
  number <- number[which(number != 0)]
}
split_labels <- do.call(rbind, strsplit(labels, " ")) %>% as.data.frame()
colnames(split_labels) <- c("GCF", "Groups")
result_data = data.frame(estimates, variances, split_labels, number)
result_data$CI_low = estimates - 1.96 * sqrt(variances)
result_data$CI_high = estimates + 1.96 * sqrt(variances)


plot_data <- result_data %>%
  mutate(
    type = case_when(
      GCF %in% c("N", "P", "K") ~ "Single Nutrient",
      GCF %in% c("eCO2", "W", "PPT+", "PPT-") ~ "Single Climate",
      GCF %in% c("N_P", "N_K", "P_K") ~ "Nutrient-Nutrient",
      GCF %in% c("eCO2_W", "W_PPT+", "W_PPT-", "eCO2_PPT-") ~ "Climate-Climate",
      GCF %in% c("eCO2_N", "W_N", "N_PPT+", "N_PPT-") ~ "Nutrient-Climate",
      GCF %in% c("eCO2_W_PPT-", "W_N_P", "N_P_K") ~ "Multi-Factor"
    )
  )

single_factors <- c("N", "P", "K", "eCO2", "W", "PPT+", "PPT-")
interaction_factors <- c(
  "N_P",
  "N_K",
  "P_K",
  "eCO2_N",
  "W_N",
  "N_PPT+",
  "N_PPT-",
  "eCO2_W",
  "eCO2_PPT-",
  "W_PPT+",
  "W_PPT-"
)
multi_factors <- c("N_P_K", "eCO2_W_PPT-", "W_N_P")
factor_levels <- c(single_factors, interaction_factors, multi_factors)
plot_data$GCF <- factor(plot_data$GCF, levels = rev(factor_levels))

colors <- c(
  "Single Nutrient"   = "#075F0E",
  "Single Climate"    = "#7FE289",
  "Nutrient-Nutrient" = "#8B6508",
  "Nutrient-Climate"  = "#A0A32B",
  "Climate-Climate"   = "#D4B95A",
  "Multi-Factor"      = "#1f77b4"
)
# 创建植物数据子集
plant_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Groups == "Plant")
microbe_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Groups == "Microbe")

background_data <- plant_data %>%
  distinct(GCF, type) %>%
  mutate(ymin = as.numeric(factor(GCF)) - 0.5, ymax = as.numeric(factor(GCF)) + 0.5)

plant_plot <- ggplot(plant_data, aes(x = estimates, y = GCF, color = type)) +
  geom_rect(
    data = background_data,
    aes(
      ymin = ymin,
      ymax = ymax,
      xmin = -Inf,
      xmax = Inf,
      fill = type
    ),
    alpha = 0.1,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0,
             linetype = "13",
             color = "gray10") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = CI_low, xmax = CI_high),
                 height = 0.2,
                 size = 0.5) +
  geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = CI_high, label = number),
    hjust = -0.1,
    size = 2.1,
    color = "black",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = function(x)
      gsub("_", "×", x)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Effect size",
    y = "Global change factor",
    color = "Factor Type",
    title = "Plant biomass"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    #panel.border = element_rect(fill=NA, colour='black', size=1),
    #panel.background = element_rect(fill='#FFFFFF'),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 7, color = 'black'),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 7, color = 'black'),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    # 去掉 y 轴刻度线
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(size = 0.5),
    # 让 x 轴刻度线更细
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-0.5, 1.2)) +
  guides(fill = "none")

print(plant_plot)



background_data <- microbe_data %>%
  distinct(GCF, type) %>%
  mutate(ymin = as.numeric(factor(GCF)) - 0.5, ymax = as.numeric(factor(GCF)) + 0.5)

microbe_plot <- ggplot(microbe_data, aes(x = estimates, y = GCF, color = type)) +
  geom_rect(
    data = background_data,
    aes(
      ymin = ymin,
      ymax = ymax,
      xmin = -Inf,
      xmax = Inf,
      fill = type
    ),
    alpha = 0.1,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "13",
    color = "gray10",
    size = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = CI_low, xmax = CI_high),
                 height = 0.2,
                 size = 0.5) +
  geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = CI_high, label = number),
    hjust = -0.1,
    size = 2.1,
    color = "black",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  # 修改y轴标签，将下划线改为乘号
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = function(x)
      gsub("_", "×", x)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Effect size",
    y = NULL,
    color = "Factor Type",
    title = "Microbial biomass"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    #panel.border = element_rect(fill=NA, colour='black', size=1),
    #panel.background = element_rect(fill='#FFFFFF'),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 7, color = 'black'),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 7, color = 'black'),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    # 去掉 y 轴刻度线
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(size = 0.5),
    # 让 x 轴刻度线更细
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-0.5, 1.2)) +
  guides(fill = "none")

print(microbe_plot)

combined_plot <- plant_plot + microbe_plot +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.tag = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    plot.tag.position = c(0, 1)
  )

combined_plot <- combined_plot +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'a')

print(combined_plot)

```

##Diversity
```{r}
library(metafor)

  "eCO2",

GCname <- unique(d2$GC)
GCname <- GCname[order(match(GCname, GC_order))]

Groupname <- Groupname[order(match(Groupname, GR_order))]


estimates <- vector()

number <- vector()

for (a1 in GCname) {
  d3 <- subset(d2, GC == a1)
  Groupname <- unique(d3$Group)
  estimates1 <- vector()
  variances1 <- vector()
  labels1 <- vector()
  number1 <- vector()
  for (a2 in Groupname) {
    rr <- try(rma(yi, vi, data = subset(d3, Group == a2), method = "REML"))
    if ('try-error' %in% class(rr)) {
      rr <- NA
    }
    estimates2 <- try(coef(rr))
    if ('try-error' %in% class(estimates2)) {
      estimates2 <- NA
    }
    variances2 <- try(vcov(rr))
    if ('try-error' %in% class(variances2)) {
      variances2 <- NA
    }
    estimates1 <- c(estimates1, estimates2)
    variances1 <- c(variances1, variances2)
    labels2 <- paste (a1, a2)
    labels1 <- c(labels1, labels2)
    aaa  = subset(d3, Group == a2)
    number2 = length(aaa$yi)
    number1 <- c(number1, number2)
  }
  estimates <- c(estimates, estimates1)
  variances <- c(variances, variances1)
  labels <- c(labels, labels1)
  number <- c(number, number1)
  number <- number[which(number != 0)]
}
split_labels <- do.call(rbind, strsplit(labels, " ")) %>% as.data.frame()
colnames(split_labels) <- c("GCF", "Groups")

resltdata$CI_high = estimates + 1.96 * sqrt(variances)

names(df2)[names(df2) == "ALL_MicrobialShannon_vi"] <- "vi"

names(df3)[names(df3) == "Bacteria_MicrobialShannon_vi"] <- "vi"

ddf <- rbind(df1, df2, df3, df4, df5)
d2 <- subset(ddf, !is.na(yi))
d2 <- subset(d2, vi > 0)

GCname <- unique(d2$GC)
GCname <- GCname[order(match(GCname, GC_order))]

Groupname <- unique(d2$Group)
Groupname <- Groupname[order(match(Groupname, GR_order))]


estimates <- vector()
variances <- vector()
labels <- vector()
number <- vector()

for (a1 in GCname) {
  d3 <- subset(d2, GC == a1)
  Groupname <- unique(d3$Group)
  estimates1 <- vector()
  variances1 <- vector()
  labels1 <- vector()
  number1 <- vector()
  for (a2 in Groupname) {
    rr <- try(rma(yi, vi, data = subset(d3, Group == a2), method = "REML"))
    if ('try-error' %in% class(rr)) {
      rr <- NA
    }
    estimates2 <- try(coef(rr))
    if ('try-error' %in% class(estimates2)) {
      estimates2 <- NA
    }
    variances2 <- try(vcov(rr))
    if ('try-error' %in% class(variances2)) {
      variances2 <- NA
    }
    estimates1 <- c(estimates1, estimates2)
    variances1 <- c(variances1, variances2)
    labels2 <- paste (a1, a2)
    labels1 <- c(labels1, labels2)
    aaa  = subset(d3, Group == a2)
    number2 = length(aaa$yi)
    number1 <- c(number1, number2)
  }
  estimates <- c(estimates, estimates1)
  variances <- c(variances, variances1)
  labels <- c(labels, labels1)
  number <- c(number, number1)
  number <- number[which(number != 0)]
}
split_labels <- do.call(rbind, strsplit(labels, " ")) %>% as.data.frame()
colnames(split_labels) <- c("GCF", "Groups")
resltdata = data.frame(estimates, variances, split_labels, number)
resltdata$CI_low = estimates - 1.96 * sqrt(variances)
resltdata$CI_high = estimates + 1.96 * sqrt(variances)

result_data2 <- resltdata
result_data2$Diversity <- "Shannon"

result_data <- rbind(result_data1, result_data2)



plot_data <- result_data %>%
  mutate(
    type = case_when(
      GCF %in% c("N", "P", "K") ~ "Single Nutrient",
      GCF %in% c("eCO2", "W", "PPT+", "PPT-") ~ "Single Climate",
      GCF %in% c("N_P", "N_K", "P_K") ~ "Nutrient-Nutrient",
      GCF %in% c("eCO2_W", "W_PPT+", "W_PPT-", "eCO2_PPT-") ~ "Climate-Climate",
      GCF %in% c("eCO2_N", "W_N", "N_PPT+", "N_PPT-") ~ "Nutrient-Climate",
      GCF %in% c("eCO2_W_PPT-", "W_N_P", "N_P_K") ~ "Multi-Factor"
    )
  )

single_factors <- c("N", "P", "K", "eCO2", "W", "PPT+", "PPT-")
interaction_factors <- c(
  "N_P",
  "N_K",

)

colors <- c(
  "Single Nutrient"   = "#075F0E",
  "Single Climate"    = "#7FE289",
  "Nutrient-Nutrient" = "#8B6508",
  "Nutrient-Climate"  = "#A0A32B",
  "Climate-Climate"   = "#D4B95A",
  "Multi-Factor"      = "#1f77b4"
)

# 创建植物数据子集
plant_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Groups == "Plant")
microbe_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Groups == "Microbe")

background_data <- plant_data %>%
  distinct(GCF, type) %>%
  mutate(ymin = as.numeric(factor(GCF)) - 0.5, ymax = as.numeric(factor(GCF)) + 0.5)

plant_plot <- ggplot(plant_data,
                     aes(
                       x = estimates,
                       y = GCF,
                       color = type,
                       shape = Diversity
                     )) +
  geom_rect(
    data = background_data,
    aes(
      ymin = ymin,
      ymax = ymax,
      xmin = -Inf,
      xmax = Inf,
      fill = type
    ),
    alpha = 0.1,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0,
             linetype = "13",
             color = "gray10") +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = CI_low, xmax = CI_high),
    height = 0.2,
    size = 0.5,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 1,
             alpha = 0.8,
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = CI_high, label = number),
    hjust = -0.1,
    size = 2.1,
    color = "black",
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Richness" = 16, "Shannon" = 15)) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = function(x)
      gsub("_", "×", x)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Effect size",
    y = "Global change factor",
    color = "Factor Type",
    title = "Plant diversity"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 7, color = 'black'),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 7, color = 'black'),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(size = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-1.5, 0.7)) +
  guides(fill = "none")

print(plant_plot)



background_data <- microbe_data %>%
  distinct(GCF, type) %>%
  mutate(ymin = as.numeric(factor(GCF)) - 0.5, ymax = as.numeric(factor(GCF)) + 0.5)

microbe_plot <- ggplot(microbe_data,
                       aes(
                         x = estimates,
                         y = GCF,
                         color = type,
                         shape = Diversity
                       )) +
  geom_rect(
    data = background_data,
    aes(
      ymin = ymin,
      ymax = ymax,
      xmin = -Inf,
      xmax = Inf,
      fill = type
    ),
    alpha = 0.1,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0,
             linetype = "13",
             color = "gray10") +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = CI_low, xmax = CI_high),
    height = 0.2,
    size = 0.5,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 1,
             alpha = 0.8,
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = CI_high, label = number),
    hjust = -0.1,
    size = 2.1,
    color = "black",
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Richness" = 16, "Shannon" = 15)) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = function(x)
      gsub("_", "×", x)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Effect size",
    y = NULL,
    color = "Factor Type",
    title = "Microbial diversity"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 7, color = 'black'),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 7, color = 'black'),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(size = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-0.4, 0.5)) +
  guides(fill = "none")

print(microbe_plot)

combined_plot <- plant_plot + microbe_plot +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.tag = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    plot.tag.position = c(0, 1)
  )

combined_plot <- combined_plot +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'a')

print(combined_plot)
```

##Structure
```{r}
library(metafor)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

ddate <- read.csv("metadata.csv", header = T)
GC_order <- c(
  "eCO2",
  "W",
  "N",
  "P",
  "K",
  "PPT-",
  "PPT+",
  "eCO2_W",
  "eCO2_N",
  "eCO2_PPT-",
  "W_N",
  "W_PPT-",
  "W_PPT+",
  "N_P",
  "N_K",
  "P_K",
  "N_PPT-",
  "N_PPT+",
  "eCO2_W_PPT-",
  "W_N_P",
  "N_P_K"
)
GR_order <- c("Plant", "Microbe", "Bacteria", "Fungi", "AMF")
df = ddate[, 1:32]

df1 = cbind(df, ddate[, c("PlantStructure_yi", "PlantStructure_vi")])
names(df1)[names(df1) == "PlantStructure_yi"] <- "yi"
names(df1)[names(df1) == "PlantStructure_vi"] <- "vi"
df1$Group <- "Plant"

df2 = cbind(df, ddate[, c("ALL_MicrobialStructure_yi", "ALL_MicrobialStructure_vi")])
names(df2)[names(df2) == "ALL_MicrobialStructure_yi"] <- "yi"
names(df2)[names(df2) == "ALL_MicrobialStructure_vi"] <- "vi"
df2$Group <- "Microbe"

df3 = cbind(df, ddate[, c("Bacteria_MicrobialStructure_yi",
                          "Bacteria_MicrobialStructure_vi")])
names(df3)[names(df3) == "Bacteria_MicrobialStructure_yi"] <- "yi"
names(df3)[names(df3) == "Bacteria_MicrobialStructure_vi"] <- "vi"
df3$Group <- "Microbe"

df4 = cbind(df, ddate[, c("Fungi_MicrobialStructure_yi",
                          "Fungi_MicrobialStructure_vi")])
names(df4)[names(df4) == "Fungi_MicrobialStructure_yi"] <- "yi"
names(df4)[names(df4) == "Fungi_MicrobialStructure_vi"] <- "vi"
df4$Group <- "Microbe"

df5 = cbind(df, ddate[, c("AMF_MicrobialStructure_yi", "AMF_MicrobialStructure_vi")])
names(df5)[names(df5) == "AMF_MicrobialStructure_yi"] <- "yi"
names(df5)[names(df5) == "AMF_MicrobialStructure_vi"] <- "vi"
df5$Group <- "Microbe"


ddf <- rbind(df1, df2, df3, df4, df5)
d2 <- subset(ddf, !is.na(yi))
d2 <- subset(d2, vi > 0)

GCname <- unique(d2$GC)
GCname <- GCname[order(match(GCname, GC_order))]

Groupname <- unique(d2$Group)
Groupname <- Groupname[order(match(Groupname, GR_order))]


estimates <- vector()
variances <- vector()
labels <- vector()
number <- vector()

for (a1 in GCname) {
  d3 <- subset(d2, GC == a1)
  Groupname <- unique(d3$Group)
  estimates1 <- vector()
  variances1 <- vector()
  labels1 <- vector()
  number1 <- vector()
  for (a2 in Groupname) {
    rr <- try(rma(yi, vi, data = subset(d3, Group == a2), method = "REML"))
    if ('try-error' %in% class(rr)) {
      rr <- NA
    }
    estimates2 <- try(coef(rr))
    if ('try-error' %in% class(estimates2)) {
      estimates2 <- NA
    }
    variances2 <- try(vcov(rr))
    if ('try-error' %in% class(variances2)) {
      variances2 <- NA
    }
    estimates1 <- c(estimates1, estimates2)
    variances1 <- c(variances1, variances2)
    labels2 <- paste (a1, a2)
    labels1 <- c(labels1, labels2)
    aaa  = subset(d3, Group == a2)
    number2 = length(aaa$yi)
    number1 <- c(number1, number2)
  }
  estimates <- c(estimates, estimates1)
  variances <- c(variances, variances1)
  labels <- c(labels, labels1)
  number <- c(number, number1)
  number <- number[which(number != 0)]
}
split_labels <- do.call(rbind, strsplit(labels, " ")) %>% as.data.frame()
colnames(split_labels) <- c("GCF", "Groups")
result_data = data.frame(estimates, variances, split_labels, number)
result_data$CI_low = estimates - 1.96 * sqrt(variances)
result_data$CI_high = estimates + 1.96 * sqrt(variances)


plot_data <- result_data %>%
  mutate(
    type = case_when(
      GCF %in% c("N", "P", "K") ~ "Single Nutrient",
      GCF %in% c("eCO2", "W", "PPT+", "PPT-") ~ "Single Climate",
      GCF %in% c("N_P", "N_K", "P_K") ~ "Nutrient-Nutrient",
      GCF %in% c("eCO2_W", "W_PPT+", "W_PPT-", "eCO2_PPT-") ~ "Climate-Climate",
      GCF %in% c("eCO2_N", "W_N", "N_PPT+", "N_PPT-") ~ "Nutrient-Climate",
      GCF %in% c("eCO2_W_PPT-", "W_N_P", "N_P_K") ~ "Multi-Factor"
    )
  )

single_factors <- c("N", "P", "K", "eCO2", "W", "PPT+", "PPT-")
interaction_factors <- c(
  "N_P",
  "N_K",
  "P_K",
  "eCO2_N",
  "W_N",
  "N_PPT+",
  "N_PPT-",
  "eCO2_W",
  "eCO2_PPT-",
  "W_PPT+",
  "W_PPT-"
)
multi_factors <- c("N_P_K", "eCO2_W_PPT-", "W_N_P")
factor_levels <- c(single_factors, interaction_factors, multi_factors)
plot_data$GCF <- factor(plot_data$GCF, levels = rev(factor_levels))

colors <- c(
  "Single Nutrient"   = "#075F0E",
  "Single Climate"    = "#7FE289",
  "Nutrient-Nutrient" = "#8B6508",
  "Nutrient-Climate"  = "#A0A32B",
  "Climate-Climate"   = "#D4B95A",
  "Multi-Factor"      = "#1f77b4"
)
# 创建植物数据子集
plant_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Groups == "Plant")
microbe_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Groups == "Microbe")

background_data <- plant_data %>%
  distinct(GCF, type) %>%
  mutate(ymin = as.numeric(factor(GCF)) - 0.5, ymax = as.numeric(factor(GCF)) + 0.5)

plant_plot <- ggplot(plant_data, aes(x = estimates, y = GCF, color = type)) +
  geom_rect(
    data = background_data,
    aes(
      ymin = ymin,
      ymax = ymax,
      xmin = -Inf,
      xmax = Inf,
      fill = type
    ),
    alpha = 0.1,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0,
             linetype = "13",
             color = "gray10") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = CI_low, xmax = CI_high),
                 height = 0.2,
                 size = 0.5) +
  geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = CI_high, label = number),
    hjust = -0.1,
    size = 2.1,
    color = "black",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = function(x)
      gsub("_", "×", x)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Effect size",
    y = "Global change factor",
    color = "Factor Type",
    title = "Plant structure"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    #panel.border = element_rect(fill=NA, colour='black', size=1),
    #panel.background = element_rect(fill='#FFFFFF'),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 7, color = 'black'),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 7, color = 'black'),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    # 去掉 y 轴刻度线
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(size = 0.5),
    # 让 x 轴刻度线更细
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-0.5, 1.5)) +
  guides(fill = "none")

print(plant_plot)



background_data <- microbe_data %>%
  distinct(GCF, type) %>%
  mutate(ymin = as.numeric(factor(GCF)) - 0.5, ymax = as.numeric(factor(GCF)) + 0.5)

microbe_plot <- ggplot(microbe_data, aes(x = estimates, y = GCF, color = type)) +
  geom_rect(
    data = background_data,
    aes(
      ymin = ymin,
      ymax = ymax,
      xmin = -Inf,
      xmax = Inf,
      fill = type
    ),
    alpha = 0.1,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "13",
    color = "gray10",
    size = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = CI_low, xmax = CI_high),
                 height = 0.2,
                 size = 0.5) +
  geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = CI_high, label = number),
    hjust = -0.1,
    size = 2.1,
    color = "black",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  # 修改y轴标签，将下划线改为乘号
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = function(x)
      gsub("_", "×", x)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Effect size",
    y = NULL,
    color = "Factor Type",
    title = "Microbial structure"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    #panel.border = element_rect(fill=NA, colour='black', size=1),
    #panel.background = element_rect(fill='#FFFFFF'),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 7, color = 'black'),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 7, color = 'black'),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    # 去掉 y 轴刻度线
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(size = 0.5),
    # 让 x 轴刻度线更细
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-1.5, 2.8)) +
  guides(fill = "none")

print(microbe_plot)

combined_plot <- plant_plot + microbe_plot +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.tag = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    plot.tag.position = c(0, 1)
  )

combined_plot <- combined_plot +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'a')

print(combined_plot)
```

```{r}
    axis.title = element_text(size = 7, color = 'black'),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    # 去掉 y 轴刻度线
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(size = 0.5),
    # 让 x 轴刻度线更细
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-2.2, 1)) +
  guides(fill = "none")

print(plant_plot)



background_data <- microbe_data %>%
  distinct(GCF, type) %>%
  mutate(ymin = as.numeric(factor(GCF)) - 0.5, ymax = as.numeric(factor(GCF)) + 0.5)

microbe_plot <- ggplot(microbe_data, aes(x = estimates, y = GCF, color = type)) +
  geom_rect(
    data = background_data,
    aes(
      ymin = ymin,
      ymax = ymax,
      xmin = -Inf,
      xmax = Inf,
      fill = type
    ),
    alpha = 0.1,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "13",
    color = "gray10",
    size = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = CI_low, xmax = CI_high),
                 height = 0.2,
                 size = 0.5) +
  geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = CI_high, label = number),
    hjust = -0.1,
    size = 2.1,
    color = "black",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  # 修改y轴标签，将下划线改为乘号
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = function(x)
      gsub("_", "×", x)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Effect size",
    y = NULL,
    color = "Factor Type",
    title = "Microbial beta"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    #panel.border = element_rect(fill=NA, colour='black', size=1),
    #panel.background = element_rect(fill='#FFFFFF'),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 7, color = 'black'),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 7, color = 'black'),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    # 去掉 y 轴刻度线
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(size = 0.5),
    # 让 x 轴刻度线更细
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-3.3, 1.2)) +
  guides(fill = "none")

print(microbe_plot)

combined_plot <- plant_plot + microbe_plot +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.tag = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    plot.tag.position = c(0, 1)
  )

combined_plot <- combined_plot +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'a')

print(combined_plot)

```


#03 Cumulative effect size subgroup forest plots for Figs. S3–S8
## Subgroup analysis by biomes
### Biomass
```{r}
library(metafor)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

ddate <- read.csv("metadata.csv", header = T)
ddate <- ddate %>%
  mutate(
    Biomes = case_when(
      Biomes %in% c("Irrigated agriculture", "Rainfed agriculture") ~ "Agriculture",
      Biomes %in% c("Alpine grassland", "Temperate grassland") ~ "Grassland",
      Biomes %in% c("Desert grassland") ~ "Desert/Desert grassland",
      TRUE ~ Biomes  # 保持其他值不变
    )
  )
GC_order <- c(
  "eCO2",
  "W",
  "N",
  "P",
  "K",
  "PPT-",
  "PPT+",
  "eCO2_W",
  "eCO2_N",
  "eCO2_PPT-",
  "W_N",
  "W_PPT-",
  "W_PPT+",
  "N_P",
  "N_K",
  "P_K",
  "N_PPT-",
  "N_PPT+",
  "eCO2_W_PPT-",
  "W_N_P",
  "N_P_K"
)
GR_order <- c("Plant", "Microbe", "Bacteria", "Fungi", "AMF")
Biome_order <- c("Agriculture",
                 "Forest",
                 "Grassland",
                 "Desert/Desert grassland",
                 "Tundra",
                 "Wetland")
df = ddate[, 1:32]

df1 = cbind(df, ddate[, c("PlantBiomass_yi", "PlantBiomass_vi")])
names(df1)[names(df1) == "PlantBiomass_yi"] <- "yi"
names(df1)[names(df1) == "PlantBiomass_vi"] <- "vi"
df1$Group <- "Plant"

d2 <- subset(df1, !is.na(yi))
d2 <- subset(d2, vi > 0)

GCname <- unique(d2$GC)
GCname <- GCname[order(match(GCname, GC_order))]

estimates <- vector()
variances <- vector()
labels <- vector()
number <- vector()
QMdf <- vector()
Pdf <- vector()
GCdf <- vector()
for (a1 in unique(GCname)) {
  d3 <- subset(d2, GC == a1)
  
  if (length(unique(d3$Biomes)) > 1 &&
      nrow(d3) > length(unique(d3$Biomes))) {
    rr <- try(rma(yi,
                  vi,
                  mods =  ~ Biomes,
                  data = d3,
                  method = "REML"))
    QM <- rr$QM
    P <- rr$QMp
    QMdf <- c(QMdf, QM)
    Pdf <- c(Pdf, P)
  } else {
    QM <- NA
    P <- NA
    QMdf <- c(QMdf, QM)
    Pdf <- c(Pdf, P)
  }
  GC <- a1
  GCdf <- c(GCdf, GC)
  
  Biomename <- unique(d3$Biomes)
  Biomename <- Biomename[order(match(Biomename, Biome_order))]
  estimates1 <- vector()
  variances1 <- vector()
  labels1 <- vector()
  number1 <- vector()
  for (a2 in Biomename) {
    rr <- try(rma(yi, vi, data = subset(d3, Biomes == a2), method = "REML"))
    if ('try-error' %in% class(rr)) {
      rr <- NA
    }
    estimates2 <- try(coef(rr))
    if ('try-error' %in% class(estimates2)) {
      estimates2 <- NA
    }
    variances2 <- try(vcov(rr))
    if ('try-error' %in% class(variances2)) {
      variances2 <- NA
    }
    estimates1 <- c(estimates1, estimates2)
    variances1 <- c(variances1, variances2)
    labels2 <- paste0 (a1, ":", a2)
    labels1 <- c(labels1, labels2)
    aaa  = subset(d3, Biomes == a2)
    number2 = length(aaa$yi)
    number1 <- c(number1, number2)
  }
  estimates <- c(estimates, estimates1)
  variances <- c(variances, variances1)
  labels <- c(labels, labels1)
  number <- c(number, number1)
  number <- number[which(number != 0)]
  
}
QMdata <- data.frame(GC = GCdf, QM = QMdf, P = Pdf)

split_labels <- do.call(rbind, strsplit(labels, ":")) %>% as.data.frame()
colnames(split_labels) <- c("GCF", "Biomes")
result_data = data.frame(estimates, variances, split_labels, number)
result_data$CI_low = estimates - 1.96 * sqrt(variances)
result_data$CI_high = estimates + 1.96 * sqrt(variances)



plot_data <- result_data %>%
  mutate(
    type = case_when(
      GCF %in% c("N", "P", "K") ~ "Single Nutrient",
      GCF %in% c("eCO2", "W", "PPT+", "PPT-") ~ "Single Climate",
      GCF %in% c("N_P", "N_K", "P_K") ~ "Nutrient-Nutrient",
      GCF %in% c("eCO2_W", "W_PPT+", "W_PPT-", "eCO2_PPT-") ~ "Climate-Climate",
      GCF %in% c("eCO2_N", "W_N", "N_PPT+", "N_PPT-") ~ "Nutrient-Climate",
      GCF %in% c("eCO2_W_PPT-", "W_N_P", "N_P_K") ~ "Multi-Factor"
    )
  )

single_factors <- c("N", "P", "K", "eCO2", "W", "PPT+", "PPT-")
interaction_factors <- c(
  "N_P",
  "N_K",
  "P_K",
  "eCO2_N",
  "W_N",
  "N_PPT+",
  "N_PPT-",
  "eCO2_W",
  "eCO2_PPT-",
  "W_PPT+",
  "W_PPT-"
)
multi_factors <- c("N_P_K", "eCO2_W_PPT-", "W_N_P")
factor_levels <- c(single_factors, interaction_factors, multi_factors)
plot_data$GCF <- factor(plot_data$GCF, levels = rev(factor_levels))
plot_data$Biomes <- factor(plot_data$Biomes, levels = rev(Biome_order))

colors <- c(
  "Agriculture" = "#D13B95",
  "Forest" = "#1E3A5F",
  "Wetland" = "#7B5BA1",
  "Grassland" = "#075F0E",
  "Tundra" = "#1EF1FF",
  "Desert/Desert grassland" = "#F4A460"
)


plot_data <- merge(plot_data,
                   QMdata,
                   by.x = "GCF",
                   by.y = "GC",
                   all.x = TRUE)

# 找到每个GCF组的最大x坐标位置用于放置标签
label_data <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(GCF) %>%
  summarize(
    max_x = max(CI_high, na.rm = TRUE),
    QM = first(QM),
    P = first(P)
  ) %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(is.na(QM) | is.na(P), "", paste0(
    "QM = ",
    sprintf("%.2f", round(QM, 2)),
    "\n",
    ifelse(P < 0.001, "P < 0.001", paste0("P = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(
      P, 3
    ))))
  )))


background_data <- plot_data %>%
  distinct(GCF, type) %>%
  mutate(ymin = as.numeric(factor(GCF)) - 0.5, ymax = as.numeric(factor(GCF)) + 0.5)


type <- c(
  "Single Nutrient"   = "#075F0E",
  "Single Climate"    = "#7FE289",
  "Nutrient-Nutrient" = "#8B6508",
  "Nutrient-Climate"  = "#A0A32B",
  "Climate-Climate"   = "#D4B95A",
  "Multi-Factor"      = "#1f77b4"
)

# 修改ggplot代码
plant_plot <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(
  x = estimates,
  y = GCF,
  color = Biomes,
  shape = Biomes
)) +
  geom_rect(
    data = background_data,
    aes(
      ymin = ymin,
      ymax = ymax,
      xmin = -Inf,
      xmax = Inf,
      fill = type
    ),
    alpha = 0.1,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0,
             linetype = "13",
             color = "gray10") +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = CI_low, xmax = CI_high),
    height = 0,
    size = 0.5,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 1,
             alpha = 0.8,
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = CI_high, label = number),
    hjust = -0.5,
    size = 1.925,
    color = "black",
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  
  # 添加QM和P值标签
  geom_text(

  ) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = type) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Agriculture" = 0,
      "Forest" = 1,
      "Wetland" = 2,
      "Grassland" = 15,
      "Tundra" = 16,
      "Desert/Desert grassland" = 17
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(

  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Effect size",
    y = "Global change factor",
    color = "Factor Type",
    title = "Plant biomass"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 7, color = 'black'),

  ) +
  # 扩展x轴范围以容纳标签
```

```{r}
library(metafor)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

ddate <- read.csv("metadata.csv", header = T)
ddate <- ddate %>%
  mutate(
    Biomes = case_when(
      Biomes %in% c("Irrigated agriculture", "Rainfed agriculture") ~ "Agriculture",
      Biomes %in% c("Alpine grassland", "Temperate grassland") ~ "Grassland",
      Biomes %in% c("Desert grassland") ~ "Desert/Desert grassland",
      TRUE ~ Biomes  # 保持其他值不变
    )
  )
GC_order <- c(
  "eCO2",
  "W",
  "N",
  "P",
  "K",
  "PPT-",
  "PPT+",
  "eCO2_W",
  "eCO2_N",
  "eCO2_PPT-",
  "W_N",
  "W_PPT-",
  "W_PPT+",
  "N_P",
  "N_K",
  "P_K",
  "N_PPT-",
  "N_PPT+",
  "eCO2_W_PPT-",
  "W_N_P",
  "N_P_K"
)
GR_order <- c("Plant", "Microbe", "Bacteria", "Fungi", "AMF")
Biome_order <- c("Agriculture",
                 "Forest",
                 "Grassland",
                 "Desert/Desert grassland",
                 "Tundra",
                 "Wetland")
df = ddate[, 1:32]

df1 = cbind(df, ddate[, c("PlantRichness_yi", "PlantRichness_vi")])
names(df1)[names(df1) == "PlantRichness_yi"] <- "yi"
names(df1)[names(df1) == "PlantRichness_vi"] <- "vi"
df1$Group <- "Plant"

df2 = cbind(df, ddate[, c("PlantShannon_yi", "PlantShannon_vi")])
names(df2)[names(df2) == "PlantShannon_yi"] <- "yi"
names(df2)[names(df2) == "PlantShannon_vi"] <- "vi"
df2$Group <- "Plant"

ddf <- rbind(df1, df2)
d2 <- subset(ddf, !is.na(yi))
d2 <- subset(d2, vi > 0)

GCname <- unique(d2$GC)
GCname <- GCname[order(match(GCname, GC_order))]

estimates <- vector()
variances <- vector()
labels <- vector()
number <- vector()
QMdf <- vector()
Pdf <- vector()
GCdf <- vector()
for (a1 in unique(GCname)) {
  d3 <- subset(d2, GC == a1)
  
  if (length(unique(d3$Biomes)) > 1 &&
      nrow(d3) > length(unique(d3$Biomes))) {
    rr <- try(rma(yi,
                  vi,
                  mods =  ~ Biomes,
                  data = d3,
                  method = "REML"))
    QM <- rr$QM
    P <- rr$QMp
    QMdf <- c(QMdf, QM)
    Pdf <- c(Pdf, P)
  } else {
    QM <- NA
    P <- NA
    QMdf <- c(QMdf, QM)
    Pdf <- c(Pdf, P)
  }
  GC <- a1
  GCdf <- c(GCdf, GC)
  
  Biomename <- unique(d3$Biomes)
  Biomename <- Biomename[order(match(Biomename, Biome_order))]
  estimates1 <- vector()
  variances1 <- vector()
  labels1 <- vector()
  number1 <- vector()
  for (a2 in Biomename) {
    rr <- try(rma(yi, vi, data = subset(d3, Biomes == a2), method = "REML"))
    if ('try-error' %in% class(rr)) {
      rr <- NA
    }
    estimates2 <- try(coef(rr))
    if ('try-error' %in% class(estimates2)) {
      estimates2 <- NA
    }
    variances2 <- try(vcov(rr))
    if ('try-error' %in% class(variances2)) {
      variances2 <- NA
    }
    estimates1 <- c(estimates1, estimates2)
    variances1 <- c(variances1, variances2)
    labels2 <- paste0 (a1, ":", a2)
    labels1 <- c(labels1, labels2)
    aaa  = subset(d3, Biomes == a2)
    number2 = length(aaa$yi)
    number1 <- c(number1, number2)
  }
  estimates <- c(estimates, estimates1)
  variances <- c(variances, variances1)
  labels <- c(labels, labels1)
  number <- c(number, number1)
  number <- number[which(number != 0)]
  
}
QMdata <- data.frame(GC = GCdf, QM = QMdf, P = Pdf)

split_labels <- do.call(rbind, strsplit(labels, ":")) %>% as.data.frame()
colnames(split_labels) <- c("GCF", "Biomes")
result_data = data.frame(estimates, variances, split_labels, number)
result_data$CI_low = estimates - 1.96 * sqrt(variances)
result_data$CI_high = estimates + 1.96 * sqrt(variances)



plot_data <- result_data %>%
  mutate(
    type = case_when(
      GCF %in% c("N", "P", "K") ~ "Single Nutrient",
      GCF %in% c("eCO2", "W", "PPT+", "PPT-") ~ "Single Climate",
      GCF %in% c("N_P", "N_K", "P_K") ~ "Nutrient-Nutrient",
      GCF %in% c("eCO2_W", "W_PPT+", "W_PPT-", "eCO2_PPT-") ~ "Climate-Climate",
      GCF %in% c("eCO2_N", "W_N", "N_PPT+", "N_PPT-") ~ "Nutrient-Climate",
      GCF %in% c("eCO2_W_PPT-", "W_N_P", "N_P_K") ~ "Multi-Factor"
    )
  )

single_factors <- c("N", "P", "K", "eCO2", "W", "PPT+", "PPT-")
interaction_factors <- c(
  "N_P",
  "N_K",
  "P_K",
  "eCO2_N",
  "W_N",
  "N_PPT+",
  "N_PPT-",

)
multi_factors <- c("N_P_K", "eCO2_W_PPT-", "W_N_P")
factor_levels <- c(single_factors, interaction_factors, multi_factors)
plot_data$GCF <- factor(plot_data$GCF, levels = rev(factor_levels))
plot_data$Biomes <- factor(plot_data$Biomes, levels = rev(Biome_order))

colors <- c(
  "Agriculture" = "#D13B95",
  "Forest" = "#1E3A5F",
  "Wetland" = "#7B5BA1",
  "Grassland" = "#075F0E",
  "Tundra" = "#1EF1FF",
  "Desert/Desert grassland" = "#F4A460"
)

plot_data <- merge(plot_data,

# 找到每个GCF组的最大x坐标位置用于放置标签
label_data <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(GCF) %>%
  summarize(
    max_x = max(CI_high, na.rm = TRUE),
    QM = first(QM),

  ) %>%

    "\n",

    ))))
  )))


background_data <- plot_data %>%

  labs(

  ) +
```

```{r}
library(metafor)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

ddate <- read.csv("metadata.csv", header = T)
ddate <- ddate %>%
  mutate(
    Biomes = case_when(
      Biomes %in% c("Irrigated agriculture", "Rainfed agriculture") ~ "Agriculture",
      Biomes %in% c("Alpine grassland", "Temperate grassland") ~ "Grassland",
      Biomes %in% c("Desert grassland") ~ "Desert/Desert grassland",
      TRUE ~ Biomes  # 保持其他值不变
    )
  )
GC_order <- c(
  "eCO2",
  "W",
  "N",
  "P",
  "K",
  "PPT-",
  "PPT+",
  "eCO2_W",
  "eCO2_N",
  "eCO2_PPT-",
  "W_N",
  "W_PPT-",
  "W_PPT+",
  "N_P",
  "N_K",
  "P_K",
  "N_PPT-",
  "N_PPT+",
  "eCO2_W_PPT-",
  "W_N_P",
  "N_P_K"
)
GR_order <- c("Plant", "Microbe", "Bacteria", "Fungi", "AMF")
Biome_order <- c("Agriculture",
                 "Forest",
                 "Grassland",
                 "Desert/Desert grassland",
                 "Tundra",
                 "Wetland")
df = ddate[, 1:32]

df1 = cbind(df, ddate[, c("PlantStructure_yi", "PlantStructure_vi")])
names(df1)[names(df1) == "PlantStructure_yi"] <- "yi"
names(df1)[names(df1) == "PlantStructure_vi"] <- "vi"
df1$Group <- "Plant"

d2 <- subset(df1, !is.na(yi))
d2 <- subset(d2, vi > 0)

GCname <- unique(d2$GC)
GCname <- GCname[order(match(GCname, GC_order))]

estimates <- vector()
variances <- vector()
labels <- vector()
number <- vector()
QMdf <- vector()
Pdf <- vector()
GCdf <- vector()
for (a1 in unique(GCname)) {
  d3 <- subset(d2, GC == a1)
  
  if (length(unique(d3$Biomes)) > 1 &&
      nrow(d3) > length(unique(d3$Biomes))) {
    rr <- try(rma(yi,
                  vi,
                  mods =  ~ Biomes,
                  data = d3,
                  method = "REML"))
    QM <- rr$QM
    P <- rr$QMp
    QMdf <- c(QMdf, QM)
    Pdf <- c(Pdf, P)
  } else {
    QM <- NA
    P <- NA
    QMdf <- c(QMdf, QM)
    Pdf <- c(Pdf, P)
  }
  GC <- a1
  GCdf <- c(GCdf, GC)
  
  Biomename <- unique(d3$Biomes)
  Biomename <- Biomename[order(match(Biomename, Biome_order))]
  estimates1 <- vector()
  variances1 <- vector()
  labels1 <- vector()
  number1 <- vector()
  for (a2 in Biomename) {
    rr <- try(rma(yi, vi, data = subset(d3, Biomes == a2), method = "REML"))
    if ('try-error' %in% class(rr)) {
      rr <- NA
    }
    estimates2 <- try(coef(rr))
    if ('try-error' %in% class(estimates2)) {
      estimates2 <- NA
    }
    variances2 <- try(vcov(rr))
    if ('try-error' %in% class(variances2)) {
      variances2 <- NA
    }
    estimates1 <- c(estimates1, estimates2)
    variances1 <- c(variances1, variances2)
    labels2 <- paste0 (a1, ":", a2)
    labels1 <- c(labels1, labels2)
    aaa  = subset(d3, Biomes == a2)
    number2 = length(aaa$yi)
    number1 <- c(number1, number2)
  }
  estimates <- c(estimates, estimates1)
  variances <- c(variances, variances1)
  labels <- c(labels, labels1)
  number <- c(number, number1)
  number <- number[which(number != 0)]
  
}
QMdata <- data.frame(GC = GCdf, QM = QMdf, P = Pdf)

split_labels <- do.call(rbind, strsplit(labels, ":")) %>% as.data.frame()
colnames(split_labels) <- c("GCF", "Biomes")
result_data = data.frame(estimates, variances, split_labels, number)
result_data$CI_low = estimates - 1.96 * sqrt(variances)
result_data$CI_high = estimates + 1.96 * sqrt(variances)



plot_data <- result_data %>%
  mutate(
    type = case_when(
      GCF %in% c("N", "P", "K") ~ "Single Nutrient",
      GCF %in% c("eCO2", "W", "PPT+", "PPT-") ~ "Single Climate",
      GCF %in% c("N_P", "N_K", "P_K") ~ "Nutrient-Nutrient",
      GCF %in% c("eCO2_W", "W_PPT+", "W_PPT-", "eCO2_PPT-") ~ "Climate-Climate",
      GCF %in% c("eCO2_N", "W_N", "N_PPT+", "N_PPT-") ~ "Nutrient-Climate",
      GCF %in% c("eCO2_W_PPT-", "W_N_P", "N_P_K") ~ "Multi-Factor"
    )
  )

single_factors <- c("N", "P", "K", "eCO2", "W", "PPT+", "PPT-")
interaction_factors <- c(
  "N_P",
  "N_K",
  "P_K",
  "eCO2_N",
  "W_N",
  "N_PPT+",
  "N_PPT-",
  "eCO2_W",
  "eCO2_PPT-",
  "W_PPT+",
  "W_PPT-"
)
multi_factors <- c("N_P_K", "eCO2_W_PPT-", "W_N_P")
factor_levels <- c(single_factors, interaction_factors, multi_factors)
plot_data$GCF <- factor(plot_data$GCF, levels = rev(factor_levels))
plot_data$Biomes <- factor(plot_data$Biomes, levels = rev(Biome_order))

colors <- c(
  "Agriculture" = "#D13B95",
  "Forest" = "#1E3A5F",
  "Wetland" = "#7B5BA1",
  "Grassland" = "#075F0E",
  "Tundra" = "#1EF1FF",
  "Desert/Desert grassland" = "#F4A460"
)


plot_data <- merge(plot_data,
                   QMdata,
                   by.x = "GCF",
                   by.y = "GC",
                   all.x = TRUE)

# 找到每个GCF组的最大x坐标位置用于放置标签
label_data <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(GCF) %>%
  summarize(
    max_x = max(CI_high, na.rm = TRUE),
    QM = first(QM),
    P = first(P)
  ) %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(is.na(QM) | is.na(P), "", paste0(
    "QM = ",
    sprintf("%.2f", round(QM, 2)),
    "\n",
    ifelse(P < 0.001, "P < 0.001", paste0("P = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(
      P, 3
    ))))
  )))


background_data <- plot_data %>%
  distinct(GCF, type) %>%
  mutate(ymin = as.numeric(factor(GCF)) - 0.5, ymax = as.numeric(factor(GCF)) + 0.5)


type <- c(
  "Single Nutrient"   = "#075F0E",
  "Single Climate"    = "#7FE289",
  "Nutrient-Nutrient" = "#8B6508",
  "Nutrient-Climate"  = "#A0A32B",
  "Climate-Climate"   = "#D4B95A",
  "Multi-Factor"      = "#1f77b4"
)

# 修改ggplot代码
plant_plot <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(
  x = estimates,
  y = GCF,
  color = Biomes,
  shape = Biomes
)) +
  geom_rect(
    data = background_data,
    aes(
      ymin = ymin,
      ymax = ymax,
      xmin = -Inf,
      xmax = Inf,
      fill = type
    ),
    alpha = 0.1,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0,
             linetype = "13",
             color = "gray10") +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = CI_low, xmax = CI_high),
    height = 0,
    size = 0.5,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 1,
             alpha = 0.8,
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = CI_high, label = number),
    hjust = -0.5,
    size = 1.925,
    color = "black",
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  
  # 添加QM和P值标签
  geom_text(
    data = label_data,
    aes(x = 2, y = GCF, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 1.925,
    color = "black",
    hjust = 0.5
  ) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = type) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Agriculture" = 0,
      "Forest" = 1,
      "Wetland" = 2,
      "Grassland" = 15,
      "Tundra" = 16,
      "Desert/Desert grassland" = 17
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = function(x)
      gsub("_", "×", x)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Effect size",
    y = "Global change factor",
    color = "Factor Type",
    title = "Plant structure"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 7, color = 'black'),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 7, color = 'black'),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(size = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  # 扩展x轴范围以容纳标签
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-1.1, 2.2)) +
  guides(fill = "none")

print(plant_plot)

plot_data$y = "PlantStructure"
write.csv(plot_data, "plant_data_structure_biomes.csv")
```

```{r}

library(metafor)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

ddate <- read.csv("metadata.csv", header = T)
ddate <- ddate %>%
  mutate(
    Biomes = case_when(
      Biomes %in% c("Irrigated agriculture", "Rainfed agriculture") ~ "Agriculture",
      Biomes %in% c("Alpine grassland", "Temperate grassland") ~ "Grassland",
      Biomes %in% c("Desert grassland") ~ "Desert/Desert grassland",
      TRUE ~ Biomes  # 保持其他值不变
    )
  )
GC_order <- c(
  "eCO2",
  "W",
  "N",
  "P",
  "K",
  "PPT-",
  "PPT+",
  "eCO2_W",
  "eCO2_N",
  "eCO2_PPT-",
  "W_N",
  "W_PPT-",
  "W_PPT+",
  "N_P",
  "N_K",
  "P_K",
  "N_PPT-",
  "N_PPT+",
  "eCO2_W_PPT-",
  "W_N_P",
  "N_P_K"
)
GR_order <- c("Plant", "Microbe", "Bacteria", "Fungi", "AMF")
Biome_order <- c("Agriculture",
                 "Forest",
                 "Grassland",
                 "Desert/Desert grassland",
                 "Tundra",
                 "Wetland")
df = ddate[, 1:32]

df1 = cbind(df, ddate[, c("PlantBeta_yi", "PlantBeta_vi")])
names(df1)[names(df1) == "PlantBeta_yi"] <- "yi"
names(df1)[names(df1) == "PlantBeta_vi"] <- "vi"
df1$Group <- "Plant"

d2 <- subset(df1, !is.na(yi))
d2 <- subset(d2, vi > 0)

GCname <- unique(d2$GC)
GCname <- GCname[order(match(GCname, GC_order))]

estimates <- vector()
variances <- vector()
labels <- vector()
number <- vector()
QMdf <- vector()
Pdf <- vector()
GCdf <- vector()
for (a1 in unique(GCname)) {
  d3 <- subset(d2, GC == a1)
  
  if (length(unique(d3$Biomes)) > 1 &&
      nrow(d3) > length(unique(d3$Biomes))) {
    rr <- try(rma(yi,
                  vi,
                  mods =  ~ Biomes,
                  data = d3,
                  method = "REML"))
    QM <- rr$QM
    P <- rr$QMp
    QMdf <- c(QMdf, QM)
    Pdf <- c(Pdf, P)
  } else {
    QM <- NA
    P <- NA
    QMdf <- c(QMdf, QM)
    Pdf <- c(Pdf, P)
  }
  GC <- a1
  GCdf <- c(GCdf, GC)
  
  Biomename <- unique(d3$Biomes)
  Biomename <- Biomename[order(match(Biomename, Biome_order))]
  estimates1 <- vector()
  variances1 <- vector()
  labels1 <- vector()
  number1 <- vector()
  for (a2 in Biomename) {
    rr <- try(rma(yi, vi, data = subset(d3, Biomes == a2), method = "REML"))
    if ('try-error' %in% class(rr)) {
      rr <- NA
    }
    estimates2 <- try(coef(rr))
    if ('try-error' %in% class(estimates2)) {
      estimates2 <- NA
    }
    variances2 <- try(vcov(rr))
    if ('try-error' %in% class(variances2)) {
      variances2 <- NA
    }
    estimates1 <- c(estimates1, estimates2)
    variances1 <- c(variances1, variances2)
    labels2 <- paste0 (a1, ":", a2)
    labels1 <- c(labels1, labels2)
    aaa  = subset(d3, Biomes == a2)
    number2 = length(aaa$yi)
    number1 <- c(number1, number2)
  }
  estimates <- c(estimates, estimates1)
  variances <- c(variances, variances1)
  labels <- c(labels, labels1)
  number <- c(number, number1)
  number <- number[which(number != 0)]
  
}
QMdata <- data.frame(GC = GCdf, QM = QMdf, P = Pdf)

split_labels <- do.call(rbind, strsplit(labels, ":")) %>% as.data.frame()
colnames(split_labels) <- c("GCF", "Biomes")
result_data = data.frame(estimates, variances, split_labels, number)
result_data$CI_low = estimates - 1.96 * sqrt(variances)
result_data$CI_high = estimates + 1.96 * sqrt(variances)



plot_data <- result_data %>%
  mutate(
    type = case_when(
      GCF %in% c("N", "P", "K") ~ "Single Nutrient",
      GCF %in% c("eCO2", "W", "PPT+", "PPT-") ~ "Single Climate",
      GCF %in% c("N_P", "N_K", "P_K") ~ "Nutrient-Nutrient",
      GCF %in% c("eCO2_W", "W_PPT+", "W_PPT-", "eCO2_PPT-") ~ "Climate-Climate",
      GCF %in% c("eCO2_N", "W_N", "N_PPT+", "N_PPT-") ~ "Nutrient-Climate",
      GCF %in% c("eCO2_W_PPT-", "W_N_P", "N_P_K") ~ "Multi-Factor"
    )
  )

  "N_P",

factor_levels <- c(single_factors, interaction_factors, multi_factors)
plot_data$GCF <- factor(plot_data$GCF, levels = rev(factor_levels))
plot_data$Biomes <- factor(plot_data$Biomes, levels = rev(Biome_order))

colors <- c(
  "Agriculture" = "#D13B95",

label_data <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(GCF) %>%
  summarize(
    max_x = max(CI_high, na.rm = TRUE),
    QM = first(QM),
    P = first(P)
  ) %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(is.na(QM) | is.na(P), "", paste0(
    "QM = ",
    sprintf("%.2f", round(QM, 2)),
    "\n",
    ifelse(P < 0.001, "P < 0.001", paste0("P = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(
      P, 3
    ))))
  )))


background_data <- plot_data %>%
  distinct(GCF, type) %>%
  mutate(ymin = as.numeric(factor(GCF)) - 0.5, ymax = as.numeric(factor(GCF)) + 0.5)


type <- c(

  "Nutrient-Nutrient" = "#8B6508",

  "Climate-Climate"   = "#D4B95A",

)

# 修改ggplot代码
plant_plot <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(
  x = estimates,
  y = GCF,
  color = Biomes,
  shape = Biomes
)) +
  geom_rect(
    data = background_data,
    aes(
      ymin = ymin,
      ymax = ymax,
      xmin = -Inf,
      xmax = Inf,
      fill = type
    ),
    alpha = 0.1,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0,
             linetype = "13",
             color = "gray10") +

    aes(xmin = CI_low, xmax = CI_high),

    size = 0.5,

  ) +

             alpha = 0.8,
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = CI_high, label = number),
    hjust = -0.5,
    size = 1.925,
    color = "black",
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  
  # 添加QM和P值标签
  geom_text(
    data = label_data,

    size = 1.925,
    color = "black",

  ) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = type) +

    )
  ) +

  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Effect size",
    y = "Global change factor",

  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),

    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(size = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  # 扩展x轴范围以容纳标签
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-1.1, 1.9)) +
  guides(fill = "none")

for (a1 in unique(GCname)) {
  d3 <- subset(d2, GC == a1)
```
  
```{r}
  if (length(unique(d3$Group)) > 1 &&
      nrow(d3) > length(unique(d3$Group))) {
    rr <- try(rma(yi,
                  vi,
                  mods =  ~ Group,
                  data = d3,
                  method = "REML"))
    QM <- rr$QM
    P <- rr$QMp
    QMdf <- c(QMdf, QM)
    Pdf <- c(Pdf, P)
  } else {
    QM <- NA
    P <- NA
    QMdf <- c(QMdf, QM)

  }

      estimates2 <- NA
    }
    variances2 <- try(vcov(rr))

      variances2 <- NA
    }
    estimates1 <- c(estimates1, estimates2)
    variances1 <- c(variances1, variances2)
    labels2 <- paste0 (a1, ":", a2)
    labels1 <- c(labels1, labels2)
    aaa  = subset(d3, Group == a2)
    number2 = length(aaa$yi)
    number1 <- c(number1, number2)
  }
  estimates <- c(estimates, estimates1)
  variances <- c(variances, variances1)
  labels <- c(labels, labels1)
  number <- c(number, number1)
  number <- number[which(number != 0)]
  
}
```

#04 Interaction for Fig. 4ab and Figs. S15–S17
## Interaction calculation
### Calculation of plant richness and biomass interaction
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(metafor)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

# 读取数据
ddate <- read.csv("metadata.csv", header = TRUE)
ddate <- ddate[!ddate$GC %in% c("eCO2_W_PPT-", "W_N_P", "N_P_K"), ]
# 创建一个函数来处理每一行，生成新的标识符
create_new_id <- function(gc, mag1, freq1, mag2, freq2, mag3, freq3) {
  parts <- unlist(strsplit(gc, "_"))
  new_parts <- character(length(parts))
  
  for (i in seq_along(parts)) {
    if (i == 1 && !is.na(mag1)) {
      # 如果有频率数据，添加幅度和频率；否则只添加幅度
      if (!is.na(freq1)) {
        new_parts[i] <- paste0(parts[i], ":", mag1, "-", freq1)
      } else {
        new_parts[i] <- paste0(parts[i], ":", mag1)
      }
    } else if (i == 2 && !is.na(mag2)) {
      if (!is.na(freq2)) {
        new_parts[i] <- paste0(parts[i], ":", mag2, "-", freq2)
      } else {
        new_parts[i] <- paste0(parts[i], ":", mag2)
      }
    } else if (i == 3 && !is.na(mag3)) {
      if (!is.na(freq3)) {
        new_parts[i] <- paste0(parts[i], ":", mag3, "-", freq3)
      } else {
        new_parts[i] <- paste0(parts[i], ":", mag3)
      }
    } else {
      new_parts[i] <- parts[i]
    }
  }
  
  return(paste(new_parts, collapse = "_"))
}
# 应用函数到每一行，创建新列
ddate$GC_with_magnitude <- apply(ddate, 1, function(row) {
  create_new_id(
    row["GC"],
    as.numeric(row["Magnitude1"]),
    as.numeric(row["Frequency1"]),
    as.numeric(row["Magnitude2"]),
    as.numeric(row["Frequency2"]),
    as.numeric(row["Magnitude3"]),
    as.numeric(row["Frequency3"])
  )
})

# 定义处理组合
GC_order <- unique(ddate$GC_with_magnitude)
GC_order <- GC_order[grepl("_", GC_order)]
# 找出所有包含组合处理及其对应单独处理的ID
results <- list()
for (a1 in GC_order) {
  single_treatments <- unlist(strsplit(a1, "_"))
  combo_ids <- unique(ddate$ID_1[ddate$GC_with_magnitude == a1])
  
  valid_ids <- c()
  for (id in combo_ids) {
    id_treatments <- unique(ddate$GC_with_magnitude[ddate$ID_1 == id])
    if (all(single_treatments %in% id_treatments)) {
      valid_ids <- c(valid_ids, id)
    }
  }
  results[[a1]] <- valid_ids
}


for (n in c("PlantBiomass", "PlantRichness", "PlantShannon")) {
  # 创建一个数据框来存储所有效应量计算结果
  all_effects <- data.frame()
  
  # 对于每个组合处理及其对应的ID
  for (a1 in names(results)) {
    if (length(results[[a1]]) > 0) {
      for (I1 in results[[a1]]) {
        # 获取该ID的所有数据
        d1 <- subset(ddate, ID_1 == I1)
        
        # 提取组合处理的各个组成部分
        components <- unlist(strsplit(a1, "_"))
        n_factors <- length(components)
        
        # 提取各个单独处理的数据
        single_data <- list()
        for (comp in components) {
          single_data[[comp]] <- d1[d1$GC_with_magnitude == comp, ]
        }
        
        # 提取组合处理数据
        combo_data <- d1[d1$GC_with_magnitude == a1, ]
        
        # 检查所有必要的数据是否都存在
        if (all(sapply(single_data, nrow) > 0) &&
            nrow(combo_data) > 0) {
          # 动态构建列名
          c_mean_col <- paste0(n, "_C_Mean")
          c_sd_col <- paste0(n, "_C_SD")
          c_n_col <- paste0(n, "_C_N")
          t_mean_col <- paste0(n, "_T_Mean")
          t_sd_col <- paste0(n, "_T_SD")
          t_n_col <- paste0(n, "_T_N")
          
          # 提取对照组相关数据
          Xc <- combo_data[[c_mean_col]]
          Sc <- combo_data[[c_sd_col]]
          Nc <- combo_data[[c_n_col]]
          
          # 对于每个单独处理，提取相应的数据
          X_list <- list()
          S_list <- list()
          N_list <- list()
          
          for (i in seq_along(components)) {
            comp <- components[i]
            X_list[[comp]] <- single_data[[comp]][[t_mean_col]]
            S_list[[comp]] <- single_data[[comp]][[t_sd_col]]
            N_list[[comp]] <- single_data[[comp]][[t_n_col]]
          }
          
          # 提取组合处理的数据
          X_comb <- combo_data[[t_mean_col]]
          S_comb <- combo_data[[t_sd_col]]
          N_comb <- combo_data[[t_n_col]]
          
          # 计算合并标准差s和自由度m
          # 使用所有组的自由度加权平均
          N_values <- c(Nc, unlist(N_list), N_comb)
          m <- sum(N_values - 1)
          s_squared <- ((Nc - 1) * Sc^2 +
                          sum(sapply(seq_along(components), function(i)
                            (N_list[[i]] - 1) * S_list[[i]]^2)) +
                          (N_comb - 1) * S_comb^2) / m
          s <- sqrt(s_squared)
          
          # 计算校正因子J
          J <- 1 - 3 / (4 * m - 1)
          
          # 计算主效应和交互效应
          main_effects <- list()
          main_variances <- list()
          
          # 对于每个因素，计算主效应
          for (comp in components) {
            # 计算该因素的主效应
            # 公式: (该处理 + 交互处理 - 其他处理 - 对照) / (2s) * J
            
            # 获取其他因素
            other_comps <- components[components != comp]
            
            # 计算主效应
            d_main <- (X_list[[comp]] + X_comb - X_list[[other_comps]] - Xc) / (2 * s)
            d_main <- J * d_main
            
            # 计算主效应方差
            N_total <- Nc + N_list[[comp]] + N_list[[other_comps]] + N_comb
            v_main <- 1 / 4 * (1 / Nc + 1 / N_list[[comp]] + 1 / N_list[[other_comps]] + 1 /
                                 N_comb + d_main^2 / (2 * N_total))
            
            main_effects[[comp]] <- d_main
            main_variances[[comp]] <- v_main
          }
          
          # 计算交互效应dI
          # 对于多因素设计，交互效应的计算更加复杂
          dI <- (X_comb + Xc) - sum(sapply(X_list, function(x)
            x))
          dI <- J * dI / (2 * s)
          
          # 计算dI的方差
          N_total <- Nc + sum(unlist(N_list)) + N_comb
          vI <- 1 / 4 * (1 / Nc + sum(1 / unlist(N_list)) + 1 / N_comb + dI^2 /
                           (2 * N_total))
          
          # 将结果添加到数据框
          for (comp in components) {
            all_effects <- rbind(
              all_effects,
              data.frame(
                Combination = a1,
                ID = I1,
                Effect_Type = "Main",
                Factor = comp,
                d = main_effects[[comp]],
                v = main_variances[[comp]],
                stringsAsFactors = FALSE
              )
            )
          }
          
          all_effects <- rbind(
            all_effects,
            data.frame(
              Combination = a1,
              ID = I1,
              Effect_Type = "Interaction",
              Factor = paste(components, collapse = "_"),
              d = dI,
              v = vI,
              stringsAsFactors = FALSE
            )
          )
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  all_effects <- na.omit(all_effects)
  all_effects$group = n
  
  
  df <- all_effects
  
  # 计算95%置信区间
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(ci_lower = d - 1.96 * sqrt(v),
           ci_upper = d + 1.96 * sqrt(v))
  
  # 分离主效应和交互效应
  main_effects <- df %>%
    filter(Effect_Type == "Main") %>%
    select(Combination, ID, Factor, d, v, ci_lower, ci_upper)
  
  interaction_effects <- df %>%
    filter(Effect_Type == "Interaction") %>%
    select(
      Combination,
      ID,
      Factor,
      d_interaction = d,
      v_interaction = v,
      ci_lower_interaction = ci_lower,
      ci_upper_interaction = ci_upper
    )
  
  # 将主效应转换为宽格式，以便计算每个因子的效应
  main_effects_wide <- main_effects %>%
    group_by(Combination, ID) %>%
    mutate(factor_num = row_number()) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = factor_num,
      values_from = c(Factor, d, v, ci_lower, ci_upper),
      names_sep = "_"
    ) %>%
    rename(
      factor1 = Factor_1,
      factor2 = Factor_2,
      d1 = d_1,
      d2 = d_2,
      v1 = v_1,
      v2 = v_2
    )
  
  # 合并主效应和交互效应
  combined_data <- main_effects_wide %>%
    left_join(interaction_effects, by = c("Combination", "ID"))
  
  # 计算dA + dB的和
  combined_data <- combined_data %>%
    mutate(
      d_sum = d1 + d2,
      interaction_sign = sign(d_interaction),
      sum_sign = sign(d_sum)
    )
  
  # 判断交互作用类型
  combined_data <- combined_data %>%
    mutate(
      interaction_type = case_when(
        # 如果交互效应的CI包含0，则为加性效应
        ci_lower_interaction <= 0 &
          ci_upper_interaction >= 0 ~ "Additive",
        # 如果交互效应显著且与(dA+dB)符号相同，则为协同效应
        ci_lower_interaction > 0 |
          ci_upper_interaction < 0 &
          interaction_sign == sum_sign ~ "Synergistic",
        # 如果交互效应显著且与(dA+dB)符号相反，则为拮抗效应
        ci_lower_interaction > 0 |
          ci_upper_interaction < 0 &
          interaction_sign != sum_sign ~ "Antagonistic",
        TRUE ~ "Undetermined"
      )
    )
  
  combined_data <- combined_data %>%
    mutate(Combination = gsub(
      "[:][-]?\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?(?:-\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?)?",
      "",
      Combination
    ))
  
  write.csv(combined_data, paste0(n, "_interaction_df.csv"))
  
}
```

### Calculation of plant structure and beta interaction
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(metafor)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

# 读取数据
ddate <- read.csv("beta_plant.csv", header = TRUE)


# 定义处理组合
GC_order <- unique(ddate$GC)
GC_order <- GC_order[grepl("_", GC_order)]
# 找出所有包含组合处理及其对应单独处理的ID
results <- list()
for (a1 in GC_order) {
  single_treatments <- unlist(strsplit(a1, "_"))
  combo_ids <- unique(ddate$ID[ddate$GC == a1])
  
  valid_ids <- c()
  for (id in combo_ids) {
    id_treatments <- unique(ddate$GC[ddate$ID == id])
    if (all(single_treatments %in% id_treatments)) {
      valid_ids <- c(valid_ids, id)
    }
  }
  results[[a1]] <- valid_ids
}


for (n in c("PlantStructure", "PlantBeta")) {
  # 创建一个数据框来存储所有效应量计算结果
  all_effects <- data.frame()
  
  # 对于每个组合处理及其对应的ID
  for (a1 in names(results)) {
    if (length(results[[a1]]) > 0) {
      for (I1 in results[[a1]]) {
        # 获取该ID的所有数据
        d1 <- subset(ddate, ID == I1)
        
        # 提取组合处理的各个组成部分
        components <- unlist(strsplit(a1, "_"))
        n_factors <- length(components)
        
        # 提取各个单独处理的数据
        single_data <- list()
        for (comp in components) {
          single_data[[comp]] <- d1[d1$GC == comp, ]
        }
        
        # 提取组合处理数据
        combo_data <- d1[d1$GC == a1, ]
        
        # 检查所有必要的数据是否都存在
        if (all(sapply(single_data, nrow) > 0) &&
            nrow(combo_data) > 0) {
          # 动态构建列名
          c_mean_col <- paste0(n, "_C_Mean")
          c_sd_col <- paste0(n, "_C_SD")
          c_n_col <- paste0(n, "_C_N")
          t_mean_col <- paste0(n, "_T_Mean")
          t_sd_col <- paste0(n, "_T_SD")
          t_n_col <- paste0(n, "_T_N")
          
          # 提取对照组相关数据
          Xc <- combo_data[[c_mean_col]]
          Sc <- combo_data[[c_sd_col]]
          Nc <- combo_data[[c_n_col]]
          
          # 对于每个单独处理，提取相应的数据
          X_list <- list()
          S_list <- list()
          N_list <- list()
          
          for (i in seq_along(components)) {
            comp <- components[i]
            X_list[[comp]] <- single_data[[comp]][[t_mean_col]]
            S_list[[comp]] <- single_data[[comp]][[t_sd_col]]
            N_list[[comp]] <- single_data[[comp]][[t_n_col]]
          }
          
          # 提取组合处理的数据
          X_comb <- combo_data[[t_mean_col]]
          S_comb <- combo_data[[t_sd_col]]
          N_comb <- combo_data[[t_n_col]]
          
          # 计算合并标准差s和自由度m
          # 使用所有组的自由度加权平均
          N_values <- c(Nc, unlist(N_list), N_comb)
          m <- sum(N_values - 1)
          s_squared <- ((Nc - 1) * Sc^2 +
                          sum(sapply(seq_along(components), function(i)
                            (N_list[[i]] - 1) * S_list[[i]]^2)) +
                          (N_comb - 1) * S_comb^2) / m
          s <- sqrt(s_squared)
          
          # 计算校正因子J
          J <- 1 - 3 / (4 * m - 1)
          
          # 计算主效应和交互效应
          main_effects <- list()
          main_variances <- list()
          
          # 对于每个因素，计算主效应
          for (comp in components) {
            # 计算该因素的主效应
            # 公式: (该处理 + 交互处理 - 其他处理 - 对照) / (2s) * J
            
            # 获取其他因素
            other_comps <- components[components != comp]
            
            # 计算主效应
            d_main <- (X_list[[comp]] + X_comb - X_list[[other_comps]] - Xc) / (2 * s)
            d_main <- J * d_main
            
            # 计算主效应方差
            N_total <- Nc + N_list[[comp]] + N_list[[other_comps]] + N_comb
            v_main <- 1 / 4 * (1 / Nc + 1 / N_list[[comp]] + 1 / N_list[[other_comps]] + 1 /
                                 N_comb + d_main^2 / (2 * N_total))
            
            main_effects[[comp]] <- d_main
            main_variances[[comp]] <- v_main
          }
          
          # 计算交互效应dI
          # 对于多因素设计，交互效应的计算更加复杂
          dI <- (X_comb + Xc) - sum(sapply(X_list, function(x)
            x))
          dI <- J * dI / (2 * s)
          
          # 计算dI的方差
          N_total <- Nc + sum(unlist(N_list)) + N_comb
          vI <- 1 / 4 * (1 / Nc + sum(1 / unlist(N_list)) + 1 / N_comb + dI^2 /
                           (2 * N_total))
          
          # 将结果添加到数据框
          for (comp in components) {
            all_effects <- rbind(
              all_effects,
              data.frame(
                Combination = a1,
                ID = I1,
                Effect_Type = "Main",
                Factor = comp,
                d = main_effects[[comp]],
                v = main_variances[[comp]],
                stringsAsFactors = FALSE
              )
            )
          }
          
          all_effects <- rbind(
            all_effects,
            data.frame(
              Combination = a1,
              ID = I1,
              Effect_Type = "Interaction",
              Factor = paste(components, collapse = "_"),
              d = dI,
              v = vI,
              stringsAsFactors = FALSE
            )
          )
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  all_effects <- na.omit(all_effects)
  all_effects$group = n
  
  
  df <- all_effects
  
  # 计算95%置信区间
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(ci_lower = d - 1.96 * sqrt(v),
           ci_upper = d + 1.96 * sqrt(v))
  
  # 分离主效应和交互效应
  main_effects <- df %>%
    filter(Effect_Type == "Main") %>%
    select(Combination, ID, Factor, d, v, ci_lower, ci_upper)
  
  interaction_effects <- df %>%
    filter(Effect_Type == "Interaction") %>%
    select(
      Combination,
      ID,
      Factor,
      d_interaction = d,
      v_interaction = v,
      ci_lower_interaction = ci_lower,
      ci_upper_interaction = ci_upper
    )
  
  # 将主效应转换为宽格式，以便计算每个因子的效应
  main_effects_wide <- main_effects %>%
    group_by(Combination, ID) %>%
    mutate(factor_num = row_number()) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = factor_num,
      values_from = c(Factor, d, v, ci_lower, ci_upper),
      names_sep = "_"
    ) %>%
    rename(
      factor1 = Factor_1,
      factor2 = Factor_2,
      d1 = d_1,
      d2 = d_2,
      v1 = v_1,
      v2 = v_2
    )
  
  # 合并主效应和交互效应
  combined_data <- main_effects_wide %>%
    left_join(interaction_effects, by = c("Combination", "ID"))
  
  # 计算dA + dB的和
  combined_data <- combined_data %>%
    mutate(
      d_sum = d1 + d2,
      interaction_sign = sign(d_interaction),
      sum_sign = sign(d_sum)
    )
  
  # 判断交互作用类型
  combined_data <- combined_data %>%
    mutate(
      interaction_type = case_when(
        # 如果交互效应的CI包含0，则为加性效应
        ci_lower_interaction <= 0 &
          ci_upper_interaction >= 0 ~ "Additive",
        # 如果交互效应显著且与(dA+dB)符号相同，则为协同效应
        ci_lower_interaction > 0 |
          ci_upper_interaction < 0 &
          interaction_sign == sum_sign ~ "Synergistic",
        # 如果交互效应显著且与(dA+dB)符号相反，则为拮抗效应
        ci_lower_interaction > 0 |
          ci_upper_interaction < 0 &
          interaction_sign != sum_sign ~ "Antagonistic",
        TRUE ~ "Undetermined"
      )
    )
  
  combined_data <- combined_data %>%
    mutate(Combination = gsub(
      "[:][-]?\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?(?:-\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?)?",
      "",
      Combination
    ))
  
  write.csv(combined_data, paste0(n, "_interaction_df.csv"))
  
}
```

### Calculation of microbial richness and biomass interaction算
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# 读取数据
metadf <- read.csv("metadata.csv", header = TRUE)
metadf <- metadf[!metadf$GC %in% c("eCO2_W_PPT-", "W_N_P", "N_P_K"), ]

# 选择标识列
id_cols <- colnames(metadf[, 1:32])

# 定义微生物组和测量类型
microbial_groups <- c("ALL", "Bacteria", "Fungi", "AMF")
measure_types <- c("Richness", "Shannon", "Biomass")

# 创建要转换的列名列表
cols_to_pivot <- c()
for (group in microbial_groups) {
  for (measure in measure_types) {
    prefix <- ifelse(
      group == "ALL",
      paste0("ALL_Microbial", measure),
      paste0(group, "_Microbial", measure)
    )
    cols_to_pivot <- c(
      cols_to_pivot,
      paste0(prefix, "_C_Mean"),
      paste0(prefix, "_C_SD"),
      paste0(prefix, "_C_N"),
      paste0(prefix, "_T_Mean"),
      paste0(prefix, "_T_SD"),
      paste0(prefix, "_T_N")
    )
  }
}

# 转换数据 - 保持测量类型作为单独的列
long_data <- metadf %>%
  select(all_of(id_cols), all_of(cols_to_pivot)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -all_of(id_cols),
    names_to = c("Group", "Measurement", "Variable", "Stat"),
    names_pattern = "(ALL|Bacteria|Fungi|AMF)_Microbial(.*)_(C|T)_(Mean|SD|N)",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = c("ALL", "Bacteria", "Fungi", "AMF"))) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = c("Variable", "Stat", "Measurement"),
    names_glue = "Microbial{Measurement}_{Variable}_{Stat}",
    values_from = "Value"
  )

Microbedf <- long_data


for (g in unique(Microbedf$Group)) {
  ddate <- subset(Microbedf, Group == g)
  # 创建一个函数来处理每一行，生成新的标识符
  create_new_id <- function(gc, mag1, freq1, mag2, freq2, mag3, freq3) {
    parts <- unlist(strsplit(gc, "_"))
    new_parts <- character(length(parts))
    
    for (i in seq_along(parts)) {
      if (i == 1 && !is.na(mag1)) {
        # 如果有频率数据，添加幅度和频率；否则只添加幅度
        if (!is.na(freq1)) {
          new_parts[i] <- paste0(parts[i], ":", mag1, ":", freq1)
        } else {
          new_parts[i] <- paste0(parts[i], ":", mag1)
        }
      } else if (i == 2 && !is.na(mag2)) {
        if (!is.na(freq2)) {
          new_parts[i] <- paste0(parts[i], ":", mag2, ":", freq2)
        } else {
          new_parts[i] <- paste0(parts[i], ":", mag2)
        }
      } else if (i == 3 && !is.na(mag3)) {
        if (!is.na(freq3)) {
          new_parts[i] <- paste0(parts[i], ":", mag3, ":", freq3)
        } else {
          new_parts[i] <- paste0(parts[i], ":", mag3)
        }
      } else {
        new_parts[i] <- parts[i]
      }
    }
    
    return(paste(new_parts, collapse = "_"))
  }
  # 应用函数到每一行，创建新列
  ddate$GC_with_magnitude <- apply(ddate, 1, function(row) {
    create_new_id(
      row["GC"],
      as.numeric(row["Magnitude1"]),
      as.numeric(row["Frequency1"]),
      as.numeric(row["Magnitude2"]),
      as.numeric(row["Frequency2"]),
      as.numeric(row["Magnitude3"]),
      as.numeric(row["Frequency3"])
    )
  })
  
  # 定义处理组合
  GC_order <- unique(ddate$GC_with_magnitude)
  GC_order <- GC_order[grepl("_", GC_order)]
  # 找出所有包含组合处理及其对应单独处理的ID
  results <- list()
  for (a1 in GC_order) {
    single_treatments <- unlist(strsplit(a1, "_"))
    combo_ids <- unique(ddate$ID_1[ddate$GC_with_magnitude == a1])
    
    valid_ids <- c()
    for (id in combo_ids) {
      id_treatments <- unique(ddate$GC_with_magnitude[ddate$ID_1 == id])
      if (all(single_treatments %in% id_treatments)) {
        valid_ids <- c(valid_ids, id)
      }
    }
    results[[a1]] <- valid_ids
  }
  
  
  for (n in c("MicrobialBiomass",
              "MicrobialRichness",
              "MicrobialShannon")) {
    # 创建一个数据框来存储所有效应量计算结果
    all_effects <- data.frame()
    
    # 对于每个组合处理及其对应的ID
    for (a1 in names(results)) {
      if (length(results[[a1]]) > 0) {

          components <- unlist(strsplit(a1, "_"))
          n_factors <- length(components)
          
          # 提取各个单独处理的数据
          single_data <- list()
          for (comp in components) {
            single_data[[comp]] <- d1[d1$GC_with_magnitude == comp, ]
          }
          
          # 提取组合处理数据
          combo_data <- d1[d1$GC_with_magnitude == a1, ]
          
          # 检查所有必要的数据是否都存在
          if (all(sapply(single_data, nrow) > 0) &&
              nrow(combo_data) > 0) {
            # 动态构建列名
            c_mean_col <- paste0(n, "_C_Mean")
            c_sd_col <- paste0(n, "_C_SD")
            c_n_col <- paste0(n, "_C_N")
            t_mean_col <- paste0(n, "_T_Mean")
            t_sd_col <- paste0(n, "_T_SD")
            t_n_col <- paste0(n, "_T_N")
            
            # 提取对照组相关数据
            Xc <- combo_data[[c_mean_col]]
            Sc <- combo_data[[c_sd_col]]
            Nc <- combo_data[[c_n_col]]
            
            # 对于每个单独处理，提取相应的数据
```
