```{r}
              S_list[[comp]] <- single_data[[comp]][[t_sd_col]]
              N_list[[comp]] <- single_data[[comp]][[t_n_col]]
            }
            
            # 提取组合处理的数据
            X_comb <- combo_data[[t_mean_col]]
            S_comb <- combo_data[[t_sd_col]]
            N_comb <- combo_data[[t_n_col]]
            
            # 计算合并标准差s和自由度m
            # 使用所有组的自由度加权平均
            N_values <- c(Nc, unlist(N_list), N_comb)
            m <- sum(N_values - 1)
            s_squared <- ((Nc - 1) * Sc^2 +
                            sum(sapply(seq_along(components), function(i)
                              (N_list[[i]] - 1) * S_list[[i]]^2)) +
                            (N_comb - 1) * S_comb^2) / m
            s <- sqrt(s_squared)
            
            # 计算校正因子J
            J <- 1 - 3 / (4 * m - 1)
            
            # 计算主效应和交互效应
            main_effects <- list()
            main_variances <- list()
            
            # 对于每个因素，计算主效应
            for (comp in components) {

              # 计算主效应

                                   N_comb + d_main^2 / (2 * N_total))

              x))

            N_total <- Nc + sum(unlist(N_list)) + N_comb
            vI <- 1 / 4 * (1 / Nc + sum(1 / unlist(N_list)) + 1 / N_comb + dI^2 /
                             (2 * N_total))
            
            # 将结果添加到数据框
            for (comp in components) {

              )
            )
          }
        }
      }
    }
    
    all_effects <- na.omit(all_effects)
    
    if (nrow(all_effects) == 0) {
      print(paste0(g, "_", n, "无数据"))
    } else {
      all_effects$group = n
      
      
      df <- all_effects
      
      # 计算95%置信区间
      df <- df %>%

          Combination = gsub(
            "[:][-]?\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?(?:-\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?)?",
```

```{r}
          # 获取该ID的所有数据
          d1 <- subset(ddate, ID == I1)
          
          # 提取组合处理的各个组成部分
          components <- unlist(strsplit(a1, "_"))
          n_factors <- length(components)
          
          # 提取各个单独处理的数据
          single_data <- list()
          for (comp in components) {
            single_data[[comp]] <- d1[d1$GC == comp, ]
          }
          
          # 提取组合处理数据
          combo_data <- d1[d1$GC == a1, ]
          
          # 检查所有必要的数据是否都存在
          if (all(sapply(single_data, nrow) > 0) &&
              nrow(combo_data) > 0) {
            # 动态构建列名
            c_mean_col <- paste0(n, "_C_Mean")
            c_sd_col <- paste0(n, "_C_SD")
            c_n_col <- paste0(n, "_C_N")
            t_mean_col <- paste0(n, "_T_Mean")
            t_sd_col <- paste0(n, "_T_SD")
            t_n_col <- paste0(n, "_T_N")
            
            # 提取对照组相关数据
            Xc <- combo_data[[c_mean_col]]
            Sc <- combo_data[[c_sd_col]]
            Nc <- combo_data[[c_n_col]]
            
            # 对于每个单独处理，提取相应的数据
            X_list <- list()
            S_list <- list()
            N_list <- list()
            
            for (i in seq_along(components)) {
              comp <- components[i]
              X_list[[comp]] <- single_data[[comp]][[t_mean_col]]
              S_list[[comp]] <- single_data[[comp]][[t_sd_col]]
              N_list[[comp]] <- single_data[[comp]][[t_n_col]]
            }
            
            # 提取组合处理的数据
            X_comb <- combo_data[[t_mean_col]]
            S_comb <- combo_data[[t_sd_col]]
            N_comb <- combo_data[[t_n_col]]
            
            # 计算合并标准差s和自由度m
            # 使用所有组的自由度加权平均
            N_values <- c(Nc, unlist(N_list), N_comb)
            m <- sum(N_values - 1)
            s_squared <- ((Nc - 1) * Sc^2 +
                            sum(sapply(seq_along(components), function(i)
                              (N_list[[i]] - 1) * S_list[[i]]^2)) +
                            (N_comb - 1) * S_comb^2) / m
            s <- sqrt(s_squared)
            
            # 计算校正因子J
            J <- 1 - 3 / (4 * m - 1)
            
            # 计算主效应和交互效应
            main_effects <- list()
            main_variances <- list()
            
            # 对于每个因素，计算主效应
            for (comp in components) {
              # 计算该因素的主效应
              # 公式: (该处理 + 交互处理 - 其他处理 - 对照) / (2s) * J
              
              # 获取其他因素
              other_comps <- components[components != comp]
              
              # 计算主效应
              d_main <- (X_list[[comp]] + X_comb - X_list[[other_comps]] - Xc) / (2 * s)
              d_main <- J * d_main
              
              # 计算主效应方差
              N_total <- Nc + N_list[[comp]] + N_list[[other_comps]] + N_comb
              v_main <- 1 / 4 * (1 / Nc + 1 / N_list[[comp]] + 1 / N_list[[other_comps]] + 1 /
                                   N_comb + d_main^2 / (2 * N_total))
              
              main_effects[[comp]] <- d_main
              main_variances[[comp]] <- v_main
            }
            
            # 计算交互效应dI
            # 对于多因素设计，交互效应的计算更加复杂
            dI <- (X_comb + Xc) - sum(sapply(X_list, function(x)
              x))
            dI <- J * dI / (2 * s)
            
            # 计算dI的方差
            N_total <- Nc + sum(unlist(N_list)) + N_comb
            vI <- 1 / 4 * (1 / Nc + sum(1 / unlist(N_list)) + 1 / N_comb + dI^2 /
                             (2 * N_total))
            
            # 将结果添加到数据框
            for (comp in components) {
              all_effects <- rbind(
                all_effects,
                data.frame(
                  Combination = a1,
                  ID = I1,
                  Effect_Type = "Main",
                  Factor = comp,
                  d = main_effects[[comp]],
                  v = main_variances[[comp]],
                  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
                )
              )
            }
            
            all_effects <- rbind(
              all_effects,
              data.frame(
                Combination = a1,
                ID = I1,
                Effect_Type = "Interaction",
                Factor = paste(components, collapse = "_"),
                d = dI,
                v = vI,
                stringsAsFactors = FALSE
              )
            )
          }
        }
      }
    }
    
    all_effects <- na.omit(all_effects)
    all_effects$group = n
    
    
    df <- all_effects
    
    # 计算95%置信区间
    df <- df %>%
      mutate(ci_lower = d - 1.96 * sqrt(v),
             ci_upper = d + 1.96 * sqrt(v))
    
    # 分离主效应和交互效应
    main_effects <- df %>%
      filter(Effect_Type == "Main") %>%
      select(Combination, ID, Factor, d, v, ci_lower, ci_upper)
    
    interaction_effects <- df %>%
      filter(Effect_Type == "Interaction") %>%
      select(
        Combination,
        ID,
        Factor,
        d_interaction = d,
        v_interaction = v,
        ci_lower_interaction = ci_lower,
        ci_upper_interaction = ci_upper
      )
    
    # 将主效应转换为宽格式，以便计算每个因子的效应
    main_effects_wide <- main_effects %>%
      group_by(Combination, ID) %>%
      mutate(factor_num = row_number()) %>%
      pivot_wider(
        names_from = factor_num,
        values_from = c(Factor, d, v, ci_lower, ci_upper),
        names_sep = "_"
      ) %>%
      rename(
        factor1 = Factor_1,
        factor2 = Factor_2,
        d1 = d_1,
        d2 = d_2,
        v1 = v_1,
        v2 = v_2
      )
    
    # 合并主效应和交互效应
    combined_data <- main_effects_wide %>%
      left_join(interaction_effects, by = c("Combination", "ID"))
    
    # 计算dA + dB的和
    combined_data <- combined_data %>%
      mutate(
        d_sum = d1 + d2,
        interaction_sign = sign(d_interaction),
        sum_sign = sign(d_sum)
      )
    
    # 判断交互作用类型
    combined_data <- combined_data %>%
      mutate(
        interaction_type = case_when(
          # 如果交互效应的CI包含0，则为加性效应
          ci_lower_interaction <= 0 &
            ci_upper_interaction >= 0 ~ "Additive",
          # 如果交互效应显著且与(dA+dB)符号相同，则为协同效应
          ci_lower_interaction > 0 |
            ci_upper_interaction < 0 &
            interaction_sign == sum_sign ~ "Synergistic",
          # 如果交互效应显著且与(dA+dB)符号相反，则为拮抗效应
          ci_lower_interaction > 0 |
            ci_upper_interaction < 0 &
            interaction_sign != sum_sign ~ "Antagonistic",
          TRUE ~ "Undetermined"
        )
      )
    
    combined_data <- combined_data %>%
      mutate(
        Combination = gsub(
          "[:][-]?\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?(?:-\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?)?",
          "",
          Combination
        )
      )
    
    write.csv(combined_data, paste0(g, "_", n, "_interaction_df.csv"))
    
  }
}

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

ddate <- read.csv("PlantBiomass_interaction_df.csv", row.names = 1)

  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
  mutate(percentage = count / sum(count) * 100)

# 计算每个组合中每个类型的累积百分比，用于确定标签位置
type_summary <- type_summary %>%
  group_by(Combination) %>%
  arrange(desc(interaction_type)) %>%
  mutate(cum_percent = cumsum(percentage),

  "P_K",

  "W_N",
  "N_PPT+",

  "eCO2_W",
```

### Interaction plots of biomass and diversity
```{r}



# 加载必要的包
library(metafor)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(boot)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
interaction_data <- read.csv("PlantBiomass_interaction_df.csv", row.names = 1)
# 按Combination分组计算累积效应值（随机效应模型）
comb_results <- interaction_data %>%
  group_by(Combination) %>%
  group_modify( ~ {
    if (nrow(.) == 1) {
      # 直接使用该研究的效应值和1.96倍标准误计算置信区间
      data.frame(
        k = 1,
        d_pooled = .$d1[1],
        ci_lower = .$d1[1] - 1.96 * .$v1[1],
        ci_upper = .$d1[1] + 1.96 * .$v1[1],
        method = "Single study (1.96 SE)"
      )
    }
    # 如果该组合的研究数量少于10个，使用自助抽样
    if (nrow(.) > 1 && nrow(.) < 10) {
      # 自助抽样1000次
      boot_results <- boot::boot(
        .,
        statistic = function(data, indices) {
          res <- rma(
            yi = d_interaction,
            vi = v_interaction,
            data = data[indices, ],
            method = "HE"
          )
          return(res$b[1])
        },
        R = 1000
      )
      
      # 计算自助抽样置信区间
      boot_ci <- boot::boot.ci(boot_results, type = "perc")
      
      data.frame(
        k = nrow(.),
        d_pooled = boot_results$t0,
        ci_lower = boot_ci$percent[4],
        ci_upper = boot_ci$percent[5],
        method = "Bootstrap REML"
      )
    } else {
      # 对于有10个或以上研究的组合，使用标准随机效应模型
      res <- rma(
        yi = d_interaction,
        vi = v_interaction,
        data = .,
        method = "HE"
      )
      
      data.frame(
        k = nrow(.),
        d_pooled = res$b[1],
        ci_lower = res$ci.lb,
        ci_upper = res$ci.ub,
        method = "Standard REML"
      )
    }
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

# 查看结果

ddate1 <- read.csv("All_MicrobialBiomass_interaction_df.csv", row.names = 1)
ddate2 <- read.csv("Bacteria_MicrobialBiomass_interaction_df.csv", row.names = 1)
ddate3 <- read.csv("Fungi_MicrobialBiomass_interaction_df.csv", row.names = 1)
ddate4 <- read.csv("AMF_MicrobialBiomass_interaction_df.csv", row.names = 1)
interaction_data <- rbind(ddate1, ddate2, ddate3, ddate4)

# 按Combination分组计算累积效应值（随机效应模型）
comb_results <- interaction_data %>%
  group_by(Combination) %>%
  group_modify( ~ {
    if (nrow(.) == 1) {
      # 直接使用该研究的效应值和1.96倍标准误计算置信区间
      data.frame(
        k = 1,
        d_pooled = .$d1[1],
        ci_lower = .$d1[1] - 1.96 * .$v1[1],
        ci_upper = .$d1[1] + 1.96 * .$v1[1],
        method = "Single study (1.96 SE)"
      )
    }
    # 如果该组合的研究数量少于10个，使用自助抽样
    if (nrow(.) > 1 && nrow(.) < 10) {
      # 自助抽样1000次
      boot_results <- boot::boot(
        .,
        statistic = function(data, indices) {
          res <- rma(
            yi = d_interaction,
            vi = v_interaction,
            data = data[indices, ],
            method = "HE"
          )
          return(res$b[1])
        },
        R = 1000
      )
      
      # 计算自助抽样置信区间
      boot_ci <- boot::boot.ci(boot_results, type = "perc")
      
      data.frame(
        k = nrow(.),
        d_pooled = boot_results$t0,
        ci_lower = boot_ci$percent[4],
        ci_upper = boot_ci$percent[5],
        method = "Bootstrap REML"
      )
    } else {
      # 对于有10个或以上研究的组合，使用标准随机效应模型
      res <- rma(
        yi = d_interaction,
        vi = v_interaction,
        data = .,
        method = "HE"
      )
      
      data.frame(
        k = nrow(.),
        d_pooled = res$b[1],
        ci_lower = res$ci.lb,
        ci_upper = res$ci.ub,
        method = "Standard REML"
      )
    }
  }) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
# 加载必要的包
library(metafor)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(boot)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)

interaction_data <- read.csv("PlantStructure_interaction_df.csv", row.names = 1)
interaction_data$Combination <- gsub("(?<!CO)\\d", "", interaction_data$Combination, perl = TRUE)
# 按Combination分组计算累积效应值（随机效应模型）
comb_results <- interaction_data %>%
  group_by(Combination) %>%
  group_modify( ~ {
    if (nrow(.) == 1) {
      # 直接使用该研究的效应值和1.96倍标准误计算置信区间
      data.frame(
        k = 1,
        d_pooled = .$d1[1],
        ci_lower = .$d1[1] - 1.96 * .$v1[1],
        ci_upper = .$d1[1] + 1.96 * .$v1[1],
        method = "Single study (1.96 SE)"
      )
    }
    # 如果该组合的研究数量少于10个，使用自助抽样
    if (nrow(.) > 1 && nrow(.) < 10) {
      # 自助抽样1000次
      boot_results <- boot::boot(
        .,
        statistic = function(data, indices) {
          res <- rma(
            yi = d_interaction,
            vi = v_interaction,
            data = data[indices, ],
            method = "HE"
          )
          return(res$b[1])
        },
        R = 1000
      )
      
      # 计算自助抽样置信区间
      boot_ci <- boot::boot.ci(boot_results, type = "perc")
      
      data.frame(
        k = nrow(.),
        d_pooled = boot_results$t0,
        ci_lower = boot_ci$percent[4],
        ci_upper = boot_ci$percent[5],
        method = "Bootstrap REML"
      )
    } else {
      # 对于有10个或以上研究的组合，使用标准随机效应模型
      res <- rma(
        yi = d_interaction,
        vi = v_interaction,
        data = .,
        method = "HE"
      )
      
      data.frame(
        k = nrow(.),
        d_pooled = res$b[1],
        ci_lower = res$ci.lb,
        ci_upper = res$ci.ub,
        method = "Standard REML"
      )
    }
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

# 查看结果

d1_results$effect_type <- "Factor1"
d2_results <- comb_results2

interaction_results <- comb_results

# 合并所有结果

  mutate(effect_type = factor(effect_type, levels = c("Factor1", "Factor2", "Interaction")))
all_results1 <- subset(all_results1, effect_type == "Interaction")
combination_order <- c(
  "N_P",
  "N_K",
  "P_K",
  "eCO2_N",
  "W_N",
  "N_PPT+",
  "N_PPT-",
  "eCO2_W",
  "eCO2_PPT-",
  "W_PPT+",
  "W_PPT-"
)

# 将Combination转换为因子并按照指定顺序排序
all_results1$Combination <- factor(all_results1$Combination, levels = rev(combination_order))

# 创建森林图
structure_plot1 <- ggplot(all_results1,
                          aes(
                            x = d_pooled,
                            y = Combination,
                            color = effect_type,
                            shape = effect_type
                          )) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0,
             linetype = "13",
             color = "gray10") +
  geom_point(size = 1,
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
             alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = ci_lower, xmax = ci_upper),
    height = 0.2,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
    size = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = ci_upper, label = k),
    hjust = -0.5,
    size = 2.1,
    color = "black",
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Hedges'dAB",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Plant structure",
    color = "Effect Type",
    shape = "Effect Type"
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = function(x)
      gsub("_", "×", x)
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(
      fill = NA,
      colour = 'black',
      size = 0.6
    ),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 7, color = 'black'),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 7, color = 'black'),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
    axis.ticks.y = element_line(size = 0.5),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(size = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Factor1" = "#AAB8AB",
      "Factor2" = "#A08887",
      "Interaction" = "gray70"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "Factor1" = "Factor 1 Main Effect",
      "Factor2" = "Factor 2 Main Effect",
      "Interaction" = "Interaction Effect"
    )
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Factor1" = 16,
      "Factor2" = 17,
      "Interaction" = 15
    ),
    labels = c(
      "Factor1" = "Factor 1 Main Effect",
      "Factor2" = "Factor 2 Main Effect",
      "Interaction" = "Interaction Effect"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-0.8, 0.8))

    if (nrow(.) > 1 && nrow(.) < 10) {

        .,
        statistic = function(data, indices) {
          res <- rma(
            yi = d2,
            vi = v2,
            data = data[indices, ],
            method = "HE"
          )
          return(res$b[1])
        },
        R = 1000
      )
      
      # 计算自助抽样置信区间
      boot_ci <- boot::boot.ci(boot_results, type = "perc")
      
      data.frame(
        k = nrow(.),
        d_pooled = boot_results$t0,
        ci_lower = boot_ci$percent[4],
        ci_upper = boot_ci$percent[5],
        method = "Bootstrap REML"
      )
    } else {
      # 对于有10个或以上研究的组合，使用标准随机效应模型
      res <- rma(
        yi = d2,
        vi = v2,
        data = .,
        method = "HE"
      )
      
      data.frame(
        k = nrow(.),
        d_pooled = res$b[1],
        ci_lower = res$ci.lb,
        ci_upper = res$ci.ub,
        method = "Standard REML"
      )
    }
  }) %>%
  ungroup()
```

#05 Factor analysis interpretation for Figs. 4cd and S18
## Data preprocessing
### Treatment intensity
```{r}
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(metafor)
library(dplyr)
ddate<-read.csv("metadata.csv",header = T)
df <- ddate %>%
  mutate(
  ) %>%
  separate(GC, c("GC1", "GC2", "GC3"), "_", remove = FALSE, fill = "right")
# 第一步：将数据转换为长格式
long_df <- df %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(GC1, GC2, GC3),
    names_to = "GC_position",
    values_to = "GC_type",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Magnitude = case_when(
      GC_position == "GC1" ~ Magnitude1,
      GC_position == "GC2" ~ Magnitude2,
      GC_position == "GC3" ~ Magnitude3
    )
  ) %>%
  select(row_id, GC, GC_type, Magnitude)

# 第二步：按处理类型分别标准化
scaled_df <- long_df %>%
  group_by(GC_type) %>%
  mutate(
    scaled_Magnitude = scale(Magnitude)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 第三步：转换回宽格式
final_df <- scaled_df %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = row_id,
    names_from = GC_type,
    values_from = scaled_Magnitude,
    values_fn = list(scaled_Magnitude = mean)  # 处理重复值
  ) %>%
  # 合并回原始数据
  right_join(df %>% mutate(row_id = row_number()), by = "row_id") %>%
  mutate(
    Magnitude1 = ifelse(!is.na(GC1), 
                        coalesce(
                          case_when(
                            GC1 == "eCO2" ~ eCO2,
                            GC1 == "N" ~ N,
                            GC1 == "P" ~ P,
                            GC1 == "K" ~ K,
                            GC1 == "W" ~ W,
                            GC1 == "PPT-" ~ `PPT-`,
                            GC1 == "PPT+" ~ `PPT+`,
                            TRUE ~ NA_real_
                          ), Magnitude1),
                        Magnitude1),
    
    Magnitude2 = ifelse(!is.na(GC2), 
                        coalesce(
                          case_when(
                            GC2 == "eCO2" ~ eCO2,
                            GC2 == "N" ~ N,
                            GC2 == "P" ~ P,
                            GC2 == "K" ~ K,
                            GC2 == "W" ~ W,
                            GC2 == "PPT-" ~ `PPT-`,
                            GC2 == "PPT+" ~ `PPT+`,
                            TRUE ~ NA_real_
                          ), Magnitude2),
                        Magnitude2),
    
    Magnitude3 = ifelse(!is.na(GC3), 
                        coalesce(
                          case_when(
                            GC3 == "eCO2" ~ eCO2,
                            GC3 == "N" ~ N,
                            GC3 == "P" ~ P,
                            GC3 == "K" ~ K,
                            GC3 == "W" ~ W,
                            GC3 == "PPT-" ~ `PPT-`,
                            GC3 == "PPT+" ~ `PPT+`,
                            TRUE ~ NA_real_
                          ), Magnitude3),
                        Magnitude3)
  ) %>%
  # 删除临时列
  select(-row_id, -eCO2, -N, -P, -K, -W, -`PPT-`, -`PPT+`)

write.csv(final_df, "meta_factor.csv")
```


## Factor analysis interpretation
### Plant biomass
```{r}
library(metaforest)
library(caret)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(ggrepel)
library(parallel)
library(doParallel)
library(dplyr)

ddate <- read.csv( "/node5/hzh/projects/Meta_analysis/above_below_ground/meta_factor/meta_factor.csv", row.names = 1)

ddate$Magnitude <- rowMeans(ddate[, c("Magnitude1", "Magnitude2", "Magnitude3")], na.rm = TRUE)
ddate <- ddate %>%
  mutate(GCnumber = case_when(
    !is.na(GC1) & !is.na(GC2) & !is.na(GC3) ~ 3,
    !is.na(GC1) & !is.na(GC2) & is.na(GC3) ~ 2,
    !is.na(GC1) & is.na(GC2) & is.na(GC3) ~ 1,
    TRUE ~ 0  # 其他情况（如GC1为NA）
  ))

df = ddate[,c(1:35,245:256)]

df1 = cbind(df,ddate[,c("PlantBiomass_yi","PlantBiomass_vi")])
names(df1)[names(df1) == "PlantBiomass_yi"] <- "yi"
names(df1)[names(df1) == "PlantBiomass_vi"] <- "vi"
df1$Diversity_type <- "Biomass"

ddf <- df1

mydata <-subset(ddf,!is.na(yi)) 


moderators <- c("MAP","MAT","Biomes","GC","GCnumber","Magnitude","Duration","pH_yi","Moisture_yi","SoilC_yi","SoilN_yi")
set.seed(123)
# 检查需要多少棵树才能收敛
check_conv <- MetaForest(as.formula(paste0("yi~", paste(moderators, collapse = "+"))),
                         data = mydata,
                         whichweights = "random",
                         num.trees = 1000)#10000
save(check_conv, file = "check_conv.RData")

# 执行递归预选
set.seed(123)
pre <- preselect(check_conv, replications = 100, algorithm = "recursive")#100
pre.p <- plot(pre)
save(pre, file = "pre.RData")

# 设置10折交叉验证
set.seed(123)
cv_folds <- trainControl(method = "cv", 10, allowParallel = TRUE)

# 设置参数调优网格
tuning_grid <- expand.grid(whichweights = c("random"),
                           mtry = 2:6,
                           min.node.size = 2:6)

# 选择预选变量和vi
X <- dplyr::select(mydata, "vi", preselect_vars(pre, cutoff = .95))

# 训练模型
registerDoParallel(10) # 并行计算，使用10个核心
set.seed(123)
mf_cv <- train(y = mydata$yi,
               x = X,
               method = ModelInfo_mf(),
               trControl = cv_folds,
               tuneGrid = tuning_grid,
               keep.inbag = TRUE,
               num.threads = 10,
               verbose = TRUE,
               num.trees = 1000)#10000

# 保存模型
saveRDS(mf_cv, "mf_cv_model.RData")

# 检查结果
mf_cv
mf_cv$results[which.min(mf_cv$results$RMSE), ]
# 交叉验证R²
mf_cv$results[which.min(mf_cv$results$RMSE), ]$Rsquared

# 提取最终模型
final_model <- mf_cv$finalModel

# 绘制收敛图
plot(final_model)

# OOB R²
final_model$forest$r.squared
saveRDS(final_model, "final_model.RData")
# 变量重要性
importance.export <- varImp(mf_cv)$importance
write.csv(importance.export, "variable_importance.csv")

```

```{r}
  mutate(GCnumber = case_when(
```

```{r}
    !is.na(GC1) & !is.na(GC2) & is.na(GC3) ~ 2,
    !is.na(GC1) & is.na(GC2) & is.na(GC3) ~ 1,
    TRUE ~ 0  # 其他情况（如GC1为NA）
  ))

df = ddate[,c(1:35,245:256)]

df2 = cbind(df,ddate[,c("ALL_MicrobialBeta_yi","ALL_MicrobialBeta_vi")])
names(df2)[names(df2) == "ALL_MicrobialBeta_yi"] <- "yi"
names(df2)[names(df2) == "ALL_MicrobialBeta_vi"] <- "vi"
df2$Group <- "Microbe"
df2$Diversity_type <- "Beta"

df3 = cbind(df,ddate[,c("Bacteria_MicrobialBeta_yi","Bacteria_MicrobialBeta_vi")])
names(df3)[names(df3) == "Bacteria_MicrobialBeta_yi"] <- "yi"
names(df3)[names(df3) == "Bacteria_MicrobialBeta_vi"] <- "vi"
df3$Group <- "Bacteria"
df3$Diversity_type <- "Beta"

df4 = cbind(df,ddate[,c("Fungi_MicrobialBeta_yi","Fungi_MicrobialBeta_vi")])
names(df4)[names(df4) == "Fungi_MicrobialBeta_yi"] <- "yi"
names(df4)[names(df4) == "Fungi_MicrobialBeta_vi"] <- "vi"
df4$Group <- "Fungi"
df4$Diversity_type <- "Beta"

df5 = cbind(df,ddate[,c("AMF_MicrobialBeta_yi","AMF_MicrobialBeta_vi")])
names(df5)[names(df5) == "AMF_MicrobialBeta_yi"] <- "yi"
names(df5)[names(df5) == "AMF_MicrobialBeta_vi"] <- "vi"
df5$Group <- "AMF"
df5$Diversity_type <- "Beta"

ddf <- rbind(df2,df3,df4,df5)

mydata <-subset(ddf,!is.na(yi)) 


moderators <- c("MAP","MAT","Biomes","GC","GCnumber","Magnitude","Duration","Group","pH_yi","Moisture_yi","SoilC_yi","SoilN_yi")
set.seed(123)
# 检查需要多少棵树才能收敛
check_conv <- MetaForest(as.formula(paste0("yi~", paste(moderators, collapse = "+"))),
                         data = mydata,
                         whichweights = "random",
                         num.trees = 1000)#10000
save(check_conv, file = "check_conv.RData")

# 执行递归预选
set.seed(123)
pre <- preselect(check_conv, replications = 100, algorithm = "recursive")#100
pre.p <- plot(pre)
save(pre, file = "pre.RData")

# 设置10折交叉验证
set.seed(123)
cv_folds <- trainControl(method = "cv", 10, allowParallel = TRUE)

# 设置参数调优网格
tuning_grid <- expand.grid(whichweights = c("random"),
                           mtry = 2:6,
                           min.node.size = 2:6)

# 选择预选变量和vi
X <- dplyr::select(mydata, "vi", preselect_vars(pre, cutoff = .95))

# 训练模型
registerDoParallel(10) # 并行计算，使用10个核心
set.seed(123)
mf_cv <- train(y = mydata$yi,
               x = X,
               method = ModelInfo_mf(),
               trControl = cv_folds,
               tuneGrid = tuning_grid,
               keep.inbag = TRUE,
               num.threads = 10,
               verbose = TRUE,
               num.trees = 1000)#10000

# 保存模型
saveRDS(mf_cv, "mf_cv_model.RData")

# 检查结果
mf_cv
mf_cv$results[which.min(mf_cv$results$RMSE), ]
# 交叉验证R²
mf_cv$results[which.min(mf_cv$results$RMSE), ]$Rsquared

# 提取最终模型
final_model <- mf_cv$finalModel

# 绘制收敛图
plot(final_model)

# OOB R²
final_model$forest$r.squared
saveRDS(final_model, "final_model.RData")
# 变量重要性
importance.export <- varImp(mf_cv)$importance
write.csv(importance.export, "variable_importance.csv")

```

#06 Biodiversity–productivity relationship for Fig. 2 and Figs. S9–S12
## Overall biodiversity–productivity relationship
### Plant biodiversity–productivity relationship
```{r}
library(lme4)
library(sjPlot)
library(cowplot)
library(dplyr)
library(metafor)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
ddate <- read.csv("meta_factor.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)
ddate$Magnitude <- rowMeans(ddate[, c("Magnitude1", "Magnitude2", "Magnitude3")], na.rm = TRUE)
ddate <- ddate %>%
  mutate(
    GCnumber = case_when(
      !is.na(GC1) & !is.na(GC2) & !is.na(GC3) ~ 3,
      !is.na(GC1) &
        !is.na(GC2) & is.na(GC3) ~ 2,
      !is.na(GC1) &
        is.na(GC2) & is.na(GC3) ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0  # 其他情况（如GC1为NA）
    )
  )

df = ddate[, c(1:35, 245:256)]
ddf1 = cbind(df, ddate[, c("PlantBiomass_yi",
                           "PlantBiomass_vi",
                           "PlantRichness_yi",
                           "PlantRichness_vi")])
df1 <- ddf1
names(df1)[names(df1) == "PlantRichness_yi"] <- "PlantDiversity_yi"
names(df1)[names(df1) == "PlantRichness_vi"] <- "PlantDiversity_vi"

ddf2 = cbind(df, ddate[, c("PlantBiomass_yi",
                           "PlantBiomass_vi",
                           "PlantShannon_yi",
                           "PlantShannon_vi")])
df2 <- ddf2
names(df2)[names(df2) == "PlantShannon_yi"] <- "PlantDiversity_yi"
names(df2)[names(df2) == "PlantShannon_vi"] <- "PlantDiversity_vi"

ddf <- rbind(df1, df2)

ddf <- subset(ddf, !is.na(PlantBiomass_yi))
ddf <- subset(ddf, !is.na(PlantDiversity_yi))

Q1_bio <- quantile(ddf$PlantBiomass_yi, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
Q3_bio <- quantile(ddf$PlantBiomass_yi, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
IQR_bio <- Q3_bio - Q1_bio
ddf <- ddf[ddf$PlantBiomass_yi >= (Q1_bio - 3 * IQR_bio) &
             ddf$PlantBiomass_yi <= (Q3_bio + 3 * IQR_bio), ]

Q1_div <- quantile(ddf$PlantDiversity_yi, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
Q3_div <- quantile(ddf$PlantDiversity_yi, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
IQR_div <- Q3_div - Q1_div
ddf <- ddf[ddf$PlantDiversity_yi >= (Q1_div - 3 * IQR_div) &
             ddf$PlantDiversity_yi <= (Q3_div + 3 * IQR_div), ]

ddf <- ddf %>%
  mutate(
    type = case_when(
      GC %in% c("N", "P", "K") ~ "Single nutrient",
      GC %in% c("eCO2", "W", "PPT+", "PPT-") ~ "Single climate",
      GC %in% c("N_P", "N_K", "P_K") ~ "Nutrient-nutrient",
      GC %in% c("eCO2_W", "W_PPT+", "W_PPT-", "eCO2_PPT-") ~ "Climate-climate",
      GC %in% c("eCO2_N", "W_N", "N_PPT+", "N_PPT-") ~ "Nutrient-climate",
      GC %in% c("eCO2_W_PPT-", "W_N_P", "N_P_K") ~ "Multi-factor"
    )
  )

GCname <- c("Single nutrient",
            "Single climate",
            "Nutrient-nutrient",
            "Nutrient-climate")

for (g in GCname) {
  dda <- subset(ddf, type == g)
  dda$BubbleSize <- 1
  Weight <- 1 / sqrt(dda$PlantBiomass_vi)
  Breaks <- quantile(Weight, c(0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
  selectIDs <- which(Weight < Breaks[1])
  dda$BubbleSize <- 1
  for (i in seq(2, length(Breaks))) {
    selectIDs <- which((Weight < Breaks[i]) & (Weight >= Breaks[i - 1]))
    dda$BubbleSize[selectIDs] <- 1 + (i - 1) * 0.5
  }
  
  # 拟合模型
  mixed.lmer <- rma.mv(
    yi = PlantBiomass_yi,
    V = PlantBiomass_vi,
    mods = ~ PlantDiversity_yi,
    random = list(~ 1 | GC, ~ 1 | Biomes / ID),
    control = list(iter.max = 1000, rel.tol = 1e-8),
    data = dda
  )
  
  # 生成预测数据
  tempX <- seq(
    min(dda$PlantDiversity_yi, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(dda$PlantDiversity_yi, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 100
  )
  pred.mm <- data.frame(tempX, predict(mixed.lmer, newmods = tempX))
  pred.mm <- pred.mm[, c('tempX', 'pred', 'ci.ub', 'ci.lb')]
  slope <- mixed.lmer$beta[2]
  p <- mixed.lmer$pval[2]
  
  if (p < 0.001) {
    p_values <- paste0('Slope = ', round(slope, 3), ', P < 0.001, n = ', nrow(dda))
  } else if (p < 0.1) {
    p_values <- paste0('Slope = ',
                       round(slope, 3),
                       ', P = ',
                       sprintf('%0.3f', p),
                       ', n = ',
                       nrow(dda))
  } else {
    p_values <- paste0('P = ', sprintf('%0.3f', p), ', n = ', nrow(dda))
  }
  
  # 创建标签数据（简化版）
  label <- data.frame(p_values = p_values,
                      x = -Inf,
                      y = Inf)
  
  # 绘制图形
  P <- ggplot() +
    geom_point(
      data = dda,
      aes(x = PlantDiversity_yi, y = PlantBiomass_yi),
      size = dda$BubbleSize,
      alpha = 0.5,
      col = 'grey40'
    ) +
    
    geom_line(data = pred.mm, aes(x = tempX, y = pred), size = 0.6) +
    geom_text(
      data = label,
      aes(label = p_values, x = x, y = y),
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 2.35
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "black",
      size = 0.3
    ) +
    # 添加y=0的虚线
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "black",
      size = 0.3
    ) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(
        fill = NA,
        colour = 'black',
        size = 0.6
      ),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = '#FFFFFF'),
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 8,
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 7, color = 'black'),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 7, color = 'black'),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
      axis.ticks.y = element_line(size = 0.5),
      axis.ticks.x = element_line(size = 0.5),
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    ylab('RR of plant biomass') +
    xlab('RR of plant diversity') +
    labs(title = paste0(g))
  
  print(P)
  
}

```

```{r}
library(lme4)
library(sjPlot)

ddate <- read.csv("meta_factor.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)

ddate <- ddate %>%
  mutate(
    GCnumber = case_when(
      !is.na(GC1) & !is.na(GC2) & !is.na(GC3) ~ 3,!is.na(GC1) &
        !is.na(GC2) & is.na(GC3) ~ 2,!is.na(GC1) &
        is.na(GC2) & is.na(GC3) ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0  # 其他情况（如GC1为NA）
    )
  )

df = ddate[, c(1:35, 245:256)]
ddf1 = cbind(df, ddate[, c("PlantBiomass_yi",
                           "PlantBiomass_vi",
                           "PlantRichness_yi",
                           "PlantRichness_vi")])
df1 <- ddf1
names(df1)[names(df1) == "PlantRichness_yi"] <- "PlantDiversity_yi"
names(df1)[names(df1) == "PlantRichness_vi"] <- "PlantDiversity_vi"

ddf2 = cbind(df, ddate[, c("PlantBiomass_yi",
                           "PlantBiomass_vi",
                           "PlantShannon_yi",
                           "PlantShannon_vi")])
df2 <- ddf2
names(df2)[names(df2) == "PlantShannon_yi"] <- "PlantDiversity_yi"
names(df2)[names(df2) == "PlantShannon_vi"] <- "PlantDiversity_vi"

ddf <- rbind(df1, df2)

ddf <- subset(ddf, !is.na(PlantBiomass_yi))
ddf <- subset(ddf, !is.na(PlantDiversity_yi))

Q1_bio <- quantile(ddf$PlantBiomass_yi, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
Q3_bio <- quantile(ddf$PlantBiomass_yi, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
IQR_bio <- Q3_bio - Q1_bio
ddf <- ddf[ddf$PlantBiomass_yi >= (Q1_bio - 3 * IQR_bio) &
             ddf$PlantBiomass_yi <= (Q3_bio + 3 * IQR_bio), ]

Q1_div <- quantile(ddf$PlantDiversity_yi, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
Q3_div <- quantile(ddf$PlantDiversity_yi, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
IQR_div <- Q3_div - Q1_div
ddf <- ddf[ddf$PlantDiversity_yi >= (Q1_div - 3 * IQR_div) &
             ddf$PlantDiversity_yi <= (Q3_div + 3 * IQR_div), ]

ddf <- ddf %>%
  mutate(
    type = case_when(
      GC %in% c("N", "P", "K") ~ "Single nutrient",
      GC %in% c("eCO2", "W", "PPT+", "PPT-") ~ "Single climate",
      GC %in% c("N_P", "N_K", "P_K") ~ "Nutrient-nutrient",
      GC %in% c("eCO2_W", "W_PPT+", "W_PPT-", "eCO2_PPT-") ~ "Climate-climate",
      GC %in% c("eCO2_N", "W_N", "N_PPT+", "N_PPT-") ~ "Nutrient-climate",
      GC %in% c("eCO2_W_PPT-", "W_N_P", "N_P_K") ~ "Multi-factor"
    )
  )

GCname <- c("Single nutrient",
            "Single climate",
            "Nutrient-nutrient",
            "Nutrient-climate")


for (g in GCname) {
  dda <- subset(ddf, type == g)
  # 拟合模型
  mixed.lmer <- rma.mv(
    yi = PlantBiomass_yi,
    V = PlantBiomass_vi,
    mods = ~ PlantDiversity_yi + PlantDiversity_yi:Duration + PlantDiversity_yi:Magnitude,
    random = list( ~ 1 | GC, ~ 1 | Biomes / ID),
    control = list(iter.max = 1000, rel.tol = 1e-8),
    data = dda
  )
  
  # 提取模型结果
  model_results <- data.frame(
    estimate = mixed.lmer$b,
    se = mixed.lmer$se,
    zval = mixed.lmer$zval,
    pval = mixed.lmer$pval,
    ci.lb = mixed.lmer$ci.lb,
    ci.ub = mixed.lmer$ci.ub
  )
  rownames(model_results) <- c(
    "Intercept",
    "PlantDiversity",
    "PlantDiversity:Duration",
    "PlantDiversity:Magnitude"
  )
  
  ##==== 绘制交互效应图 ====##
  
  # 绘制 Duration 交互效应
  x1 <- seq(0, 1, 0.01)
  y1 <- model_results$estimate[3] * x1
  ploy1 <- data.frame(
    x = c(0, 1, 1, 0),
    y = c(0, model_results$ci.lb[3] * 1, model_results$ci.ub[3] * 1, 0)
  )
  lines1 <- ifelse(model_results$pval[3] < 0.05, 1, 2)
  
  # 绘制 Magnitude 交互效应
  x2 <- seq(0, 1, 0.01)
  y2 <- model_results$estimate[4] * x2
  ploy2 <- data.frame(
    x = c(0, 1, 1, 0),
    y = c(0, model_results$ci.lb[4] * 1, model_results$ci.ub[4] * 1, 0)
  )
  lines2 <- ifelse(model_results$pval[4] < 0.05, 1, 2)
  
  
  
  # 创建第一个图（Duration）
  p1 <- ggplot() +
    geom_polygon(
      data = ploy1,
      aes(x = x, y = y),
      fill = 'grey60',
      alpha = 0.3
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0,
               col = '#9d2933',
               size = 0.5) +
    geom_line(
      data = data.frame(x = x1, y = y1),
      aes(x = x, y = y),
      linetype = lines1,
      size = 0.5
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1), expand = c(0, 0.01)) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      label = paste0('Duration\n', 'P = ', round(model_results$pval[3], 4)),
      x = -Inf,
      y = Inf,
      hjust = -0.1,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 4.7
    ) +
    theme(
      #panel.grid = element_blank(),
      #panel.border = element_rect(fill=NA, colour='black', size=1),
      #panel.background = element_rect(fill='#FFFFFF'),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 14, color = 'black'),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14, color = 'black'),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      # 去掉 y 轴刻度线
      axis.ticks.x = element_line(size = 0.5),
      # 让 x 轴刻度线更细
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    labs(x = "", y = NULL)
  
  # 创建第二个图（Magnitude）
  p2 <- ggplot() +
    geom_polygon(
      data = ploy2,
      aes(x = x, y = y),
      fill = 'black',
      alpha = 0.3
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0,
               col = '#9d2933',
               size = 0.5) +
    geom_line(
      data = data.frame(x = x2, y = y2),
      aes(x = x, y = y),
      linetype = lines2,
      size = 0.5
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1), expand = c(0, 0.01)) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      label = paste0('Intensity\n', 'P = ', round(model_results$pval[4], 4)),
      x = -Inf,
      y = Inf,
      hjust = -0.1,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 4.7
    ) +
    theme(
      #panel.grid = element_blank(),
      #panel.border = element_rect(fill=NA, colour='black', size=1),
      #panel.background = element_rect(fill='#FFFFFF'),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 14, color = 'black'),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14, color = 'black'),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      # 去掉 y 轴刻度线
      axis.ticks.x = element_line(size = 0.5),
      # 让 x 轴刻度线更细
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    labs(x = "", y = NULL)
  
  # 使用patchwork组合图形
  tight_theme <- theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, "cm"))
  # 应用到两个图上
  p1 <- p1 + tight_theme
  p2 <- p2 + tight_theme
  
  combined <- p1 / p2 +
    plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1))
  
  combined <- ggdraw(combined) +
    draw_label(
      "Effects on relationships",
      x = 0.02,
      y = 0.5,
      angle = 90,
      size = 14
    )
  combined
  
}
```

```{r}
    geom_point(
      data = dda,
      aes(x = MicrobialDiversity_yi, y = MicrobialBiomass_yi),
      size = dda$BubbleSize,
      alpha = 0.5,
      col = 'grey40'
    ) +
    
    geom_line(data = pred.mm, aes(x = tempX, y = pred), size = 0.6) +
    geom_text(
      data = label,
      aes(label = p_values, x = x, y = y),
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 2.35
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "black",
      size = 0.3
    ) +
    # 添加y=0的虚线
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "black",
      size = 0.3
    ) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(
        fill = NA,
        colour = 'black',
        size = 0.6
      ),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = '#FFFFFF'),
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 8,
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 7, color = 'black'),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 7, color = 'black'),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
      axis.ticks.y = element_line(size = 0.5),
      axis.ticks.x = element_line(size = 0.5),
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    ylab('RR of microbial biomass') +
    xlab('RR of microbial diversity')  +
    labs(title = paste0(g))
  
  print(P)
  
}
```

```{r}
names(df41)[names(df41) == "AMF_MicrobialShannon_vi"] <- "MicrobialDiversity_vi"

ddf <- rbind(df1, df2, df3, df4, df11, df21, df31, df41)

ddf <- subset(ddf, !is.na(MicrobialBiomass_yi))
ddf <- subset(ddf, !is.na(MicrobialDiversity_yi))

             ddf$MicrobialBiomass_yi <= (Q3_bio + 3 * IQR_bio), ]

Q1_div <- quantile(ddf$MicrobialDiversity_yi, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
Q3_div <- quantile(ddf$MicrobialDiversity_yi, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
IQR_div <- Q3_div - Q1_div
ddf <- ddf[ddf$MicrobialDiversity_yi >= (Q1_div - 3 * IQR_div) &
             ddf$MicrobialDiversity_yi <= (Q3_div + 3 * IQR_div), ]

ddf <- ddf %>%
  mutate(
    type = case_when(
      GC %in% c("N", "P", "K") ~ "Single nutrient",
      GC %in% c("eCO2", "W", "PPT+", "PPT-") ~ "Single climate",
      GC %in% c("N_P", "N_K", "P_K") ~ "Nutrient-nutrient",
      GC %in% c("eCO2_W", "W_PPT+", "W_PPT-", "eCO2_PPT-") ~ "Climate-climate",
      GC %in% c("eCO2_N", "W_N", "N_PPT+", "N_PPT-") ~ "Nutrient-climate",
      GC %in% c("eCO2_W_PPT-", "W_N_P", "N_P_K") ~ "Multi-factor"
    )
  )

GCname <- c("Single nutrient",
            "Single climate",
            "Nutrient-nutrient",
            "Nutrient-climate")


for (g in GCname) {
  dda <- subset(ddf, type == g)
  # 拟合模型
  mixed.lmer <- rma.mv(
    yi = MicrobialBiomass_yi,
    V = MicrobialBiomass_vi,
    mods = ~ MicrobialDiversity_yi + MicrobialDiversity_yi:Duration + MicrobialDiversity_yi:Magnitude,
    random = list( ~ 1 | GC, ~ 1 | Biomes / ID),
    control = list(iter.max = 1000, rel.tol = 1e-8),
    data = dda
  )
  
  # 提取模型结果
  model_results <- data.frame(
    estimate = mixed.lmer$b,
    se = mixed.lmer$se,
    zval = mixed.lmer$zval,
    pval = mixed.lmer$pval,
    ci.lb = mixed.lmer$ci.lb,
    ci.ub = mixed.lmer$ci.ub
  )
  rownames(model_results) <- c(
    "Intercept",
    "MicrobialDiversity",
    "MicrobialDiversity:Duration",
    "MicrobialDiversity:Magnitude"
  )
  
  ##==== 绘制交互效应图 ====##
  
  # 绘制 Duration 交互效应
  x1 <- seq(0, 1, 0.01)
  y1 <- model_results$estimate[3] * x1
  ploy1 <- data.frame(
    x = c(0, 1, 1, 0),
    y = c(0, model_results$ci.lb[3] * 1, model_results$ci.ub[3] * 1, 0)
  )
  lines1 <- ifelse(model_results$pval[3] < 0.05, 1, 2)
  
  # 绘制 Magnitude 交互效应
  x2 <- seq(0, 1, 0.01)
  y2 <- model_results$estimate[4] * x2
  ploy2 <- data.frame(
    x = c(0, 1, 1, 0),
    y = c(0, model_results$ci.lb[4] * 1, model_results$ci.ub[4] * 1, 0)
  )
  lines2 <- ifelse(model_results$pval[4] < 0.05, 1, 2)
  
  
  
  # 创建第一个图（Duration）
  p1 <- ggplot() +
    geom_polygon(
      data = ploy1,
      aes(x = x, y = y),
      fill = 'grey60',
      alpha = 0.3
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0,
               col = '#9d2933',
               size = 0.5) +
    geom_line(
      data = data.frame(x = x1, y = y1),
      aes(x = x, y = y),
      linetype = lines1,
      size = 0.5
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1), expand = c(0, 0.01)) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      label = paste0('Duration\n', 'P = ', round(model_results$pval[3], 4)),
      x = -Inf,
      y = Inf,
      hjust = -0.1,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 4.7
    ) +
    theme(
      #panel.grid = element_blank(),
      #panel.border = element_rect(fill=NA, colour='black', size=1),
      #panel.background = element_rect(fill='#FFFFFF'),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 14, color = 'black'),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14, color = 'black'),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      # 去掉 y 轴刻度线
      axis.ticks.x = element_line(size = 0.5),
      # 让 x 轴刻度线更细
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    labs(x = "", y = NULL)
  
  # 创建第二个图（Magnitude）
  p2 <- ggplot() +
    geom_polygon(
      data = ploy2,
      aes(x = x, y = y),
      fill = 'black',
      alpha = 0.3
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0,
               col = '#9d2933',
               size = 0.5) +
    geom_line(
      data = data.frame(x = x2, y = y2),
      aes(x = x, y = y),
      linetype = lines2,
      size = 0.5
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1), expand = c(0, 0.01)) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      label = paste0('Intensity\n', 'P = ', round(model_results$pval[4], 4)),
      x = -Inf,
      y = Inf,
      hjust = -0.1,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 4.7
    ) +
    theme(
      #panel.grid = element_blank(),
      #panel.border = element_rect(fill=NA, colour='black', size=1),
      #panel.background = element_rect(fill='#FFFFFF'),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 14, color = 'black'),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14, color = 'black'),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      # 去掉 y 轴刻度线
      axis.ticks.x = element_line(size = 0.5),
      # 让 x 轴刻度线更细
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    labs(x = "", y = NULL)
  
  # 使用patchwork组合图形
  tight_theme <- theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, "cm"))
  # 应用到两个图上
  p1 <- p1 + tight_theme
  p2 <- p2 + tight_theme
  
  combined <- p1 / p2 +
    plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1))
  
  combined <- ggdraw(combined) +
    draw_label(
      "Effects on relationships",
      x = 0.02,
      y = 0.5,
      angle = 90,
      size = 14
    )
  combined
}
```

## Biodiversity–productivity relationship in factor analysis
### Plant biodiversity–productivity relationship in factor analysis
```{r}
library(lme4)
library(sjPlot)
library(cowplot)
library(dplyr)
library(metafor)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
ddate <- read.csv("meta_factor.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)
ddate$Magnitude <- rowMeans(ddate[, c("Magnitude1", "Magnitude2", "Magnitude3")], na.rm = TRUE)
ddate <- ddate %>%
  mutate(
    GCnumber = case_when(
      !is.na(GC1) & !is.na(GC2) & !is.na(GC3) ~ 3,!is.na(GC1) &
        !is.na(GC2) & is.na(GC3) ~ 2,!is.na(GC1) &
        is.na(GC2) & is.na(GC3) ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0  # 其他情况（如GC1为NA）
    )
  )

df = ddate[, c(1:35, 245:256)]
ddf1 = cbind(df, ddate[, c("PlantBiomass_yi",
                           "PlantBiomass_vi",
                           "PlantRichness_yi",
                           "PlantRichness_vi")])
df1 <- ddf1
names(df1)[names(df1) == "PlantRichness_yi"] <- "PlantDiversity_yi"
names(df1)[names(df1) == "PlantRichness_vi"] <- "PlantDiversity_vi"

ddf2 = cbind(df, ddate[, c("PlantBiomass_yi",
                           "PlantBiomass_vi",
                           "PlantShannon_yi",
                           "PlantShannon_vi")])
df2 <- ddf2
names(df2)[names(df2) == "PlantShannon_yi"] <- "PlantDiversity_yi"
names(df2)[names(df2) == "PlantShannon_vi"] <- "PlantDiversity_vi"

ddf <- rbind(df1, df2)

ddf <- subset(ddf, !is.na(PlantBiomass_yi))
ddf <- subset(ddf, !is.na(PlantDiversity_yi))

Q1_bio <- quantile(ddf$PlantBiomass_yi, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
Q3_bio <- quantile(ddf$PlantBiomass_yi, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
IQR_bio <- Q3_bio - Q1_bio
ddf <- ddf[ddf$PlantBiomass_yi >= (Q1_bio - 3 * IQR_bio) &
             ddf$PlantBiomass_yi <= (Q3_bio + 3 * IQR_bio), ]

Q1_div <- quantile(ddf$PlantDiversity_yi, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
Q3_div <- quantile(ddf$PlantDiversity_yi, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
IQR_div <- Q3_div - Q1_div
ddf <- ddf[ddf$PlantDiversity_yi >= (Q1_div - 3 * IQR_div) &
             ddf$PlantDiversity_yi <= (Q3_div + 3 * IQR_div), ]

gc_counts <- table(ddf$GC)
selected_GC <- names(gc_counts[gc_counts >= 15])
ddf <- ddf[ddf$GC %in% selected_GC, ]

# 循环处理每个GC组
for (g in unique(ddf$GC)) {
  dda <- subset(ddf, GC == g)
  dda$BubbleSize <- 1
  Weight <- 1 / sqrt(dda$PlantBiomass_vi)
  Breaks <- quantile(Weight, c(0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
  selectIDs <- which(Weight < Breaks[1])
  dda$BubbleSize <- 1
  for (i in seq(2, length(Breaks))) {
    selectIDs <- which((Weight < Breaks[i]) & (Weight >= Breaks[i - 1]))
    dda$BubbleSize[selectIDs] <- 1 + (i - 1) * 0.5
  }
  
  # 拟合模型
  mixed.lmer <- rma.mv(
    yi = PlantBiomass_yi,
    V = PlantBiomass_vi,
    mods = ~ PlantDiversity_yi,
    random = list(~ 1 | Biomes / ID),
    control = list(iter.max = 1000, rel.tol = 1e-8),
    data = dda
  )
  
  # 生成预测数据
  tempX <- seq(
    min(dda$PlantDiversity_yi, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(dda$PlantDiversity_yi, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 100
  )
  pred.mm <- data.frame(tempX, predict(mixed.lmer, newmods = tempX))
  pred.mm <- pred.mm[, c('tempX', 'pred', 'ci.ub', 'ci.lb')]
  slope <- mixed.lmer$beta[2]
  p <- mixed.lmer$pval[2]
  
  if (p < 0.001) {
    p_values <- paste0('Slope = ', round(slope, 3), ', P < 0.001, n = ', nrow(dda))
  } else if (p < 0.1) {
    p_values <- paste0('Slope = ',
                       round(slope, 3),
                       ', P = ',
                       sprintf('%0.3f', p),
                       ', n = ',
                       nrow(dda))
  } else {
    p_values <- paste0('P = ', sprintf('%0.3f', p), ', n = ', nrow(dda))
  }
  
  # 创建标签数据（简化版）
  label <- data.frame(p_values = p_values,
                      x = -Inf,
                      y = Inf)
  
  # 绘制图形
  P <- ggplot() +
    geom_point(
      data = dda,
      aes(x = PlantDiversity_yi, y = PlantBiomass_yi),
      size = dda$BubbleSize,
      alpha = 0.5,
      col = 'grey40'
    ) +
    
    geom_line(data = pred.mm, aes(x = tempX, y = pred), size = 0.6) +
    geom_text(
      data = label,
      aes(label = p_values, x = x, y = y),
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 2.35
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "black",
      size = 0.3
    ) +
    # 添加y=0的虚线
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "black",
      size = 0.3
    ) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(
        fill = NA,
        colour = 'black',
        size = 0.6
      ),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = '#FFFFFF'),
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 8,
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 7, color = 'black'),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 7, color = 'black'),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
      axis.ticks.y = element_line(size = 0.5),
      axis.ticks.x = element_line(size = 0.5),
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    ylab('RR of plant biomass') +
    xlab('RR of plant diversity') +
    labs(title = paste0("GCF: ", g))
  
  print(P)
}
```

```{r}
###多样性生产力关系微生物

library(lme4)
library(sjPlot)

ddf3 = cbind(df, ddate[, c(

df3 <- ddf3
names(df3)[names(df3) == "Fungi_MicrobialBiomass_yi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_yi"

ddf4 = cbind(df, ddate[, c(
  "AMF_MicrobialBiomass_yi",

  "AMF_MicrobialRichness_yi",
  "AMF_MicrobialRichness_vi"

names(df4)[names(df4) == "AMF_MicrobialRichness_yi"] <- "MicrobialDiversity_yi"
names(df4)[names(df4) == "AMF_MicrobialRichness_vi"] <- "MicrobialDiversity_vi"

ddf11 = cbind(df, ddate[, c(
  "ALL_MicrobialBiomass_yi",
  "ALL_MicrobialBiomass_vi",
  "ALL_MicrobialShannon_yi",
  "ALL_MicrobialShannon_vi"
)])
df11 <- ddf11
names(df11)[names(df11) == "ALL_MicrobialBiomass_yi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_yi"
names(df11)[names(df11) == "ALL_MicrobialBiomass_vi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_vi"
names(df11)[names(df11) == "ALL_MicrobialShannon_yi"] <- "MicrobialDiversity_yi"
names(df11)[names(df11) == "ALL_MicrobialShannon_vi"] <- "MicrobialDiversity_vi"

ddf21 = cbind(df, ddate[, c(
  "Bacteria_MicrobialBiomass_yi",

  "Bacteria_MicrobialShannon_yi",
  "Bacteria_MicrobialShannon_vi"
)])

names(df21)[names(df21) == "Bacteria_MicrobialBiomass_yi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_yi"
names(df21)[names(df21) == "Bacteria_MicrobialBiomass_vi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_vi"
names(df21)[names(df21) == "Bacteria_MicrobialShannon_yi"] <- "MicrobialDiversity_yi"
names(df21)[names(df21) == "Bacteria_MicrobialShannon_vi"] <- "MicrobialDiversity_vi"


ddf31 = cbind(df, ddate[, c(
  "Fungi_MicrobialBiomass_yi",
  "Fungi_MicrobialBiomass_vi",
  "Fungi_MicrobialShannon_yi",
  "Fungi_MicrobialShannon_vi"
)])
df31 <- ddf31
names(df31)[names(df31) == "Fungi_MicrobialBiomass_yi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_yi"
names(df31)[names(df31) == "Fungi_MicrobialBiomass_vi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_vi"
names(df31)[names(df31) == "Fungi_MicrobialShannon_yi"] <- "MicrobialDiversity_yi"
names(df31)[names(df31) == "Fungi_MicrobialShannon_vi"] <- "MicrobialDiversity_vi"


ddf41 = cbind(df, ddate[, c(
  "AMF_MicrobialBiomass_yi",
  "AMF_MicrobialBiomass_vi",
  "AMF_MicrobialShannon_yi",
  "AMF_MicrobialShannon_vi"
)])
df41 <- ddf41
names(df41)[names(df41) == "AMF_MicrobialBiomass_yi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_yi"
names(df41)[names(df41) == "AMF_MicrobialBiomass_vi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_vi"
names(df41)[names(df41) == "AMF_MicrobialShannon_yi"] <- "MicrobialDiversity_yi"
names(df41)[names(df41) == "AMF_MicrobialShannon_vi"] <- "MicrobialDiversity_vi"

ddf <- rbind(df1, df2, df3, df4, df11, df21, df31, df41)

ddf <- subset(ddf, !is.na(MicrobialBiomass_yi))
ddf <- subset(ddf, !is.na(MicrobialDiversity_yi))

Q1_bio <- quantile(ddf$MicrobialBiomass_yi, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
Q3_bio <- quantile(ddf$MicrobialBiomass_yi, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
IQR_bio <- Q3_bio - Q1_bio
ddf <- ddf[ddf$MicrobialBiomass_yi >= (Q1_bio - 3 * IQR_bio) &
             ddf$MicrobialBiomass_yi <= (Q3_bio + 3 * IQR_bio), ]

Q1_div <- quantile(ddf$MicrobialDiversity_yi, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
Q3_div <- quantile(ddf$MicrobialDiversity_yi, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
IQR_div <- Q3_div - Q1_div
ddf <- ddf[ddf$MicrobialDiversity_yi >= (Q1_div - 3 * IQR_div) &
             ddf$MicrobialDiversity_yi <= (Q3_div + 3 * IQR_div), ]

gc_counts <- table(ddf$GC)
selected_GC <- names(gc_counts[gc_counts >= 15])
ddf <- ddf[ddf$GC %in% selected_GC, ]

# 循环处理每个GC组
for (g in unique(ddf$GC)) {
  dda <- subset(ddf, GC == g)
  dda$BubbleSize <- 1
  Weight <- 1 / sqrt(dda$MicrobialBiomass_vi)
  Breaks <- quantile(Weight, c(0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
  selectIDs <- which(Weight < Breaks[1])
  dda$BubbleSize <- 1
  for (i in seq(2, length(Breaks))) {
    selectIDs <- which((Weight < Breaks[i]) & (Weight >= Breaks[i - 1]))
    dda$BubbleSize[selectIDs] <- 1 + (i - 1) * 0.5
  }
  
  # 拟合模型
  mixed.lmer <- rma.mv(
    yi = MicrobialBiomass_yi,
    V = MicrobialBiomass_vi,
    mods = ~ MicrobialDiversity_yi,
    random = list(~ 1 | Biomes / ID),
    control = list(iter.max = 1000, rel.tol = 1e-8),
    data = dda
  )
  
  # 生成预测数据
  tempX <- seq(
    min(dda$MicrobialDiversity_yi, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(dda$MicrobialDiversity_yi, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 100
  )
  pred.mm <- data.frame(tempX, predict(mixed.lmer, newmods = tempX))
  pred.mm <- pred.mm[, c('tempX', 'pred', 'ci.ub', 'ci.lb')]
  slope <- mixed.lmer$beta[2]
  p <- mixed.lmer$pval[2]
  
  if (p < 0.001) {
    p_values <- paste0('Slope = ', round(slope, 3), ', P < 0.001, n = ', nrow(dda))
  } else if (p < 0.1) {
    p_values <- paste0('Slope = ',
                       round(slope, 3),
                       ', P = ',
                       sprintf('%0.3f', p),
                       ', n = ',
                       nrow(dda))
  } else {
    p_values <- paste0('P = ', sprintf('%0.3f', p), ', n = ', nrow(dda))
  }
  
  # 创建标签数据（简化版）
  label <- data.frame(p_values = p_values,
                      x = -Inf,
                      y = Inf)
  
  # 绘制图形
  P <- ggplot() +
    geom_point(
      data = dda,
      aes(x = MicrobialDiversity_yi, y = MicrobialBiomass_yi),
      size = dda$BubbleSize,
      alpha = 0.5,
      col = 'grey40'
    ) +
    
    geom_line(data = pred.mm, aes(x = tempX, y = pred), size = 0.6) +
    geom_text(
      data = label,
      aes(label = p_values, x = x, y = y),
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 2.35
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "black",
      size = 0.3
    ) +
    # 添加y=0的虚线
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "black",
      size = 0.3
    ) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(
        fill = NA,
        colour = 'black',
        size = 0.6
      ),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = '#FFFFFF'),
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 8,
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 7, color = 'black'),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 7, color = 'black'),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
      axis.ticks.y = element_line(size = 0.5),
      axis.ticks.x = element_line(size = 0.5),
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    ylab('RR of microbial biomass') +
    xlab('RR of microbial diversity')  +
    labs(title = paste0("GCF: ", g))
  
  print(P)
}

```







#07 Aboveground–belowground relationships

```{r}
library(lme4)
library(sjPlot)
library(cowplot)
library(dplyr)
library(metafor)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
ddate <- read.csv("meta_factor.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)
ddate$Magnitude <- rowMeans(ddate[, c("Magnitude1", "Magnitude2", "Magnitude3")], na.rm = TRUE)
ddate <- ddate %>%
  mutate(
    GCnumber = case_when(
      !is.na(GC1) & !is.na(GC2) & !is.na(GC3) ~ 3,!is.na(GC1) &
        !is.na(GC2) & is.na(GC3) ~ 2,!is.na(GC1) &
        is.na(GC2) & is.na(GC3) ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0  # 其他情况（如GC1为NA）
    )
  )

df <- ddate[, c(1:35, 245:256, which(colnames(ddate) %in% c("PlantBiomass_yi", "PlantBiomass_vi")))]

ddf1 = cbind(df, ddate[, c("ALL_MicrobialBiomass_yi", "ALL_MicrobialBiomass_vi")])
df1 <- ddf1
names(df1)[names(df1) == "ALL_MicrobialBiomass_yi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_yi"
names(df1)[names(df1) == "ALL_MicrobialBiomass_vi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_vi"
df1$Group <- "Microbe"


ddf2 = cbind(df, ddate[, c("Bacteria_MicrobialBiomass_yi",
                           "Bacteria_MicrobialBiomass_vi")])
df2 <- ddf2
names(df2)[names(df2) == "Bacteria_MicrobialBiomass_yi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_yi"
names(df2)[names(df2) == "Bacteria_MicrobialBiomass_vi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_vi"
df2$Group <- "Bacteria"

ddf3 = cbind(df, ddate[, c("Fungi_MicrobialBiomass_yi", "Fungi_MicrobialBiomass_vi")])
df3 <- ddf3
names(df3)[names(df3) == "Fungi_MicrobialBiomass_yi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_yi"
names(df3)[names(df3) == "Fungi_MicrobialBiomass_vi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_vi"
df3$Group <- "Fungi"

ddf4 = cbind(df, ddate[, c("AMF_MicrobialBiomass_yi", "AMF_MicrobialBiomass_vi")])
df4 <- ddf4
names(df4)[names(df4) == "AMF_MicrobialBiomass_yi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_yi"
names(df4)[names(df4) == "AMF_MicrobialBiomass_vi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_vi"
df4$Group <- "AMF"

ddf <- rbind(df1, df2, df3, df4)

ddf <- subset(ddf, !is.na(PlantBiomass_yi))
ddf <- subset(ddf, !is.na(MicrobialBiomass_yi))
ddf <- subset(ddf, MicrobialBiomass_vi > 0)


Q1_bio <- quantile(ddf$PlantBiomass_yi, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
Q3_bio <- quantile(ddf$PlantBiomass_yi, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
IQR_bio <- Q3_bio - Q1_bio
ddf <- ddf[ddf$PlantBiomass_yi >= (Q1_bio - 3 * IQR_bio) &
             ddf$PlantBiomass_yi <= (Q3_bio + 3 * IQR_bio), ]

Q1_div <- quantile(ddf$MicrobialBiomass_yi, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
Q3_div <- quantile(ddf$MicrobialBiomass_yi, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
IQR_div <- Q3_div - Q1_div
ddf <- ddf[ddf$MicrobialBiomass_yi >= (Q1_div - 3 * IQR_div) &
             ddf$MicrobialBiomass_yi <= (Q3_div + 3 * IQR_div), ]




ddf <- ddf %>%
  mutate(
    type = case_when(
      GC %in% c("N", "P", "K") ~ "Single nutrient",
      GC %in% c("eCO2", "W", "PPT+", "PPT-") ~ "Single climate",
      GC %in% c("N_P", "N_K", "P_K") ~ "Nutrient-nutrient",
      GC %in% c("eCO2_W", "W_PPT+", "W_PPT-", "eCO2_PPT-") ~ "Climate-climate",
      GC %in% c("eCO2_N", "W_N", "N_PPT+", "N_PPT-") ~ "Nutrient-climate",
      GC %in% c("eCO2_W_PPT-", "W_N_P", "N_P_K") ~ "Multi-factor"
    )
  )

GCname <- c("Single nutrient", "Single climate")


for (g in GCname) {
  dda <- subset(ddf, type == g)
  dda$BubbleSize <- 1
  Weight <- 1 / sqrt(dda$MicrobialBiomass_vi)
  Breaks <- quantile(Weight, c(0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
  selectIDs <- which(Weight < Breaks[1])
  dda$BubbleSize <- 1
  for (i in seq(2, length(Breaks))) {
    selectIDs <- which((Weight < Breaks[i]) & (Weight >= Breaks[i - 1]))
    dda$BubbleSize[selectIDs] <- 1 + (i - 1) * 0.5
  }
  
  # 拟合模型
  mixed.lmer <- rma.mv(
    yi = MicrobialBiomass_yi,
    V = MicrobialBiomass_vi,
    mods = ~ PlantBiomass_yi,
    random = list( ~ 1 |GC, ~ 1 | Biomes / ID, ~ 1 | Group),
    control = list(iter.max = 1000, rel.tol = 1e-8),
    data = dda
  )
  
  # 生成预测数据
  tempX <- seq(
    min(dda$PlantBiomass_yi, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(dda$PlantBiomass_yi, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 100
  )
  newmods <- cbind(1, tempX, tempX^2)
  pred.mm <- data.frame(tempX, predict(mixed.lmer, newmods = tempX))
  pred.mm <- pred.mm[, c('tempX', 'pred', 'ci.ub', 'ci.lb')]
  
  slope <- mixed.lmer$beta[2]
  p <- mixed.lmer$pval[2]
  
  if (p < 0.001) {
    p_values <- paste0('Slope = ', round(slope, 3), ', P < 0.001, n = ', nrow(dda))
  } else if (p < 0.1) {
    p_values <- paste0('Slope = ',

                       ', P = ',
                       sprintf('%0.3f', p),
                       ', n = ',

  } else {

  }
  # 创建标签数据（简化版）
  label <- data.frame(p_values = p_values,
                      x = -Inf,
                      y = Inf)
  
  # 绘制图形
  P <- ggplot() +

      data = dda,

    ) +
    
    geom_line(data = pred.mm, aes(x = tempX, y = pred), size = 0.6) +
    geom_text(
      data = label,

      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,

    ) +
    geom_vline(

      ),

      axis.ticks.y = element_line(size = 0.5),
      axis.ticks.x = element_line(size = 0.5),
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    ylab('RR of microbial biomass') +
    xlab('RR of plant biomass')  +
    labs(title = paste0(g))
  
  print(P)

}
```

```{r}
  mixed.lmer <- rma.mv(
    yi = MicrobialDiversity_yi,
    V = MicrobialDiversity_vi,
    random = list( ~ 1 |GC, ~ 1 | Biomes / ID, ~ 1 | Group),
    mods = ~ PlantBiomass_yi,
    control = list(iter.max = 1000, rel.tol = 1e-8),
    data = dda
  )
  
  # 生成预测数据
  tempX <- seq(
    min(dda$PlantBiomass_yi, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(dda$PlantBiomass_yi, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 100
  )
  pred.mm <- data.frame(tempX, predict(mixed.lmer, newmods = tempX))
  pred.mm <- pred.mm[, c('tempX', 'pred', 'ci.ub', 'ci.lb')]
  slope <- mixed.lmer$beta[2]
  p <- mixed.lmer$pval[2]
  
  if (p < 0.001) {
    p_values <- paste0('Slope = ', round(slope, 3), ', P < 0.001, n = ', nrow(dda))
  } else if (p < 0.1) {
    p_values <- paste0('Slope = ',
                       round(slope, 3),
                       ', P = ',
                       sprintf('%0.3f', p),
                       ', n = ',
                       nrow(dda))
  } else {
    p_values <- paste0('P = ', sprintf('%0.3f', p), ', n = ', nrow(dda))
  }
  # 创建标签数据（简化版）
  label <- data.frame(p_values = p_values,
                      x = -Inf,
                      y = Inf)
  
  # 绘制图形
  P <- ggplot() +
    geom_point(
      data = dda,
      aes(x = PlantBiomass_yi, y = MicrobialDiversity_yi),
      size = dda$BubbleSize,
      alpha = 0.5,
      col = 'grey40'
    ) +
    
    geom_line(data = pred.mm, aes(x = tempX, y = pred), size = 0.6) +
    geom_text(
      data = label,
      aes(label = p_values, x = x, y = y),
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 2.35
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "black",
      size = 0.3
    ) +
    # 添加y=0的虚线
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "black",
      size = 0.3
    ) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(
        fill = NA,
        colour = 'black',
        size = 0.6
      ),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = '#FFFFFF'),
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 8,
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 7, color = 'black'),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 7, color = 'black'),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
      axis.ticks.y = element_line(size = 0.5),
      axis.ticks.x = element_line(size = 0.5),
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    ylab('RR of microbial diversity') +
    xlab('RR of plant biomass')  +
    labs(title = paste0(g))
  
  print(P)

}
```

```{r}
library(lme4)

ddate <- read.csv("meta_factor.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)

  mutate(

        is.na(GC2) & is.na(GC3) ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0  # 其他情况（如GC1为NA）
    )
  )

df <- ddate[, c(1:35, 245:256, which(
  colnames(ddate) %in% c(
    "PlantRichness_yi",
    "PlantRichness_vi",
    "PlantShannon_yi",
    "PlantShannon_vi"
  )
))]

ddf1 = cbind(df, ddate[, c("ALL_MicrobialBiomass_yi", "ALL_MicrobialBiomass_vi")])
df1 <- ddf1
names(df1)[names(df1) == "ALL_MicrobialBiomass_yi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_yi"
names(df1)[names(df1) == "ALL_MicrobialBiomass_vi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_vi"
df1$Group <- "Microbe"


ddf2 = cbind(df, ddate[, c("Bacteria_MicrobialBiomass_yi",
                           "Bacteria_MicrobialBiomass_vi")])
df2 <- ddf2
names(df2)[names(df2) == "Bacteria_MicrobialBiomass_yi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_yi"
names(df2)[names(df2) == "Bacteria_MicrobialBiomass_vi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_vi"
df2$Group <- "Bacteria"

ddf3 = cbind(df, ddate[, c("Fungi_MicrobialBiomass_yi", "Fungi_MicrobialBiomass_vi")])

names(df3)[names(df3) == "Fungi_MicrobialBiomass_yi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_yi"

names(df4)[names(df4) == "AMF_MicrobialBiomass_yi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_yi"
names(df4)[names(df4) == "AMF_MicrobialBiomass_vi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_vi"
df4$Group <- "AMF"

datadf1 <- dataf[, !(names(dataf) %in% c("PlantShannon_yi", "PlantShannon_vi"))]
names(datadf1)[names(datadf1) == "PlantRichness_yi"] <- "PlantDiversity_yi"
names(datadf1)[names(datadf1) == "PlantRichness_vi"] <- "PlantDiversity_vi"
datadf1$Diversitytype <- "Richness"

datadf2 <- dataf[, !(names(dataf) %in% c("PlantRichness_yi", "PlantRichness_vi"))]
names(datadf2)[names(datadf2) == "PlantShannon_yi"] <- "PlantDiversity_yi"
names(datadf2)[names(datadf2) == "PlantShannon_vi"] <- "PlantDiversity_vi"

ddf <- subset(ddf, !is.na(MicrobialBiomass_yi))
ddf <- subset(ddf, MicrobialBiomass_vi > 0)


Q1_bio <- quantile(ddf$PlantDiversity_yi, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
Q3_bio <- quantile(ddf$PlantDiversity_yi, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
IQR_bio <- Q3_bio - Q1_bio
ddf <- ddf[ddf$PlantDiversity_yi >= (Q1_bio - 3 * IQR_bio) &
             ddf$PlantDiversity_yi <= (Q3_bio + 3 * IQR_bio), ]

Q1_div <- quantile(ddf$MicrobialBiomass_yi, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
Q3_div <- quantile(ddf$MicrobialBiomass_yi, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)

      GC %in% c("eCO2_W", "W_PPT+", "W_PPT-", "eCO2_PPT-") ~ "Climate-climate",
      GC %in% c("eCO2_N", "W_N", "N_PPT+", "N_PPT-") ~ "Nutrient-climate",

    )
  )

  pred.mm <- pred.mm[, c('tempX', 'pred', 'ci.ub', 'ci.lb')]
  slope <- mixed.lmer$beta[2]

  if (p < 0.001) {
    p_values <- paste0('Slope = ', round(slope, 3), ', P < 0.001, n = ', nrow(dda))
  } else if (p < 0.1) {
    p_values <- paste0('Slope = ',
                       round(slope, 3),
                       ', P = ',
                       sprintf('%0.3f', p),
                       ', n = ',
                       nrow(dda))
  } else {
    p_values <- paste0('P = ', sprintf('%0.3f', p), ', n = ', nrow(dda))
  }
  # 创建标签数据（简化版）
  label <- data.frame(p_values = p_values,
                      x = -Inf,
                      y = Inf)
  
  # 绘制图形
  P <- ggplot() +
    geom_point(
      data = dda,
      aes(x = PlantDiversity_yi, y = MicrobialBiomass_yi),

      alpha = 0.5,

    geom_text(
      data = label,

      size = 2.35
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "black",
      size = 0.3
    ) +
    # 添加y=0的虚线
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,

      color = "black",

    ) +
    theme(

      panel.border = element_rect(
        fill = NA,
        colour = 'black',
        size = 0.6
      ),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = '#FFFFFF'),
```

```{r}
ddf3 = cbind(df,ddate[,c("Fungi_MicrobialBiomass_yi","Fungi_MicrobialBiomass_vi")])
df3 <- ddf3
names(df3)[names(df3) == "Fungi_MicrobialBiomass_yi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_yi"
names(df3)[names(df3) == "Fungi_MicrobialBiomass_vi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_vi"
df3$Group <- "Fungi"

ddf4 = cbind(df,ddate[,c("AMF_MicrobialBiomass_yi","AMF_MicrobialBiomass_vi")])
df4 <- ddf4
names(df4)[names(df4) == "AMF_MicrobialBiomass_yi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_yi"
names(df4)[names(df4) == "AMF_MicrobialBiomass_vi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_vi"
df4$Group <- "AMF"

ddf <- rbind(df1,df2,df3,df4)

ddf <-subset(ddf,!is.na(PlantBiomass_yi)) 
ddf <-subset(ddf,!is.na(MicrobialBiomass_yi)) 
ddf <-subset(ddf,MicrobialBiomass_vi>0) 


Q1_bio <- quantile(ddf$PlantBiomass_yi, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
Q3_bio <- quantile(ddf$PlantBiomass_yi, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
IQR_bio <- Q3_bio - Q1_bio
ddf <- ddf[ddf$PlantBiomass_yi >= (Q1_bio - 3 * IQR_bio) &
             ddf$PlantBiomass_yi <= (Q3_bio + 3 * IQR_bio), ]

Q1_div <- quantile(ddf$MicrobialBiomass_yi, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
Q3_div <- quantile(ddf$MicrobialBiomass_yi, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
IQR_div <- Q3_div - Q1_div
ddf <- ddf[ddf$MicrobialBiomass_yi >= (Q1_div - 3 * IQR_div) &
             ddf$MicrobialBiomass_yi <= (Q3_div + 3 * IQR_div), ]



  dda <- subset(ddf, GC == "N_P_K")
  dda$BubbleSize <- 1
  Weight <- 1/sqrt(dda$MicrobialBiomass_vi)
  Breaks <- quantile(Weight, c(0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
  selectIDs <- which(Weight < Breaks[1])
  dda$BubbleSize <- 1
  for(i in seq(2, length(Breaks))){
    selectIDs <- which((Weight < Breaks[i]) & (Weight >= Breaks[i-1]))
    dda$BubbleSize[selectIDs] <- 1 + (i-1)*0.5
  }
  
  # 拟合模型
  mixed.lmer <- rma.mv(yi = MicrobialBiomass_yi, V = MicrobialBiomass_vi, mods = ~ PlantBiomass_yi, 
                       random = list(~ 1|GC, ~ 1|Biomes/ID, ~1|Group),
                       control = list(iter.max = 1000, rel.tol = 1e-8), data = dda)
  
  # 生成预测数据
  tempX <- seq(min(dda$PlantBiomass_yi, na.rm = TRUE), 
               max(dda$PlantBiomass_yi, na.rm = TRUE), 
               length.out = 100)
  pred.mm <- data.frame(tempX, predict(mixed.lmer, newmods = tempX))
  pred.mm <- pred.mm[, c('tempX', 'pred', 'ci.ub', 'ci.lb')]
  slope <- mixed.lmer$beta[2]
  p <- mixed.lmer$pval[2]
  
  if(p < 0.001){
    p_values <- paste0('Slope = ', round(slope, 3), ', P < 0.001, n = ', nrow(dda))
  } else if(p < 0.1){
    p_values <- paste0('Slope = ', round(slope, 3), ', P = ', sprintf('%0.3f', p), ', n = ', nrow(dda))
  } else {
    p_values <- paste0('P = ', sprintf('%0.3f', p), ', n = ', nrow(dda))
  }
  # 创建标签数据（简化版）
  label <- data.frame(
    p_values = p_values,
    x = -Inf,
    y = Inf
  )
  
  # 绘制图形
  P <- ggplot() +
    geom_point(data = dda, 
               aes(x = PlantBiomass_yi, y = MicrobialBiomass_yi), 
               size = dda$BubbleSize, alpha = 0.5, col = 'grey40') +
    
    geom_line(data = pred.mm, aes(x = tempX, y = pred), size = 0.6) +
    geom_text(data = label, aes(label = p_values, x = x, y = y), 
              hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 2.35) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 0.3) +
    # 添加y=0的虚线
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 0.3) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(fill=NA, colour='black', size=0.6),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill='#FFFFFF'),
      plot.title = element_text(size=8, hjust=0.5, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size=7, hjust=0.5),
      axis.text = element_text(size=7, color='black'),
      axis.title = element_text(size=7, color='black'),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
      axis.ticks.y = element_line(size = 0.5),
      axis.ticks.x = element_line(size = 0.5),
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    ylab('RR of microbial biomass') +
    xlab('RR of plant biomass')  +
    labs(title = "NPK addition")
  
  print(P)
```
