## Aboveground–belowground relationships by individual factors
### Plant biomass and microbial biomass
```{r}
library(lme4)
library(sjPlot)
library(cowplot)
library(dplyr)
library(metafor)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
ddate<-read.csv("meta_factor.csv",header = T, row.names = 1)
ddate$Magnitude <- rowMeans(ddate[, c("Magnitude1", "Magnitude2", "Magnitude3")], na.rm = TRUE)
ddate <- ddate %>%
  mutate(GCnumber = case_when(
    !is.na(GC1) & !is.na(GC2) & !is.na(GC3) ~ 3,
    !is.na(GC1) & !is.na(GC2) & is.na(GC3) ~ 2,
    !is.na(GC1) & is.na(GC2) & is.na(GC3) ~ 1,
    TRUE ~ 0  # 其他情况（如GC1为NA）
  ))
ddate <- subset(ddate, GCnumber == 1)
df <- ddate[, c(1:35, 245:256, 
                which(colnames(ddate) %in% c("PlantBiomass_yi", "PlantBiomass_vi")))]

ddf1 = cbind(df,ddate[,c("ALL_MicrobialBiomass_yi","ALL_MicrobialBiomass_vi")])
df1 <- ddf1
names(df1)[names(df1) == "ALL_MicrobialBiomass_yi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_yi"
names(df1)[names(df1) == "ALL_MicrobialBiomass_vi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_vi"
df1$Group <- "Microbe"


ddf2 = cbind(df,ddate[,c("Bacteria_MicrobialBiomass_yi","Bacteria_MicrobialBiomass_vi")])
df2 <- ddf2
names(df2)[names(df2) == "Bacteria_MicrobialBiomass_yi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_yi"
names(df2)[names(df2) == "Bacteria_MicrobialBiomass_vi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_vi"
df2$Group <- "Bacteria"

ddf3 = cbind(df,ddate[,c("Fungi_MicrobialBiomass_yi","Fungi_MicrobialBiomass_vi")])
df3 <- ddf3
names(df3)[names(df3) == "Fungi_MicrobialBiomass_yi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_yi"
names(df3)[names(df3) == "Fungi_MicrobialBiomass_vi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_vi"
df3$Group <- "Fungi"

ddf4 = cbind(df,ddate[,c("AMF_MicrobialBiomass_yi","AMF_MicrobialBiomass_vi")])
df4 <- ddf4
names(df4)[names(df4) == "AMF_MicrobialBiomass_yi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_yi"
names(df4)[names(df4) == "AMF_MicrobialBiomass_vi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_vi"
df4$Group <- "AMF"

ddf <- rbind(df1,df2,df3,df4)

ddf <-subset(ddf,!is.na(PlantBiomass_yi)) 
ddf <-subset(ddf,!is.na(MicrobialBiomass_yi)) 
ddf <-subset(ddf,MicrobialBiomass_vi>0) 


Q1_bio <- quantile(ddf$PlantBiomass_yi, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
Q3_bio <- quantile(ddf$PlantBiomass_yi, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
IQR_bio <- Q3_bio - Q1_bio
ddf <- ddf[ddf$PlantBiomass_yi >= (Q1_bio - 3 * IQR_bio) &
             ddf$PlantBiomass_yi <= (Q3_bio + 3 * IQR_bio), ]

Q1_div <- quantile(ddf$MicrobialBiomass_yi, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
Q3_div <- quantile(ddf$MicrobialBiomass_yi, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
IQR_div <- Q3_div - Q1_div
ddf <- ddf[ddf$MicrobialBiomass_yi >= (Q1_div - 3 * IQR_div) &
             ddf$MicrobialBiomass_yi <= (Q3_div + 3 * IQR_div), ]

gc_counts <- table(ddf$GC)
selected_GC <- names(gc_counts[gc_counts >= 15])
ddf <- ddf[ddf$GC %in% selected_GC, ]

# 创建一个空的列表来存储每个GC组的预测数据
all_pred <- list()
all_data <- list()

# 循环处理每个GC组
for(g in unique(ddf$GC)){
  dda <- subset(ddf, GC == g)
  dda$BubbleSize <- 1
  Weight <- 1/sqrt(dda$MicrobialBiomass_vi)
  Breaks <- quantile(Weight, c(0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
  selectIDs <- which(Weight < Breaks[1])
  dda$BubbleSize <- 1
  for(i in seq(2, length(Breaks))){
    selectIDs <- which((Weight < Breaks[i]) & (Weight >= Breaks[i-1]))
    dda$BubbleSize[selectIDs] <- 1 + (i-1)*0.5
  }
  
  # 保存处理后的数据
  all_data[[g]] <- dda
  
  # 拟合模型
  mixed.lmer <- rma.mv(yi = MicrobialBiomass_yi, V = MicrobialBiomass_vi, mods = ~ PlantBiomass_yi, 
                       random = list( ~ 1|Biomes/ID, ~1|Group),
                       control = list(iter.max = 1000, rel.tol = 1e-8), data = dda)
  
  # 生成预测数据
  tempX <- seq(min(dda$PlantBiomass_yi, na.rm = TRUE), 
               max(dda$PlantBiomass_yi, na.rm = TRUE), 
               length.out = 100)
  pred.mm <- data.frame(tempX, predict(mixed.lmer, newmods = tempX))
  pred.mm <- pred.mm[, c('tempX', 'pred', 'ci.ub', 'ci.lb')]
  pred.mm$GC <- g
  p <- mixed.lmer$pval[2]
  p_text <- ifelse(p < 0.001, "< 0.001", sprintf('= %0.3f', p))
  pred.mm$p_values <- paste0(g, ', P ', p_text)
  
  all_pred[[g]] <- pred.mm
}

# 合并所有数据
combined_data <- do.call(rbind, all_data)
combined_pred <- do.call(rbind, all_pred)

# 简化版颜色方案
simple_colors <- c(
  "W" = "#B22222",   
  "PPT-" = "#fb929e", 
  "PPT+" = "#FF6600",
  "eCO2" = "#DC143C", 
  "N" = "#4797b1",   
  "P" = "#36506c",   
  "K" = "#9999FF"   
)
# 使用简化颜色方案的图形
combined_plot_simple <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = combined_data, 
             aes(x = PlantBiomass_yi, y = MicrobialBiomass_yi, color = GC), 
             size = combined_data$BubbleSize, alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_line(data = combined_pred, 
            aes(x = tempX, y = pred, color = GC), size = 0.6) +
  geom_text(data = combined_pred %>% group_by(GC) %>% slice(1),
            aes(label = p_values, x = -Inf, y = Inf, color = GC),
            hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 2.35, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 0.3) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = 'black', size = 0.6),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = '#FFFFFF'),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 7, color = 'black'),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 7, color = 'black'),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
    axis.ticks.y = element_line(size = 0.5),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(size = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.2, "cm"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6)
  ) +
  ylab('RR of microbial biomass') +
  xlab('RR of plant biomass') +
  scale_color_manual(values = simple_colors)

print(combined_plot_simple)


```

```{r}
df3$Group <- "Fungi"

df4 <- ddf4
names(df4)[names(df4) == "AMF_MicrobialRichness_yi"] <- "MicrobialDiversity_yi"
names(df4)[names(df4) == "AMF_MicrobialRichness_vi"] <- "MicrobialDiversity_vi"
df4$Group <- "AMF"

ddf11 = cbind(df,ddate[,c("ALL_MicrobialShannon_yi", "ALL_MicrobialShannon_vi")])
df11 <- ddf11
names(df11)[names(df11) == "ALL_MicrobialShannon_yi"] <- "MicrobialDiversity_yi"
names(df11)[names(df11) == "ALL_MicrobialShannon_vi"] <- "MicrobialDiversity_vi"
df11$Group <- "Microbe"

ddf21 = cbind(df,ddate[,c("Bacteria_MicrobialShannon_yi", "Bacteria_MicrobialShannon_vi")])
df21 <- ddf21
names(df21)[names(df21) == "Bacteria_MicrobialShannon_yi"] <- "MicrobialDiversity_yi"
names(df21)[names(df21) == "Bacteria_MicrobialShannon_vi"] <- "MicrobialDiversity_vi"
df21$Group <- "Bacteria"

ddf31 = cbind(df,ddate[,c("Fungi_MicrobialShannon_yi", "Fungi_MicrobialShannon_vi")])
df31 <- ddf31
names(df31)[names(df31) == "Fungi_MicrobialShannon_yi"] <- "MicrobialDiversity_yi"
names(df31)[names(df31) == "Fungi_MicrobialShannon_vi"] <- "MicrobialDiversity_vi"
df31$Group <- "Fungi"

ddf41 = cbind(df,ddate[,c("AMF_MicrobialShannon_yi", "AMF_MicrobialShannon_vi")])
df41 <- ddf41
names(df41)[names(df41) == "AMF_MicrobialShannon_yi"] <- "MicrobialDiversity_yi"
names(df41)[names(df41) == "AMF_MicrobialShannon_vi"] <- "MicrobialDiversity_vi"
df41$Group <- "AMF"

ddf <- rbind(df1,df2,df3,df4,df11,df21,df31,df41)



ddf <-subset(ddf,!is.na(PlantBiomass_yi)) 
ddf <-subset(ddf,!is.na(MicrobialDiversity_yi)) 
ddf <-subset(ddf,MicrobialDiversity_vi>0) 

Q1_bio <- quantile(ddf$PlantBiomass_yi, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
Q3_bio <- quantile(ddf$PlantBiomass_yi, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
IQR_bio <- Q3_bio - Q1_bio
ddf <- ddf[ddf$PlantBiomass_yi >= (Q1_bio - 3 * IQR_bio) &
             ddf$PlantBiomass_yi <= (Q3_bio + 3 * IQR_bio), ]

Q1_div <- quantile(ddf$MicrobialDiversity_yi, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
Q3_div <- quantile(ddf$MicrobialDiversity_yi, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
IQR_div <- Q3_div - Q1_div
ddf <- ddf[ddf$MicrobialDiversity_yi >= (Q1_div - 3 * IQR_div) &
             ddf$MicrobialDiversity_yi <= (Q3_div + 3 * IQR_div), ]


gc_counts <- table(ddf$GC)
selected_GC <- names(gc_counts[gc_counts >= 15])
ddf <- ddf[ddf$GC %in% selected_GC, ]

# 创建一个空的列表来存储每个GC组的预测数据
all_pred <- list()
all_data <- list()

# 循环处理每个GC组
for(g in unique(ddf$GC)){
  dda <- subset(ddf, GC == g)
  dda$BubbleSize <- 1
  Weight <- 1/sqrt(dda$MicrobialDiversity_vi)
  Breaks <- quantile(Weight, c(0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
  selectIDs <- which(Weight < Breaks[1])
  dda$BubbleSize <- 1
  for(i in seq(2, length(Breaks))){
    selectIDs <- which((Weight < Breaks[i]) & (Weight >= Breaks[i-1]))
    dda$BubbleSize[selectIDs] <- 1 + (i-1)*0.5
  }
  
  # 保存处理后的数据
  all_data[[g]] <- dda
  
  # 拟合模型
  mixed.lmer <- rma.mv(yi = MicrobialDiversity_yi, V = MicrobialDiversity_vi, mods = ~ PlantBiomass_yi, 
                       random = list( ~ 1|Biomes/ID, ~1|Group),
                       control = list(iter.max = 1000, rel.tol = 1e-8), data = dda)
  
  # 生成预测数据
  tempX <- seq(min(dda$PlantBiomass_yi, na.rm = TRUE), 
               max(dda$PlantBiomass_yi, na.rm = TRUE), 
               length.out = 100)
  pred.mm <- data.frame(tempX, predict(mixed.lmer, newmods = tempX))
  pred.mm <- pred.mm[, c('tempX', 'pred', 'ci.ub', 'ci.lb')]
  pred.mm$GC <- g
  p <- mixed.lmer$pval[2]
  p_text <- ifelse(p < 0.001, "< 0.001", sprintf('= %0.3f', p))
  pred.mm$p_values <- paste0(g, ', P ', p_text)
  
  all_pred[[g]] <- pred.mm
}

# 合并所有数据
combined_data <- do.call(rbind, all_data)
combined_pred <- do.call(rbind, all_pred)

# 简化版颜色方案
simple_colors <- c(
  "W" = "#B22222",   
  "PPT-" = "#fb929e", 
  "PPT+" = "#FF6600",
  "eCO2" = "#DC143C", 
  "N" = "#4797b1",   
  "P" = "#36506c",   
  "K" = "#9999FF"   
)
# 使用简化颜色方案的图形
combined_plot_simple <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = combined_data, 
             aes(x = PlantBiomass_yi, y = MicrobialDiversity_yi, color = GC), 
             size = combined_data$BubbleSize, alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_line(data = combined_pred, 
            aes(x = tempX, y = pred, color = GC), size = 0.6) +
  geom_text(data = combined_pred %>% group_by(GC) %>% slice(1),
            aes(label = p_values, x = -Inf, y = Inf, color = GC),
            hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 2.35, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 0.3) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = 'black', size = 0.6),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = '#FFFFFF'),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 7, color = 'black'),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 7, color = 'black'),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
    axis.ticks.y = element_line(size = 0.5),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(size = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.2, "cm"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6)
  ) +
  ylab('RR of microbial diversity') +
  xlab('RR of plant biomass') +
  scale_color_manual(values = simple_colors)

print(combined_plot_simple)
```

## Aboveground–belowground relationships (by individual and combined factors)
### All
```{r}
library(lme4)
library(sjPlot)
library(cowplot)
library(dplyr)
library(metafor)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
ddate<-read.csv("meta_factor.csv",header = T, row.names = 1)
ddate$Magnitude <- rowMeans(ddate[, c("Magnitude1", "Magnitude2", "Magnitude3")], na.rm = TRUE)
ddate <- ddate %>%
  mutate(GCnumber = case_when(
    !is.na(GC1) & !is.na(GC2) & !is.na(GC3) ~ 3,
    !is.na(GC1) & !is.na(GC2) & is.na(GC3) ~ 2,
    !is.na(GC1) & is.na(GC2) & is.na(GC3) ~ 1,
    TRUE ~ 0  # 其他情况（如GC1为NA）
  ))
ddate <- subset(ddate, GCnumber == 2)
df <- ddate[, c(1:35, 245:256, 
                which(colnames(ddate) %in% c("PlantBiomass_yi", "PlantBiomass_vi")))]

ddf1 = cbind(df,ddate[,c("ALL_MicrobialBiomass_yi","ALL_MicrobialBiomass_vi")])
df1 <- ddf1
names(df1)[names(df1) == "ALL_MicrobialBiomass_yi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_yi"
names(df1)[names(df1) == "ALL_MicrobialBiomass_vi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_vi"
df1$Group <- "Microbe"


ddf2 = cbind(df,ddate[,c("Bacteria_MicrobialBiomass_yi","Bacteria_MicrobialBiomass_vi")])
df2 <- ddf2
names(df2)[names(df2) == "Bacteria_MicrobialBiomass_yi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_yi"
names(df2)[names(df2) == "Bacteria_MicrobialBiomass_vi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_vi"
df2$Group <- "Bacteria"

ddf3 = cbind(df,ddate[,c("Fungi_MicrobialBiomass_yi","Fungi_MicrobialBiomass_vi")])
df3 <- ddf3
names(df3)[names(df3) == "Fungi_MicrobialBiomass_yi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_yi"
names(df3)[names(df3) == "Fungi_MicrobialBiomass_vi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_vi"
df3$Group <- "Fungi"

ddf4 = cbind(df,ddate[,c("AMF_MicrobialBiomass_yi","AMF_MicrobialBiomass_vi")])
df4 <- ddf4
names(df4)[names(df4) == "AMF_MicrobialBiomass_yi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_yi"
names(df4)[names(df4) == "AMF_MicrobialBiomass_vi"] <- "MicrobialBiomass_vi"
df4$Group <- "AMF"

ddf <- rbind(df1,df2,df3,df4)

ddf <-subset(ddf,!is.na(PlantBiomass_yi)) 
ddf <-subset(ddf,!is.na(MicrobialBiomass_yi)) 
ddf <-subset(ddf,MicrobialBiomass_vi>0) 


Q1_bio <- quantile(ddf$PlantBiomass_yi, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
Q3_bio <- quantile(ddf$PlantBiomass_yi, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
IQR_bio <- Q3_bio - Q1_bio
ddf <- ddf[ddf$PlantBiomass_yi >= (Q1_bio - 3 * IQR_bio) &
             ddf$PlantBiomass_yi <= (Q3_bio + 3 * IQR_bio), ]

Q1_div <- quantile(ddf$MicrobialBiomass_yi, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
Q3_div <- quantile(ddf$MicrobialBiomass_yi, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
IQR_div <- Q3_div - Q1_div
ddf <- ddf[ddf$MicrobialBiomass_yi >= (Q1_div - 3 * IQR_div) &
             ddf$MicrobialBiomass_yi <= (Q3_div + 3 * IQR_div), ]

gc_counts <- table(ddf$GC)
selected_GC <- names(gc_counts[gc_counts >= 15])
ddf <- ddf[ddf$GC %in% selected_GC, ]

# 创建一个空的列表来存储每个GC组的预测数据
all_pred <- list()
all_data <- list()

# 循环处理每个GC组
for(g in unique(ddf$GC)){
  dda <- subset(ddf, GC == g)
  dda$BubbleSize <- 1
  Weight <- 1/sqrt(dda$MicrobialBiomass_vi)
  Breaks <- quantile(Weight, c(0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
  selectIDs <- which(Weight < Breaks[1])
  dda$BubbleSize <- 1
  for(i in seq(2, length(Breaks))){
    selectIDs <- which((Weight < Breaks[i]) & (Weight >= Breaks[i-1]))
    dda$BubbleSize[selectIDs] <- 1 + (i-1)*0.5
  }
  
  # 保存处理后的数据
  all_data[[g]] <- dda
  
  # 拟合模型
  mixed.lmer <- rma.mv(yi = MicrobialBiomass_yi, V = MicrobialBiomass_vi, mods = ~ PlantBiomass_yi, 
                       random = list( ~ 1|Biomes/ID, ~1|Group),
                       control = list(iter.max = 1000, rel.tol = 1e-8), data = dda)
  
  # 生成预测数据
  tempX <- seq(min(dda$PlantBiomass_yi, na.rm = TRUE), 
               max(dda$PlantBiomass_yi, na.rm = TRUE), 
               length.out = 100)
  pred.mm <- data.frame(tempX, predict(mixed.lmer, newmods = tempX))
  pred.mm <- pred.mm[, c('tempX', 'pred', 'ci.ub', 'ci.lb')]
  pred.mm$GC <- g
  p <- mixed.lmer$pval[2]
  p_text <- ifelse(p < 0.001, "< 0.001", sprintf('= %0.3f', p))
  pred.mm$p_values <- paste0(g, ', P ', p_text)
  
  all_pred[[g]] <- pred.mm
}

# 合并所有数据
combined_data <- do.call(rbind, all_data)
combined_pred <- do.call(rbind, all_pred)

# 简化版颜色方案

# 使用简化颜色方案的图形
combined_plot_simple3 <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = combined_data, 
             aes(x = PlantDiversity_yi, y = MicrobialBiomass_yi, color = GC), 
             size = combined_data$BubbleSize, alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_line(data = combined_pred, 
            aes(x = tempX, y = pred, color = GC), size = 0.6) +
  geom_text(data = combined_pred %>% group_by(GC) %>% slice(1),
            aes(label = p_values, x = -Inf, y = Inf, color = GC),
            hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 2.35, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 0.3) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = 'black', size = 0.6),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = '#FFFFFF'),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 7, color = 'black'),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 7, color = 'black'),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
    axis.ticks.y = element_line(size = 0.5),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(size = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.2, "cm"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6)
  ) +
  ylab('RR of microbial biomass') +
  xlab('RR of plant diversity') +
  scale_color_manual(values = simple_colors)


df <- ddate[, c(1:35, 245:256, 
                which(colnames(ddate) %in% c("PlantRichness_yi", "PlantRichness_vi",
                                             "PlantShannon_yi", "PlantShannon_vi")))]

ddf1 = cbind(df,ddate[,c("ALL_MicrobialRichness_yi", "ALL_MicrobialRichness_vi")])
df1 <- ddf1
names(df1)[names(df1) == "ALL_MicrobialRichness_yi"] <- "MicrobialDiversity_yi"
names(df1)[names(df1) == "ALL_MicrobialRichness_vi"] <- "MicrobialDiversity_vi"
df1$Group <- "Microbe"

ddf2 = cbind(df,ddate[,c("Bacteria_MicrobialRichness_yi", "Bacteria_MicrobialRichness_vi")])
df2 <- ddf2
names(df2)[names(df2) == "Bacteria_MicrobialRichness_yi"] <- "MicrobialDiversity_yi"
names(df2)[names(df2) == "Bacteria_MicrobialRichness_vi"] <- "MicrobialDiversity_vi"
df2$Group <- "Bacteria"

ddf3 = cbind(df,ddate[,c("Fungi_MicrobialRichness_yi", "Fungi_MicrobialRichness_vi")])
df3 <- ddf3
names(df3)[names(df3) == "Fungi_MicrobialRichness_yi"] <- "MicrobialDiversity_yi"
names(df3)[names(df3) == "Fungi_MicrobialRichness_vi"] <- "MicrobialDiversity_vi"
df3$Group <- "Fungi"

ddf4 = cbind(df,ddate[,c("AMF_MicrobialRichness_yi", "AMF_MicrobialRichness_vi")])
df4 <- ddf4
names(df4)[names(df4) == "AMF_MicrobialRichness_yi"] <- "MicrobialDiversity_yi"
names(df4)[names(df4) == "AMF_MicrobialRichness_vi"] <- "MicrobialDiversity_vi"
df4$Group <- "AMF"

ddf11 = cbind(df,ddate[,c("ALL_MicrobialShannon_yi", "ALL_MicrobialShannon_vi")])
df11 <- ddf11
names(df11)[names(df11) == "ALL_MicrobialShannon_yi"] <- "MicrobialDiversity_yi"
names(df11)[names(df11) == "ALL_MicrobialShannon_vi"] <- "MicrobialDiversity_vi"
df11$Group <- "Microbe"

ddf21 = cbind(df,ddate[,c("Bacteria_MicrobialShannon_yi", "Bacteria_MicrobialShannon_vi")])
df21 <- ddf21
names(df21)[names(df21) == "Bacteria_MicrobialShannon_yi"] <- "MicrobialDiversity_yi"
names(df21)[names(df21) == "Bacteria_MicrobialShannon_vi"] <- "MicrobialDiversity_vi"
df21$Group <- "Bacteria"

ddf31 = cbind(df,ddate[,c("Fungi_MicrobialShannon_yi", "Fungi_MicrobialShannon_vi")])
df31 <- ddf31
names(df31)[names(df31) == "Fungi_MicrobialShannon_yi"] <- "MicrobialDiversity_yi"
names(df31)[names(df31) == "Fungi_MicrobialShannon_vi"] <- "MicrobialDiversity_vi"
df31$Group <- "Fungi"

ddf41 = cbind(df,ddate[,c("AMF_MicrobialShannon_yi", "AMF_MicrobialShannon_vi")])
df41 <- ddf41
names(df41)[names(df41) == "AMF_MicrobialShannon_yi"] <- "MicrobialDiversity_yi"
names(df41)[names(df41) == "AMF_MicrobialShannon_vi"] <- "MicrobialDiversity_vi"
df41$Group <- "AMF"

dataf <- rbind(df1,df2,df3,df4,df11,df21,df31,df41)
datadf1 <- dataf[, !(names(dataf) %in% c("PlantShannon_yi", "PlantShannon_vi"))]
names(datadf1)[names(datadf1) == "PlantRichness_yi"] <- "PlantDiversity_yi"
names(datadf1)[names(datadf1) == "PlantRichness_vi"] <- "PlantDiversity_vi"
datadf1$Diversitytype <- "Richness"

datadf2 <- dataf[, !(names(dataf) %in% c("PlantRichness_yi", "PlantRichness_vi"))]
names(datadf2)[names(datadf2) == "PlantShannon_yi"] <- "PlantDiversity_yi"
names(datadf2)[names(datadf2) == "PlantShannon_vi"] <- "PlantDiversity_vi"
datadf2$Diversitytype <- "Shannon"

ddf <- rbind(datadf1, datadf2)

ddf <-subset(ddf,!is.na(PlantDiversity_yi)) 
ddf <-subset(ddf,!is.na(MicrobialDiversity_yi)) 
ddf <-subset(ddf,MicrobialDiversity_vi>0) 


Q1_bio <- quantile(ddf$PlantDiversity_yi, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
Q3_bio <- quantile(ddf$PlantDiversity_yi, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
IQR_bio <- Q3_bio - Q1_bio
ddf <- ddf[ddf$PlantDiversity_yi >= (Q1_bio - 3 * IQR_bio) &
             ddf$PlantDiversity_yi <= (Q3_bio + 3 * IQR_bio), ]

Q1_div <- quantile(ddf$MicrobialDiversity_yi, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
Q3_div <- quantile(ddf$MicrobialDiversity_yi, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
IQR_div <- Q3_div - Q1_div
ddf <- ddf[ddf$MicrobialDiversity_yi >= (Q1_div - 3 * IQR_div) &
             ddf$MicrobialDiversity_yi <= (Q3_div + 3 * IQR_div), ]



gc_counts <- table(ddf$GC)
selected_GC <- names(gc_counts[gc_counts >= 15])
ddf <- ddf[ddf$GC %in% selected_GC, ]


# 创建一个空的列表来存储每个GC组的预测数据
all_pred <- list()
all_data <- list()

# 循环处理每个GC组
for(g in unique(ddf$GC)){
  dda <- subset(ddf, GC == g)
  dda$BubbleSize <- 1
  Weight <- 1/sqrt(dda$MicrobialDiversity_vi)
  Breaks <- quantile(Weight, c(0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
  selectIDs <- which(Weight < Breaks[1])
  dda$BubbleSize <- 1
  for(i in seq(2, length(Breaks))){
    selectIDs <- which((Weight < Breaks[i]) & (Weight >= Breaks[i-1]))
    dda$BubbleSize[selectIDs] <- 1 + (i-1)*0.5
  }
  
  # 保存处理后的数据
  all_data[[g]] <- dda
  
  # 拟合模型
  mixed.lmer <- rma.mv(yi = MicrobialDiversity_yi, V = MicrobialDiversity_vi, mods = ~ PlantDiversity_yi, 
                       random = list( ~ 1|Biomes/ID, ~1|Group),
                       control = list(iter.max = 1000, rel.tol = 1e-8), data = dda)
  
  # 生成预测数据
  tempX <- seq(min(dda$PlantDiversity_yi, na.rm = TRUE), 
               max(dda$PlantDiversity_yi, na.rm = TRUE), 
               length.out = 100)
  pred.mm <- data.frame(tempX, predict(mixed.lmer, newmods = tempX))
  pred.mm <- pred.mm[, c('tempX', 'pred', 'ci.ub', 'ci.lb')]
  pred.mm$GC <- g
  p <- mixed.lmer$pval[2]
  p_text <- ifelse(p < 0.001, "< 0.001", sprintf('= %0.3f', p))
  pred.mm$p_values <- paste0(g, ', P ', p_text)
  
  all_pred[[g]] <- pred.mm
}

# 合并所有数据
combined_data <- do.call(rbind, all_data)
combined_pred <- do.call(rbind, all_pred)

# 简化版颜色方案
simple_colors <- c(
  "W_N" = "#B22222",   
  "W_PPT+" = "#FF6600", 
  "N_PPT+" = "#9B59B6",
  "N_P" = "#4797b1",   
  "P_K" = "#36506c"
)
# 使用简化颜色方案的图形
combined_plot_simple4 <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = combined_data, 
             aes(x = PlantDiversity_yi, y = MicrobialDiversity_yi, color = GC), 
             size = combined_data$BubbleSize, alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_line(data = combined_pred, 
            aes(x = tempX, y = pred, color = GC), size = 0.6) +
  geom_text(data = combined_pred %>% group_by(GC) %>% slice(1),
            aes(label = p_values, x = -Inf, y = Inf, color = GC),
            hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 2.35, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 0.3) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = 'black', size = 0.6),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = '#FFFFFF'),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 7, color = 'black'),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 7, color = 'black'),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
    axis.ticks.y = element_line(size = 0.5),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(size = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.2, "cm"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6)
  ) +
  ylab('RR of microbial diversity') +
  xlab('RR of plant diversity') +
  scale_color_manual(values = simple_colors)



combined_plot <- combined_plot_simple1 + combined_plot_simple2 + combined_plot_simple3 + combined_plot_simple4 + 
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.tag = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"), 
        plot.tag.position = c(0, 1)) 

combined_plot <- combined_plot + 
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'a')

print(combined_plot)
```

```{r}
library(metafor)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

##==== Part 1: Load data ====##
ddate<-read.csv("metadata.csv",header = T)
ddate <- ddate %>%

ddate <- ddate %>%
  mutate(Biomes = case_when(

    Biomes %in% c("Alpine grassland", "Temperate grassland") ~ "Grassland",

  ))

Biome_order <- c("Agriculture", "Forest", "Grassland", "Desert/Desert grassland", "Tundra", "Wetland")
df = ddate[,1:32]

df1 = cbind(df,ddate[,c("PlantStructure_yi","PlantStructure_vi")])
names(df1)[names(df1) == "PlantStructure_yi"] <- "yi"
names(df1)[names(df1) == "PlantStructure_vi"] <- "vi"
df1$Group <- "Plant"

d2 <-subset(df1,!is.na(yi)) 
plant_structure <-subset(d2,vi > 0) 




ddate<-read.csv("metadata.csv",header = T)
ddate <- ddate %>%
  mutate(Biomes = case_when(
    Biomes %in% c("Irrigated agriculture", "Rainfed agriculture") ~ "Agriculture",
    Biomes %in% c("Alpine grassland", "Temperate grassland") ~ "Grassland",
    Biomes %in% c("Desert grassland") ~ "Desert/Desert grassland",
    TRUE ~ Biomes  # 保持其他值不变
  ))
GC_order <- c("eCO2", "W", "N", "P", "K", "PPT-", "PPT+", "eCO2_W", "eCO2_N", "eCO2_PPT-", "W_N", "W_PPT-", "W_PPT+", "N_P", "N_K", "P_K", "N_PPT-", "N_PPT+", "eCO2_W_PPT-", "W_N_P", "N_P_K")
GR_order <- c("Plant","Microbe","Bacteria","Fungi","AMF")
Biome_order <- c("Agriculture", "Forest", "Grassland", "Desert/Desert grassland", "Tundra", "Wetland")
df = ddate[,1:32]

df1 = cbind(df,ddate[,c("PlantBeta_yi","PlantBeta_vi")])
names(df1)[names(df1) == "PlantBeta_yi"] <- "yi"
names(df1)[names(df1) == "PlantBeta_vi"] <- "vi"
df1$Group <- "Plant"

d2 <-subset(df1,!is.na(yi)) 
plant_beta <-subset(d2,vi > 0) 



dataap <- list(plant_biomass,plant_diversity,plant_structure, plant_beta)

##==== Part 2: Fit model ====##
bias_table <- list()
n <- 1
for (j in 1:4) {
  dataap[[j]] <- drop_na(dataap[[j]],yi)

  for(bio in c("Agriculture", "Forest", "Grassland", "Desert/Desert grassland", "Tundra", "Wetland")){
    data_return <- data.frame('Biomes' = as.character(),'GCFs' = as.character(), 'Mean effect size' = as.character(),
                              'Egger??s z' = as.character(),'pval'= as.character(), 'Corrected mean effect size' = as.character())
    data <- filter(dataap[[j]], Biomes == bio)
    for(i in 1:length(unique(data$GC))){
      temp_rma <- try(rma(yi,vi, data = filter(data, GC == sort(unique(data$GC))[i] & vi>0), method="REML"))
      temp_res_ap <- try(regtest(temp_rma), silent = T)
      if('try-error' %in% class(temp_rma) | 'try-error' %in% class(temp_res_ap)) next
      res_ap<-rma(yi,vi, data = filter(data, GC == sort(unique(data$GC))[i] & vi>0), method="REML")
      
      ##==== Part 3: Pubulication bias analysis ====##
      Eggers_test <- regtest(res_ap) 
      if(Eggers_test[["pval"]] < 0.05) { #trimfill, if test significant
        Trim_and_fill <- trimfill(res_ap) 
        
        ##==== Part 4: extract results ====##
        data_return[i,1] <-bio
        data_return[i,2] <-sort(unique(data$GC))[i]
        data_return[i,3] <-paste0(sprintf('%0.3f',Eggers_test[["est"]][["intrcpt"]]),' (',
                                  sprintf('%0.3f',Eggers_test[["ci.lb"]]),' ?? ',
                                  sprintf('%0.3f',Eggers_test[["ci.ub"]]),')')
        data_return[i,4] <- paste0(sprintf('%0.3f',Eggers_test[["zval"]]),'*')
        data_return[i,5] <- paste0(sprintf('%0.3f',Eggers_test[["pval"]]))
        data_return[i,6] <- paste0(sprintf('%0.3f',as.numeric(Trim_and_fill[["b"]])),' (',
                                   sprintf('%0.3f',Trim_and_fill[["ci.lb"]]),' ?? ',
                                   sprintf('%0.3f',Trim_and_fill[["ci.ub"]]),')')
      }  else {
        data_return[i,1] <-bio
        data_return[i,2] <-sort(unique(data$GC))[i]
        data_return[i,3] <-paste0(sprintf('%0.3f',Eggers_test[["est"]][["intrcpt"]]),' (',
                                  sprintf('%0.3f',Eggers_test[["ci.lb"]]),' ?? ',
                                  sprintf('%0.3f',Eggers_test[["ci.ub"]]),')')
        data_return[i,4] <- paste0(sprintf('%0.3f',Eggers_test[["zval"]]))
        data_return[i,5] <- paste0(sprintf('%0.3f',Eggers_test[["pval"]]))
        data_return[i,6] <- '??'
      }
    }
    data_return$GCFs <- factor(data_return$GCFs,levels = GC_order)
    bias_table[[n]] <- arrange(data_return,GCFs)
    n <- n +1
  }
}

##==== Part 5: Save ====##
names(bias_table) <- c(rep("plant_biomass",6),rep("plant_diversity",6),rep("plant_structure",6),
                       rep("plant_beta",6))
bias_table <- bind_rows(bias_table,.id = 'group')
bias_table <- na.omit(bias_table)
write.csv(bias_table, file = 'publication_bias_plant.csv')
```

```{r}
  mutate(Biomes = case_when(
    Biomes %in% c("Irrigated agriculture", "Rainfed agriculture") ~ "Agriculture",

    Biomes %in% c("Desert grassland") ~ "Desert/Desert grassland",
    TRUE ~ Biomes  # 保持其他值不变
  ))
GC_order <- c("eCO2", "W", "N", "P", "K", "PPT-", "PPT+", "eCO2_W", "eCO2_N", "eCO2_PPT-", "W_N", "W_PPT-", "W_PPT+", "N_P", "N_K", "P_K", "N_PPT-", "N_PPT+", "eCO2_W_PPT-", "W_N_P", "N_P_K")

Biome_order <- c("Agriculture", "Forest", "Grassland", "Desert/Desert grassland", "Tundra", "Wetland")
df = ddate[,1:32]

df2 = cbind(df,ddate[,c("ALL_MicrobialBeta_yi","ALL_MicrobialBeta_vi")])

df4 = cbind(df,ddate[,c("Fungi_MicrobialBeta_yi","Fungi_MicrobialBeta_vi")])

names(df4)[names(df4) == "Fungi_MicrobialBeta_vi"] <- "vi"
df4$Group <- "Microbe"

df5 = cbind(df,ddate[,c("AMF_MicrobialBeta_yi","AMF_MicrobialBeta_vi")])
names(df5)[names(df5) == "AMF_MicrobialBeta_yi"] <- "yi"
names(df5)[names(df5) == "AMF_MicrobialBeta_vi"] <- "vi"
df5$Group <- "Microbe"

ddf <- rbind(df2,df3,df4,df5)
d2 <-subset(ddf,!is.na(yi)) 
microbial_beta <-subset(d2,vi > 0) 



dataap <- list(microbial_biomass,microbial_diversity,microbial_structure, microbial_beta)

##==== Part 2: Fit model ====##
bias_table <- list()
n <- 1
for (j in 1:4) {
  dataap[[j]] <- drop_na(dataap[[j]],yi)
  
  for(bio in c("Agriculture", "Forest", "Grassland", "Desert/Desert grassland", "Tundra", "Wetland")){
    data_return <- data.frame('Biomes' = as.character(),'GCFs' = as.character(), 'Mean effect size' = as.character(),
                              'Egger??s z' = as.character(),'pval'= as.character(), 'Corrected mean effect size' = as.character())
    data <- filter(dataap[[j]], Biomes == bio)
    for(i in 1:length(unique(data$GC))){
      temp_rma <- try(rma(yi,vi, data = filter(data, GC == sort(unique(data$GC))[i] & vi>0), method="REML"))
      if ('try-error' %in% class(temp_rma)) {
      temp_rma <- try(rma(yi, vi, data = filter(data, GC == sort(unique(data$GC))[i] & vi>0), method = "PM"))
      }
      
      temp_res_ap <- try(regtest(temp_rma), silent = T)
      
      if('try-error' %in% class(temp_rma) | 'try-error' %in% class(temp_res_ap)) next
      res_ap<-try(rma(yi,vi, data = filter(data, GC == sort(unique(data$GC))[i] & vi>0), method="REML"))

      if ('try-error' %in% class(res_ap)) {
      res_ap <- try(rma(yi, vi, data = filter(data, GC == sort(unique(data$GC))[i] & vi>0), method = "PM"))
      }

      ##==== Part 3: Pubulication bias analysis ====##
      Eggers_test <- regtest(res_ap) 
      if(Eggers_test[["pval"]] < 0.05) { #trimfill, if test significant
        Trim_and_fill <- trimfill(res_ap) 
        
        ##==== Part 4: extract results ====##
        data_return[i,1] <-bio
        data_return[i,2] <-sort(unique(data$GC))[i]
        data_return[i,3] <-paste0(sprintf('%0.3f',Eggers_test[["est"]][["intrcpt"]]),' (',
                                  sprintf('%0.3f',Eggers_test[["ci.lb"]]),' ?? ',
                                  sprintf('%0.3f',Eggers_test[["ci.ub"]]),')')
        data_return[i,4] <- paste0(sprintf('%0.3f',Eggers_test[["zval"]]),'*')
        data_return[i,5] <- paste0(sprintf('%0.3f',Eggers_test[["pval"]]))
        data_return[i,6] <- paste0(sprintf('%0.3f',as.numeric(Trim_and_fill[["b"]])),' (',
                                   sprintf('%0.3f',Trim_and_fill[["ci.lb"]]),' ?? ',
                                   sprintf('%0.3f',Trim_and_fill[["ci.ub"]]),')')
      }  else {
        data_return[i,1] <-bio
        data_return[i,2] <-sort(unique(data$GC))[i]
        data_return[i,3] <-paste0(sprintf('%0.3f',Eggers_test[["est"]][["intrcpt"]]),' (',
                                  sprintf('%0.3f',Eggers_test[["ci.lb"]]),' ?? ',
                                  sprintf('%0.3f',Eggers_test[["ci.ub"]]),')')
        data_return[i,4] <- paste0(sprintf('%0.3f',Eggers_test[["zval"]]))
        data_return[i,5] <- paste0(sprintf('%0.3f',Eggers_test[["pval"]]))
        data_return[i,6] <- '??'
      }
    }
    data_return$GCFs <- factor(data_return$GCFs,levels = GC_order)
    bias_table[[n]] <- arrange(data_return,GCFs)
    n <- n +1
  }
}

##==== Part 5: Save ====##
names(bias_table) <- c(rep("microbial_biomass",6),rep("microbial_diversity",6),rep("microbial_structure",6),
                       rep("microbial_beta",6))
bias_table <- bind_rows(bias_table,.id = 'group')
bias_table <- na.omit(bias_table)
write.csv(bias_table, file = 'publication_bias_microbial.csv')
```

```{r}
    }
    data_return$GCFs <- factor(data_return$GCFs,levels = GC_order)
    bias_table[[n]] <- arrange(data_return,GCFs)
    n <- n +1
  }
}

##==== Part 5: Save ====##
names(bias_table) <- c(rep("microbial_biomass",4),rep("microbial_diversity",4),rep("microbial_structure",4),rep("microbial_beta",4))
bias_table <- bind_rows(bias_table,.id = 'group')
bias_table <- na.omit(bias_table)
write.csv(bias_table, file = 'publication_bias_soil_microbial_group.csv')
```
